transliteration.text: síndhuḥ ǀ ná ǀ kṣódaḥ ǀ śímī-vān ǀ ṛghāyatáḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣā-iva ǀ vádhrīn ǀ abhí ǀ vaṣṭi ǀ ójasā ǀagnéḥ-iva ǀ prá-sitiḥ ǀ ná ǀ áha ǀ vártave ǀ yám-yam ǀ yújam ǀ kṛṇuté ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǁ

Sukta 25.translation: “As a river (washes away) its banks, so the devout worshipper, (ofBrahmaṇaspati), overpowers his enemies by his strength, as a bull (overcomes) an ox; like the spreading flame of fire, it is impossible to stop him, whom Brahmaṇaspati makes his associate.”
Sukta 25.sanskrit_wisdomlib: सिन्धु॒र्न क्षोद॒: शिमी॑वाँ ऋघाय॒तो वृषे॑व॒ वध्रीँ॑र॒भि व॒ष्ट्योज॑सा । अ॒ग्नेरि॑व॒ प्रसि॑ति॒र्नाह॒ वर्त॑वे॒ यंयं॒ युजं॑ कृणु॒ते ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॑:

devanagari.text: तस्मा अर्षंति दिव्या असश्चतः स सत्वभिः प्रथमो गोषु गच्छति ।अनिभृष्टतविषिर्हंत्योजसा यंयं युजं कृणुते ब्रह्मणस्पतिः ॥
तस्मै । अर्षन्ति । दिव्याः । असश्चतः । सः । सत्वऽभिः । प्रथमः । गोषु । गच्छति ।अनिभृष्टऽतविषिः । हन्ति । ओजसा । यम्ऽयम् । युजम् । कृणुते । ब्रह्मणः । पतिः ॥

transliteration.text: tásmai ǀ arṣanti ǀ divyā́ḥ ǀ asaścátaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ sátva-bhiḥ ǀ prathamáḥ ǀ góṣu ǀ gacchati ǀánibhṛṣṭa-taviṣiḥ ǀ hanti ǀ ójasā ǀ yám-yam ǀ yújam ǀ kṛṇuté ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǁ

Sukta 25.translation: “For him, the unobstructed rains of heaven descend; first among the devout, he acqires (wealth) in cattle; of irresistible vigour, he destroys his enemies by his strength, whomBrahmaṇaspatimakes his associate.”
Sukta 25.sanskrit_wisdomlib: तस्मा॑ अर्षन्ति दि॒व्या अ॑स॒श्चत॒: स सत्व॑भिः प्रथ॒मो गोषु॑ गच्छति । अनि॑भृष्टतविषिर्ह॒न्त्योज॑सा॒ यंयं॒ युजं॑ कृणु॒ते ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॑:

devanagari.text: तस्मा इद्विश्वे धुनयंत सिंधवोऽच्छिद्रा शर्म दधिरे पुरूणि ।देवानां सुम्ने सुभगः स एधते यंयं युजं कृणुते ब्रह्मणस्पतिः ॥
तस्मै । इत् । विश्वे । धुनयन्त । सिन्धवः । अच्छिद्रा । शर्म । दधिरे । पुरूणि ।देवानाम् । सुम्ने । सुऽभगः । सः । एधते । यम्ऽयम् । युजम् । कृणुते । ब्रह्मणः । पतिः ॥

transliteration.text: tásmai ǀ ít ǀ víśve ǀ dhunayanta ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ ácchidrā ǀ śárma ǀ dadhire ǀ purū́ṇi ǀdevā́nām ǀ sumné ǀ su-bhágaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ edhate ǀ yám-yam ǀ yújam ǀ kṛṇuté ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǁ

Sukta 25.translation: “Verily, for him all rivers flow; him do uninterrupted and numerous plural asures await; blessed with the felicity of the gods, he ever prospers, whomBrahmaṇaspatimakes his associate.”
Sukta 25.sanskrit_wisdomlib: तस्मा॒ इद्विश्वे॑ धुनयन्त॒ सिन्ध॒वोऽच्छि॑द्रा॒ शर्म॑ दधिरे पु॒रूणि॑ । दे॒वानां॑ सु॒म्ने सु॒भग॒: स ए॑धते॒ यंयं॒ युजं॑ कृणु॒ते ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॑:

devanagari.text: ऋजुरिच्छंसो वनवद्वनुष्यतो देवयन्निददेवयंतमभ्यसत् ।सुप्रावीरिद्वनवत्पृत्सु दुष्टरं यज्वेदयज्योर्वि भजाति भोजनं ॥
ऋजुः । इत् । शंसः । वनवत् । वनुष्यतः । देवऽयन् । इत् । अदेवऽयन्तम् । अभि । असत् ।सुप्रऽअवीः । इत् । वनवत् । पृत्ऽसु । दुस्तरम् । यज्वा । इत् । अयज्योः । वि । भजाति । भोजनम् ॥

transliteration.text: ṛjúḥ ǀ ít ǀ śáṃsaḥ ǀ vanavat ǀ vanuṣyatáḥ ǀ deva-yán ǀ ít ǀ ádeva-yantam ǀ abhí ǀ asat ǀsupra-avī́ḥ ǀ ít ǀ vanavat ǀ pṛt-sú ǀ dustáram ǀ yájvā ǀ ít ǀ áyájyoḥ ǀ ví ǀ bhajāti ǀ bhójanam ǁ

Sukta 26.translation: “May the sincere praiser (ofBrahmaṇaspati) verily overcome (his) enemies; may the worshipper of the gods overcome him assuredly who does not reverence them; may the propitiatir (of Brahmaṇaspati) overcome him who is difficult to be overcome in battles; may he who offers sacrifice appropriate the food of him who does not sacrifice.”
Sukta 26.sanskrit_wisdomlib: ऋ॒जुरिच्छंसो॑ वनवद्वनुष्य॒तो दे॑व॒यन्निददे॑वयन्तम॒भ्य॑सत् । सु॒प्रा॒वीरिद्व॑नवत्पृ॒त्सु दु॒ष्टरं॒ यज्वेदय॑ज्यो॒र्वि भ॑जाति॒ भोज॑नम्

devanagari.text: यजस्व वीर प्र विहि मनायतो भद्रं मनः कृणुष्व वृत्रतूर्ये ।हविष्कृणुष्व सुभगो यथाससि ब्रह्मणस्पतेरव आ वृणीमहे ॥
यजस्व । वीर । प्र । विहि । मनायतः । भद्रम् । मनः । कृणुष्व । वृत्रऽतूर्ये ।हविः । कृणुष्व । सुऽभगः । यथा । अससि । ब्रह्मणः । पतेः । अवः । आ । वृणीमहे ॥

transliteration.text: yájasva ǀ vīra ǀ prá ǀ vihi ǀ manāyatáḥ ǀ bhadrám ǀ mánaḥ ǀ kṛṇuṣva ǀ vṛtra-tū́rye ǀhavíḥ ǀ kṛṇuṣva ǀ su-bhágaḥ ǀ yáthā ǀ ásasi ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ páteḥ ǀ ávaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṇīmahe ǁ

Sukta 26.translation: “Offer worship, O man, (toBrahmaṇaspati); proceed resolutely against those who are meditating (hostility); keep your mind firm in contending against foes; offer oblations whereby you may be prosperous; we also solicit the protection of Brahmaṇaspati.”
Sukta 26.sanskrit_wisdomlib: यज॑स्व वीर॒ प्र वि॑हि मनाय॒तो भ॒द्रं मन॑: कृणुष्व वृत्र॒तूर्ये॑ । ह॒विष्कृ॑णुष्व सु॒भगो॒ यथास॑सि॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पते॒रव॒ आ वृ॑णीमहे

devanagari.text: स इज्जनेन स विशा स जन्मना स पुत्रैर्वाजं भरते धना नृभिः ।देवानां यः पितरमाविवासति श्रद्धामना हविषा ब्रह्मणस्पतिं ॥
सः । इत् । जनेन । सः । विशा । सः । जन्मना । सः । पुत्रैः । वाजम् । भरते । धना । नृऽभिः ।देवानाम् । यः । पितरम् । आऽविवासति । श्रद्धाऽमनाः । हविषा । ब्रह्मणः । पतिम् ॥

transliteration.text: sáḥ ǀ ít ǀ jánena ǀ sáḥ ǀ viśā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ jánmanā ǀ sáḥ ǀ putráiḥ ǀ vā́jam ǀ bharate ǀ dhánā ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀdevā́nām ǀ yáḥ ǀ pitáram ǀ ā-vívāsati ǀ śraddhā́-manāḥ ǀ havíṣā ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátim ǁ

Sukta 26.translation: “He who with a believing mind worshipsBrahmaṇaspati, the father of the gods, with oblations, he verily receives food, together with his sons, his kindred, his descendants, his people, and (obtains) riches together with (all) men.”
Sukta 26.sanskrit_wisdomlib: स इज्जने॑न॒ स वि॒शा स जन्म॑ना॒ स पु॒त्रैर्वाजं॑ भरते॒ धना॒ नृभि॑: । दे॒वानां॒ यः पि॒तर॑मा॒विवा॑सति श्र॒द्धाम॑ना ह॒विषा॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॑म्

devanagari.text: यो अस्मै हव्यैर्घृतवद्भिरविधत्प्र तं प्राचा नयति ब्रह्मणस्पतिः ।उरुष्यतीमंहसो रक्षती रिषोऽंहोश्चिदस्मा उरुचक्रिरद्भुतः ॥
यः । अस्मै । हव्यैः । घृतवत्ऽभिः । अविधत् । प्र । तम् । प्राचा । नयति । ब्रह्मणः । पतिः ।उरुष्यति । ईम् । अंहसः । रक्षति । रिषः । अंहोः । चित् । अस्मै । उरुऽचक्रिः । अद्भुतः ॥

transliteration.text: yáḥ ǀ asmai ǀ havyáiḥ ǀ ghṛtávat-bhiḥ ǀ ávidhat ǀ prá ǀ tám ǀ prācā́ ǀ nayati ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ pátiḥ ǀuruṣyáti ǀ īm ǀ áṃhasaḥ ǀ rákṣati ǀ riṣáḥ ǀ aṃhóḥ ǀ cit ǀ asmai ǀ uru-cákriḥ ǀ ádbhutaḥ ǁ

Sukta 26.translation: “Brahmaṇaspatileads by a straight path (to his reward), the worshipper who propitiates him with oblations of butter; he guards him against sin; he protects him from foes and from distress; and wonderful (in might) confers upon him many (favours).”
Sukta 26.sanskrit_wisdomlib: यो अ॑स्मै ह॒व्यैर्घृ॒तव॑द्भि॒रवि॑ध॒त्प्र तं प्रा॒चा न॑यति॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॑: । उ॒रु॒ष्यती॒मंह॑सो॒ रक्ष॑ती रि॒षों॒३॒॑ऽहोश्चि॑दस्मा उरु॒चक्रि॒रद्भु॑तः

devanagari.text: इमा गिर आदित्येभ्यो घृतस्नूः सनाद्राजभ्यो जुह्वा जुहोमि ।शृणोतु मित्रो अर्यमा भगो नस्तुविजातो वरुणो दक्षो अंशः ॥
इमाः । गिरः । आदित्येभ्यः । घृतऽस्नूः । सनात् । राजऽभ्यः । जुह्वा । जुहोमि ।शृणोतु । मित्रः । अर्यमा । भगः । नः । तुविऽजातः । वरुणः । दक्षः । अंशः ॥

transliteration.text: imā́ḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ ādityébhyaḥ ǀ ghṛtá-snūḥ ǀ sanā́t ǀ rā́ja-bhyaḥ ǀ juhvā́ ǀ juhomi ǀśṛṇótu ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ bhágaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ tuvi-jātáḥ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ dákṣaḥ ǀ áṃśaḥ ǁ

Sukta 27.translation: “I present continually, with the ladle (of speech), these oblation-dropping hymns to the royalĀdityas; mayMitra,Aryaman,Bhaga, the multi-presentVaruṇa, the powerfulAṃśa, hear us.”
Sukta 27.sanskrit_wisdomlib: इ॒मा गिर॑ आदि॒त्येभ्यो॑ घृ॒तस्नू॑: स॒नाद्राज॑भ्यो जु॒ह्वा॑ जुहोमि । शृ॒णोतु॑ मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा भगो॑ नस्तुविजा॒तो वरु॑णो॒ दक्षो॒ अंश॑:

devanagari.text: इमं स्तोमं सक्रतवो मे अद्य मित्रो अर्यमा वरुणो जुषंत ।आदित्यासः शुचयो धारपूता अवृजिना अनवद्या अरिष्टाः ॥
इमम् । स्तोमम् । सऽक्रतवः । मे । अद्य । मित्रः । अर्यमा । वरुणः । जुषन्त ।आदित्यासः । शुचयः । धारऽपूताः । अवृजिनाः । अनवद्याः । अरिष्टाः ॥

transliteration.text: imám ǀ stómam ǀ sá-kratavaḥ ǀ me ǀ adyá ǀ mitráḥ ǀ aryamā́ ǀ váruṇaḥ ǀ juṣanta ǀādityā́saḥ ǀ śúcayaḥ ǀ dhā́ra-pūtāḥ ǀ ávṛjināḥ ǀ anavadyā́ḥ ǀ áriṣṭāḥ ǁ

Sukta 27.translation: “May those of equal exploits,Mitra,Aryaman,Varuṇa, be plural ased today by this my praise; they who areĀdityas, luminous, purified by showers, who abandon none (that worship them), who are irreproachable unassailable.”
Sukta 27.sanskrit_wisdomlib: इ॒मं स्तोमं॒ सक्र॑तवो मे अ॒द्य मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा वरु॑णो जुषन्त । आ॒दि॒त्यास॒: शुच॑यो॒ धार॑पूता॒ अवृ॑जिना अनव॒द्या अरि॑ष्टाः

devanagari.text: त आदित्यास उरवो गभीरा अदब्धासो दिप्संतो भूर्यक्षाः ।अंतः पश्यंति वृजिनोत साधु सर्वं राजभ्यः परमा चिदंति ॥
ते । आदित्यासः । उरवः । गभीराः । अदब्धासः । दिप्सन्तः । भूरिऽअक्षाः ।अन्तरिति । पश्यन्ति । वृजिना । उत । साधु । सर्वम् । राजऽभ्यः । परमा । चित् । अन्ति ॥

transliteration.text: té ǀ ādityā́saḥ ǀ urávaḥ ǀ gabhīrā́ḥ ǀ ádabdhāsaḥ ǀ dípsantaḥ ǀ bhūri-akṣā́ḥ ǀantáríti ǀ paśyanti ǀ vṛjinā́ ǀ utá ǀ sādhú ǀ sárvam ǀ rā́ja-bhyaḥ ǀ paramā́ ǀ cit ǀ ánti ǁ

Sukta 27.translation: “ThoseĀdityas, mighty, profound, unsubdued, subduing, many-eyed, behold the innermost (thoughts of men), whether wicked or virtuous, whether far from or nigh to those royal (deities).”
Sukta 27.sanskrit_wisdomlib: त आ॑दि॒त्यास॑ उ॒रवो॑ गभी॒रा अद॑ब्धासो॒ दिप्स॑न्तो भूर्य॒क्षाः । अ॒न्तः प॑श्यन्ति वृजि॒नोत सा॒धु सर्वं॒ राज॑भ्यः पर॒मा चि॒दन्ति॑

devanagari.text: धारयंत आदित्यासो जगत्स्था देवा विश्वस्य भुवनस्य गोपाः ।दीर्घाधियो रक्षमाणा असुर्यमृतावानश्चयमाना ऋणानि ॥
धारयन्तः । आदित्यासः । जगत् । स्थाः । देवाः । विश्वस्य । भुवनस्य । गोपाः ।दीर्घऽधियः । रक्षमाणाः । असुर्यम् । ऋतऽवानः । चयमानाः । ऋणानि ॥

transliteration.text: dhāráyantaḥ ǀ ādityā́saḥ ǀ jágat ǀ sthā́ḥ ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ víśvasya ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀdīrghá-dhiyaḥ ǀ rákṣamāṇāḥ ǀ asuryám ǀ ṛtá-vānaḥ ǀ cáyamānāḥ ǀ ṛṇā́ni ǁ

Sukta 27.translation: “The divineĀdityasare the upholders (of all things), moveable or immoveable; the protectors of the universe; the provident in acts; the collectors of rain; the possessors of veracity; the acquitters of our debts.”
Sukta 27.sanskrit_wisdomlib: धा॒रय॑न्त आदि॒त्यासो॒ जग॒त्स्था दे॒वा विश्व॑स्य॒ भुव॑नस्य गो॒पाः । दी॒र्घाधि॑यो॒ रक्ष॑माणा असु॒र्य॑मृ॒तावा॑न॒श्चय॑माना ऋ॒णानि॑

devanagari.text: विद्यामादित्या अवसो वो अस्य यदर्यमन्भय आ चिन्मयोभु ।युष्माकं मित्रावरुणा प्रणीतौ परि श्वभ्रेव दुरितानि वृज्यां ॥
विद्याम् । आदित्याः । अवसः । वः । अस्य । यत् । अर्यमन् । भये । आ । चित् । मयःऽभु ।युष्माकम् । मित्रावरुणा । प्रऽनीतौ । परि । श्वभ्राऽइव । दुःऽइतानि । वृज्याम् ॥

Sukta 27.translation: “May I be conscious,Ādityas, of this your protection, the cause of happiness (and security) in danger;Aryaman,MitraandVaruṇa, may I, through your guidance, escape the sins which are like pitfalls (in my path).”

Sukta 27.translation: “Aryaman,MitraandVaruṇa, easy is the path (you show us), and free from thorns, and plural asant; therefore,Ādityas(lead us) by (it); speak to us favourably, and grant us happiness difficult to be disturbed.”

Sukta 27.translation: “MayAditi, the mother of royal song, plural ce us beyond the malice (of our enemies); mayAryamanlead us by easy paths, and may we, blessed with many descendants, and safe from harm, attain the great happiness ofMitraandVaruṇa.”

transliteration.text: tisráḥ ǀ bhū́mīḥ ǀ dhārayan ǀ trī́n ǀ utá ǀ dyū́n ǀ trī́ṇi ǀ vratā́ ǀ vidáthe ǀ antáḥ ǀ eṣām ǀṛténa ǀ ādityāḥ ǀ máhi ǀ vaḥ ǀ mahi-tvám ǀ tát ǀ aryaman ǀ varuṇa ǀ mitra ǀ cā́ru ǁ

Sukta 27.translation: “They uphold thethree worlds, the three heavens, and in their sacrifices three ceremonies (are comprised); by truth,Ādityas, has your great might (been produced), such as is most excellent;Aryaman,MitraandVaruṇa. (They uphold the three worlds: tisro bhumir dhārayan:bhūmi=loka, world, or sphere; earth, firmament, and heaven which the Ādityas support by supplying them with rain; the three heavens: trīḥ dyūn, the three luminous objects, dīptan; the threelokasabove the sky:mahar,jana,satya; or the three luminous deities:agni,vāyuandsūrya; three ceremonies: trīṇi vratā vidathe antar eṣām = lit. the three ceremonies in the sacrifice, in the midst of them; the three daily ceremonials are essentially one worship of the Ādityas; alternative meaning:in the midst of those worlds, there are three acts intended especially as the acts of the Ādityas, the absorption, retention, and redistribution of dew on rain].”

Sukta 27.translation: “TheĀdityas, decorated with golden ornaments, brilliant, purified by showers, who never slumber, nor close their eyelids, who are unassailable, and praised by many, uphold the three bright heavenly regions for the sake of the upright man.”

Sukta 27.translation: “Varuṇa, destroyer of foes, you are the sovereign over all, whether they be gods or mortals; grant to us to behold a hundred years, and that we may enjoy lives such as were enjoyed by ancient (sages).”
Sukta 27.sanskrit_wisdomlib: त्वं विश्वे॑षां वरुणासि॒ राजा॒ ये च॑ दे॒वा अ॑सुर॒ ये च॒ मर्ता॑: । श॒तं नो॑ रास्व श॒रदो॑ वि॒चक्षे॒ऽश्यामायूं॑षि॒ सुधि॑तानि॒ पूर्वा॑

Sukta 27.translation: “Neither is the righthandknown to us,Ādityas, nor is the left; neither is that which is in front, nor that which is behind, (discerned by me); givers of dwellings, may I, who an immature (in knowledge), and timid (in spirit), obtain, when guided by you, the light that is free from fear.”

Sukta 27.translation: “He who presents offerings to the royal and true (Ādityas); he whom their constant favours exalt; he proceeds, wealthy, renowned, munificent, and honoured, to sacrifices, in his chariot.”

Sukta 27.translation: “Pure, unmolested, possessing (abundant) food and virtuous descendants, he dwells amidst fertilizing waters; no one, whether nigh or afar, harms him who is (safe) in the good guidance of theĀdityas.”

Sukta 27.translation: “Aditi,Mitra,Varuṇa, have pity upon us, even though we may have committed some offence against you; may I obtain,Indra, that great light which is free from peril; let not the protracted glooms (of night) envelop us.”

Sukta 27.translation: “Both (heaven and earth) combined, cherish him (whom theĀdityasprotect); verily prosperous, he thrives, with the rain of heaven; victorious in battles, (he defends) both his own dwelling (and assails) that of his foe; to him both portions (of creation) are propitious.”

devanagari.text: या वो माया अभिद्रुहे यजत्राः पाशा आदित्या रिपवे विचृत्ताः ।अश्वीव ताँ अति येषं रथेनारिष्टा उरावा शर्मन्त्स्याम ॥

transliteration.text: yā́ḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ māyā́ḥ ǀ abhi-drúhe ǀ yajatrāḥ ǀ pā́śāḥ ǀ ādityāḥ ǀ ripáve ǀ ví-cṛttāḥ ǀaśvī́-iva ǀ tā́n ǀ áti ǀ yeṣam ǀ ráthena ǀ áriṣṭāḥ ǀ uráu ǀ ā́ ǀ śárman ǀ syāma ǁ

Sukta 27.translation: “AdorableĀdityas, may I pass (safe) in your car from the illusions which (you devise) for the malignant, the snares which are spread for your foes, (in like manner) as a horseman (passes over a road); and thus may we abide secure in infinite felicity.”
Sukta 27.sanskrit_wisdomlib: या वो॑ मा॒या अ॑भि॒द्रुहे॑ यजत्रा॒: पाशा॑ आदित्या रि॒पवे॒ विचृ॑त्ताः । अ॒श्वीव॒ ताँ अति॑ येषं॒ रथे॒नारि॑ष्टा उ॒रावा शर्म॑न्त्स्याम

devanagari.text: माहं मघोनो वरुण प्रियस्य भूरिदाव्न आ विदं शूनमापेः ।मा रायो राजन्त्सुयमादव स्थां बृहद्वदेम विदथे सुवीराः ॥
मा । अहम् । मघोनः । वरुण । प्रियस्य । भूरिऽदाव्नः । आ । विदम् । शूनम् । आपेः ।मा । रायः । राजन् । सुऽयमात् । अव । स्थाम् । बृहत् । वदेम । विदथे । सुऽवीराः ॥

transliteration.text: mā́ ǀ ahám ǀ maghónaḥ ǀ varuṇa ǀ priyásya ǀ bhūri-dā́vnaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vidam ǀ śū́nam ǀ āpéḥ ǀmā́ ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ rājan ǀ su-yámāt ǀ áva ǀ sthām ǀ bṛhát ǀ vadema ǀ vidáthe ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ

Sukta 27.translation: “May I never (have to) represent,Varuṇa, the destittution of a (once) opulent, dear, and munificent kinsman; may I never, royal Varuṇa, be devoid of well-regulated riches; (and) may we, blessed with excellent descendants, worthily glorify you at this sacrifice.”
Sukta 27.sanskrit_wisdomlib: माहं म॒घोनो॑ वरुण प्रि॒यस्य॑ भूरि॒दाव्न॒ आ वि॑दं॒ शून॑मा॒पेः । मा रा॒यो रा॑जन्त्सु॒यमा॒दव॑ स्थां बृ॒हद्व॑देम वि॒दथे॑ सु॒वीरा॑:

devanagari.text: इदं कवेरादित्यस्य स्वराजो विश्वानि सांत्यभ्यस्तु मह्ना ।अति यो मंद्रो यजथाय देवः सुकीर्तिं भिक्षे वरुणस्य भूरेः ॥
इदम् । कवेः । आदित्यस्य । स्वऽराजः । विश्वानि । सन्ति । अभि । अस्तु । मह्ना ।अति । यः । मन्द्रः । यजथाय । देवः । सुऽकीर्तिम् । भिक्षे । वरुणस्य । भूरेः ॥

transliteration.text: idám ǀ kavéḥ ǀ ādityásya ǀ sva-rā́jaḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ sánti ǀ abhí ǀ astu ǀ mahnā́ ǀáti ǀ yáḥ ǀ mandráḥ ǀ yajáthāya ǀ deváḥ ǀ su-kīrtím ǀ bhikṣe ǀ váruṇasya ǀ bhū́reḥ ǁ

Sukta 28.translation: “(The worshipper repeats) this praise of the sage; the self-radiantĀditya; may he preside over all beings by his power; I beg for fame of the sovereignVaruṇa, a deity who, when much plural ased (is propitious) to hsi adorer.”
Sukta 28.sanskrit_wisdomlib: इ॒दं क॒वेरा॑दि॒त्यस्य॑ स्व॒राजो॒ विश्वा॑नि॒ सान्त्य॒भ्य॑स्तु म॒ह्ना । अति॒ यो म॒न्द्रो य॒जथा॑य दे॒वः सु॑की॒र्तिं भि॑क्षे॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ भूरे॑:

devanagari.text: तव व्रते सुभगासः स्याम स्वाध्यो वरुण तुष्टुवांसः ।उपायन उषसां गोमतीनामग्नयो न जरमाणा अनु द्यून् ॥
तव । व्रते । सुऽभगासः । स्याम । सुऽआध्यः । वरुण । तुस्तुऽवांसः ।उपऽअयने । उषसाम् । गोऽमतीनाम् । अग्नयः । न । जरमाणाः । अनु । द्यून् ॥

transliteration.text: táva ǀ vraté ǀ su-bhágāsaḥ ǀ syāma ǀ su-ādhyáḥ ǀ varuṇa ǀ tustu-vā́ṃsaḥ ǀupa-áyane ǀ uṣásām ǀ gó-matīnām ǀ agnáyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ járamāṇāḥ ǀ ánu ǀ dyū́n ǁ

Sukta 28.translation: “May we,Varuṇa, deeply meditating on you, earnestly praising you, and (engaged) in your worship, be prosperous; glorifying you daily, like the fires (that are kindled in your honour) at the coming of the luminous dawns.”
Sukta 28.sanskrit_wisdomlib: तव॑ व्र॒ते सु॒भगा॑सः स्याम स्वा॒ध्यो॑ वरुण तुष्टु॒वांस॑: । उ॒पाय॑न उ॒षसां॒ गोम॑तीनाम॒ग्नयो॒ न जर॑माणा॒ अनु॒ द्यून्

devanagari.text: तव स्याम पुरुवीरस्य शर्मन्नुरुशंसस्य वरुण प्रणेतः ।यूयं नः पुत्रा अदितेरदब्धा अभि क्षमध्वं युज्याय देवाः ॥
अव । स्याम । पुरुऽवीरस्य । शर्मन् । उरुऽशंसस्य । वरुण । प्रनेतरिति प्रऽनेतः ।यूयम् । नः । पुत्राः । अदितेः । अदब्धाः । अभि । क्षमध्वम् । युज्याय । देवाः ॥

transliteration.text: áva ǀ syāma ǀ puru-vī́rasya ǀ śárman ǀ uru-śáṃsasya ǀ varuṇa ǀ pranetaríti pra-netaḥ ǀyūyám ǀ naḥ ǀ putrāḥ ǀ aditeḥ ǀ adabdhāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ kṣamadhvam ǀ yújyāya ǀ devāḥ ǁ

Sukta 28.translation: “Varuṇa, chief guide (of men), may we abide in the felicity of you, who are endowed with great powers, and are glorified by many; divine sons ofAditi, unharmed (by foes), have compassion upon us through your benevolence.”
Sukta 28.sanskrit_wisdomlib: तव॑ स्याम पुरु॒वीर॑स्य॒ शर्म॑न्नुरु॒शंस॑स्य वरुण प्रणेतः । यू॒यं न॑: पुत्रा अदितेरदब्धा अ॒भि क्ष॑मध्वं॒ युज्या॑य देवाः

devanagari.text: प्र सीमादित्यो असृजद्विधर्ताँ ऋतं सिंधवो वरुणस्य यंति ।न श्राम्यंति न वि मुचंत्येते वयो न पप्तू रघुया परिज्मन् ॥
प्र । सीम् । आदित्यः । असृजत् । विऽधर्ता । ऋतम् । सिन्धवः । वरुणस्य । यन्ति ।न । श्राम्यन्ति । न । वि । मुचन्ति । एते । वयः । न । पप्तुः । रघुऽया । परिऽज्मन् ॥

transliteration.text: prá ǀ sīm ǀ ādityáḥ ǀ asṛjat ǀ vi-dhartā́ ǀ ṛtám ǀ síndhavaḥ ǀ váruṇasya ǀ yanti ǀná ǀ śrāmyanti ǀ ná ǀ ví ǀ mucanti ǀ eté ǀ váyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ paptuḥ ǀ raghu-yā́ ǀ pári-jman ǁ

Sukta 28.translation: “TheĀditya, the upholder, has created all this water; the rivers flow by the power ofVaruṇa; they never weary, they never stop; they have descended with swiftness, like birds upon the circumambient (earth).”
Sukta 28.sanskrit_wisdomlib: प्र सी॑मादि॒त्यो अ॑सृजद्विध॒र्ताँ ऋ॒तं सिन्ध॑वो॒ वरु॑णस्य यन्ति । न श्रा॑म्यन्ति॒ न वि मु॑चन्त्ये॒ते वयो॒ न प॑प्तू रघु॒या परि॑ज्मन्

devanagari.text: वि मच्छ्रथाय रशनामिवाग ऋध्याम ते वरुण खामृतस्य ।मा तंतुश्छेदि वयतो धियं मे मा मात्रा शार्यपसः पुर ऋतोः ॥
वि । मत् । श्रथय । रशनाम्ऽइव । आगः । ऋध्याम । ते । वरुण । खाम् । ऋतस्य ।मा । तन्तुः । छेदि । वयतः । धियम् । मे । मा । मात्रा । शारि । अपसः । पुरा । ऋतोः ॥

transliteration.text: ví ǀ mát ǀ śrathaya ǀ raśanā́m-iva ǀ ā́gaḥ ǀ ṛdhyā́ma ǀ te ǀ varuṇa ǀ khā́m ǀ ṛtásya ǀmā́ ǀ tántuḥ ǀ chedi ǀ váyataḥ ǀ dhíyam ǀ me ǀ mā́ ǀ mā́trā ǀ śāri ǀ apásaḥ ǀ purā́ ǀ ṛtóḥ ǁ

Sukta 28.translation: “Cast off from me sin,Varuṇa, as if it were a rope; may we obtain from you a channel (filled) with water; cut not the thread of me (engaged in) weaving pious works; blight not the elements of holy rites before the season (of their maturity).”
Sukta 28.sanskrit_wisdomlib: वि मच्छ्र॑थाय रश॒नामि॒वाग॑ ऋ॒ध्याम॑ ते वरुण॒ खामृ॒तस्य॑ । मा तन्तु॑श्छेदि॒ वय॑तो॒ धियं॑ मे॒ मा मात्रा॑ शार्य॒पस॑: पु॒र ऋ॒तोः

devanagari.text: अपो सु म्यक्ष वरुण भियसं मत्सम्राळृतावोऽनु मा गृभाय ।दामेव वत्साद्वि मुमुग्ध्यंहो नहि त्वदारे निमिषश्चनेशे ॥
अपो इति । सु । म्यक्ष । वरुण । भियसम् । मत् । सम्ऽराट् । ऋतऽवः । अनु । मा । गृभाय ।दामऽइव । वत्सात् । वि । मुमुग्धि । अंहः । नहि । त्वत् । आरे । निऽमिषः । चन । ईशे ॥

transliteration.text: ápo íti ǀ sú ǀ myakṣa ǀ varuṇa ǀ bhiyásam ǀ mát ǀ sám-rāṭ ǀ ṛ́ta-vaḥ ǀ ánu ǀ mā ǀ gṛbhāya ǀdā́ma-iva ǀ vatsā́t ǀ ví ǀ mumugdhi ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ nahí ǀ tvát ǀ āré ǀ ni-míṣaḥ ǀ caná ǀ ī́śe ǁ

Sukta 28.translation: “Keep off all danger from me,Varuṇa; supreme monarch, endowed with truth, bestow your favour upon me; cast off (from me) sin, like a tether from a calf; no one rules for the twinkling of an eye, apart from you.”
Sukta 28.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अपो॒ सु म्य॑क्ष वरुण भि॒यसं॒ मत्सम्रा॒ळृता॒वोऽनु॑ मा गृभाय । दामे॑व व॒त्साद्वि मु॑मु॒ग्ध्यंहो॑ न॒हि त्वदा॒रे नि॒मिष॑श्च॒नेशे॑

devanagari.text: मा नो वधैर्वरुण ये त इष्टावेनः कृण्वंतमसुर भ्रीणंति ।मा ज्योतिषः प्रवसथानि गन्म वि षू मृधः शिश्रथो जीवसे नः ॥
मा । नः । वधैः । वरुण । ये । ते । इष्टौ । एनः । कृण्वन्तम् । असुर । भ्रीणन्ति ।मा । ज्योतिषः । प्रऽवसथानि । गन्म । वि । सु । मृधः । शिश्रथः । जीवसे । नः ॥

transliteration.text: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ vadháiḥ ǀ varuṇa ǀ yé ǀ te ǀ iṣṭáu ǀ énaḥ ǀ kṛṇvántam ǀ asura ǀ bhrīṇánti ǀmā́ ǀ jyótiṣaḥ ǀ pra-vasathā́ni ǀ ganma ǀ ví ǀ sú ǀ mṛ́dhaḥ ǀ śiśrathaḥ ǀ jīváse ǀ naḥ ǁ

Sukta 28.translation: “Harm us not,Varuṇa, with those destructive (weapons), repeller (of foes), demolish him who does evil at your sacrifice; let us not depart (before our time) from the regions of light; scatter the malevolent, that we may live.”
Sukta 28.sanskrit_wisdomlib: मा नो॑ व॒धैर्व॑रुण॒ ये त॑ इ॒ष्टावेन॑: कृ॒ण्वन्त॑मसुर भ्री॒णन्ति॑ । मा ज्योति॑षः प्रवस॒थानि॑ गन्म॒ वि षू मृध॑: शिश्रथो जी॒वसे॑ नः

devanagari.text: नमः पुरा ते वरुणोत नूनमुतापरं तुविजात ब्रवाम ।त्वे हि कं पर्वते न श्रितान्यप्रच्युतानि दूळभ व्रतानि ॥
नमः । पुरा । ते । वरुण । उत । नूनम् । उत । अपरम् । तुविऽजात । ब्रवाम ।त्वे इति । हि । कम् । पर्वते । न । श्रितानि । अप्रऽच्युतानि । दुःऽदभ । व्रतानि ॥

transliteration.text: námaḥ ǀ purā́ ǀ te ǀ varuṇa ǀ utá ǀ nūnám ǀ utá ǀ aparám ǀ tuvi-jāta ǀ bravāma ǀtvé íti ǀ hí ǀ kam ǀ párvate ǀ ná ǀ śritā́ni ǀ ápra-cyutāni ǀ duḥ-dabha ǀ vratā́ni ǁ

Sukta 28.translation: “As we have offered adoration to you,Varuṇa, of old, in like manner as we offer it now, so may we offer it in future (to you), who are everywhere present; for in you, who are difficult of attainment, as in an (immoveable) mountain, all holy acts are assembled, and are not to be dissevered.”
Sukta 28.sanskrit_wisdomlib: नम॑: पु॒रा ते॑ वरुणो॒त नू॒नमु॒ताप॒रं तु॑विजात ब्रवाम । त्वे हि कं॒ पर्व॑ते॒ न श्रि॒तान्यप्र॑च्युतानि दूळभ व्र॒तानि॑

devanagari.text: पर ऋणा सावीरध मत्कृतानि माहं राजन्नन्यकृतेन भोजं ।अव्युष्टा इन्नु भूयसीरुषास आ नो जीवान्वरुण तासु शाधि ॥
परा । ऋणा । सावीः । अध । मत्ऽकृतानि । मा । अहम् । राजन् । अन्यऽकृतेन । भोजम् ।अविऽउष्टाः । इत् । नु । भूयसीः । उषसः । आ । नः । जीवान् । वरुण । तासु । शाधि ॥

transliteration.text: párā ǀ ṛṇā́ ǀ sāvīḥ ǀ ádha ǀ mát-kṛtāni ǀ mā́ ǀ ahám ǀ rājan ǀ anyá-kṛtena ǀ bhojam ǀávi-uṣṭāḥ ǀ ít ǀ nú ǀ bhū́yasīḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ jīvā́n ǀ varuṇa ǀ tā́su ǀ śādhi ǁ

Sukta 28.translation: “Discharge,Varuṇa, the debts (contracted), by my progenitors, and those now (contracted) by me; and may I not, royal Varuṇa, be dependent (on the debts contracted) by another; many are the mornings that have, as it were, indeed not dawned; make us, Varuṇa, alive in them.”
Sukta 28.sanskrit_wisdomlib: पर॑ ऋ॒णा सा॑वी॒रध॒ मत्कृ॑तानि॒ माहं रा॑जन्न॒न्यकृ॑तेन भोजम् । अव्यु॑ष्टा॒ इन्नु भूय॑सीरु॒षास॒ आ नो॑ जी॒वान्व॑रुण॒ तासु॑ शाधि

transliteration.text: ūrdhváḥ ǀ hí ǀ ásthāt ǀ ádhi ǀ antárikṣe ǀ ádha ǀ vṛtrā́ya ǀ prá ǀ vadhám ǀ jabhāra ǀmíham ǀ vásānaḥ ǀ úpa ǀ hí ǀ īm ǀ ádudrot ǀ tigmá-āyudhaḥ ǀ ajayat ǀ śátrum ǀ índraḥ ǁ

Sukta 30.translation: “Inasmuch as he had soared aloft above the firmamentIndrahurled againstVṛtrahis destructive (thunderbolt); enveloped in a cloud, he rushed upon Indra, but the wielder of the sharp-edged weapon triumphed over his foe.”
Sukta 30.sanskrit_wisdomlib: ऊ॒र्ध्वो ह्यस्था॒दध्य॒न्तरि॒क्षेऽधा॑ वृ॒त्राय॒ प्र व॒धं ज॑भार । मिहं॒ वसा॑न॒ उप॒ हीमदु॑द्रोत्ति॒ग्मायु॑धो अजय॒च्छत्रु॒मिन्द्र॑:

devanagari.text: बृहस्पते तपुषाश्नेव विध्य वृकद्वरसो असुरस्य वीरान् ।यथा जघंथ धृषता पुरा चिदेवा जहि शत्रुमस्माकमिंद्र ॥
बृहस्पते । तपुषा । अश्नाऽइव । विध्य । वृकऽद्वरसः । असुरस्य । वीरान् ।यथा । जघन्थ । धृषता । पुरा । चित् । एव । जहि । शत्रुम् । अस्माकम् । इन्द्र ॥

transliteration.text: bṛ́haspate ǀ tápuṣā ǀ áśnā-iva ǀ vidhya ǀ vṛ́ka-dvarasaḥ ǀ ásurasya ǀ vīrā́n ǀyáthā ǀ jaghántha ǀ dhṛṣatā́ ǀ purā́ ǀ cit ǀ evá ǀ jahi ǀ śátrum ǀ asmā́kam ǀ indra ǁ

Sukta 30.translation: “Pierce,Bṛhaspati, with a radiant shaft,  as with a thunderbolt, the sons of theasuraguarding his gates; in like manner as you did formerly slayVṛtraby your own prowess, so do you now destroy our enemy.”
Sukta 30.sanskrit_wisdomlib: बृह॑स्पते॒ तपु॒षाश्ने॑व विध्य॒ वृक॑द्वरसो॒ असु॑रस्य वी॒रान् । यथा॑ ज॒घन्थ॑ धृष॒ता पु॒रा चि॑दे॒वा ज॑हि॒ शत्रु॑म॒स्माक॑मिन्द्र

devanagari.text: अव क्षिप दिवो अश्मानमुच्चा येन शत्रुं मंदसानो निजूर्वाः ।तोकस्य सातौ तनयस्य भूरेरस्माँ अर्धं कृणुतादिंद्र गोनां ॥
अव । क्षिप । दिवः । अश्मानम् । उच्चा । येन । शत्रुम् । मन्दसानः । निऽजूर्वाः ।तोकस्य । सातौ । तनयस्य । भूरेः । अस्मान् । अर्धम् । कृणुतात् । इन्द्र । गोनाम् ॥

transliteration.text: áva ǀ kṣipa ǀ diváḥ ǀ áśmānam ǀ uccā́ ǀ yéna ǀ śátrum ǀ mandasānáḥ ǀ ni-jū́rvāḥ ǀtokásya ǀ sātáu ǀ tánayasya ǀ bhū́reḥ ǀ asmā́n ǀ ardhám ǀ kṛṇutāt ǀ indra ǀ gónām ǁ

Sukta 30.translation: “Do you, who are on high, cast down fromheaven the adamantine (thunderbolt), wherewith, when exhilarated, you did slay your foe; and make us affluent in the possession of many sons, and grandsons, and cattle.”
Sukta 30.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अव॑ क्षिप दि॒वो अश्मा॑नमु॒च्चा येन॒ शत्रुं॑ मन्दसा॒नो नि॒जूर्वा॑: । तो॒कस्य॑ सा॒तौ तन॑यस्य॒ भूरे॑र॒स्माँ अ॒र्धं कृ॑णुतादिन्द्र॒ गोना॑म्

devanagari.text: प्र हि क्रतुं वृहथो यं वनुथो रध्रस्य स्थो यजमानस्य चोदौ ।इंद्रासोमा युवमस्माँ अविष्टमस्मिन्भयस्थे कृणुतमु लोकं ॥

transliteration.text: prá ǀ hí ǀ krátum ǀ vṛháthaḥ ǀ yám ǀ vanutháḥ ǀ radhrásya ǀ sthaḥ ǀ yájamānasya ǀ codáu ǀíndrāsomā ǀ yuvám ǀ asmā́n ǀ aviṣṭam ǀ asmín ǀ bhayá-sthe ǀ kṛṇutam ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ lokám ǁ

Sukta 30.translation: “IndraandSoma, eradicate the worker (of evil), whom you hate; be the encouragers of the liberal instrumental tutor of the rite; protect us in this plural ce of peril, and make the world (free from fear).”
Sukta 30.sanskrit_wisdomlib: प्र हि क्रतुं॑ वृ॒हथो॒ यं व॑नु॒थो र॒ध्रस्य॑ स्थो॒ यज॑मानस्य चो॒दौ । इन्द्रा॑सोमा यु॒वम॒स्माँ अ॑विष्टम॒स्मिन्भ॒यस्थे॑ कृणुतमु लो॒कम्

devanagari.text: न मा तमन्न श्रमन्नोत तंद्रन्न वोचाम मा सुनोतेति सोमं ।यो मे पृणाद्यो ददद्यो निबोधाद्यो मा सुन्वंतमुप गोभिरायत् ॥
न । मा । तमत् । न । श्रमत् । न । उत । तन्द्रत् । न । वोचाम । मा । सुनोत । इति । सोमम् ।यः । मे । पृणात् । यः । ददत् । यः । निऽबोधात् । यः । मा । सुन्वन्तम् । उप । गोभिः । आ । अयत् ॥

transliteration.text: ná ǀ mā ǀ tamat ǀ ná ǀ śramat ǀ ná ǀ utá ǀ tandrat ǀ ná ǀ vocāma ǀ mā́ ǀ sunota ǀ íti ǀ sómam ǀyáḥ ǀ me ǀ pṛṇā́t ǀ yáḥ ǀ dádat ǀ yáḥ ǀ ni-bódhāt ǀ yáḥ ǀ mā ǀ sunvántam ǀ úpa ǀ góbhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ áyat ǁ

Sukta 30.translation: “Let notIndravexme, or weary me, or make me slothful; never may we say (to another), do not offer theSoma; (for it is Indra) who will fulfil (my wishes), who will give (me riches), who will hear (my prayers), who will reward me, presenting libations, with cattle.”
Sukta 30.sanskrit_wisdomlib: न मा॑ तम॒न्न श्र॑म॒न्नोत त॑न्द्र॒न्न वो॑चाम॒ मा सु॑नो॒तेति॒ सोम॑म् । यो मे॑ पृ॒णाद्यो दद॒द्यो नि॒बोधा॒द्यो मा॑ सु॒न्वन्त॒मुप॒ गोभि॒राय॑त्

devanagari.text: सरस्वति त्वमस्माँ अविड्ढि मरुत्वती धृषती जेषि शत्रून् ।त्यं चिच्छर्धंतं तविषीयमाणमिंद्रो हंति वृषभं शंडिकानां ॥
सरस्वति । त्वम् । अस्मान् । अविड्ढि । मरुत्वती । धृषती । जेषि । शत्रून् ।त्यम् । चित् । शर्धन्तम् । तविषीऽयमाणम् । इन्द्रः । हन्ति । वृषभम् । शण्डिकानाम् ॥

transliteration.text: sárasvati ǀ tvám ǀ asmā́n ǀ aviḍḍhi ǀ marútvatī ǀ dhṛṣatī́ ǀ jeṣi ǀ śátrūn ǀtyám ǀ cit ǀ śárdhantam ǀ taviṣī-yámāṇam ǀ índraḥ ǀ hanti ǀ vṛṣabhám ǀ śáṇḍikānām ǁ

Sukta 30.translation: “Sarasvatī, do you protect us; associated with theMarutsand firm (of purpose), overcome our foes, whiilstIndraslays the chief of the Śaṇḍikas, defying him and confiding in his strength.”
Sukta 30.sanskrit_wisdomlib: सर॑स्वति॒ त्वम॒स्माँ अ॑विड्ढि म॒रुत्व॑ती धृष॒ती जे॑षि॒ शत्रू॑न् । त्यं चि॒च्छर्ध॑न्तं तविषी॒यमा॑ण॒मिन्द्रो॑ हन्ति वृष॒भं शण्डि॑कानाम्

devanagari.text: यो नः सनुत्य उत वा जिघत्नुरभिख्याय तं तिगितेन विध्य ।बृहस्पत आयुधैर्जेषि शत्रूंद्रुहे रीषंतं परि धेहि राजन् ॥
यः । नः । सनुत्यः । उत । वा । जिघत्नुः । अभिऽख्याय । तम् । तिगितेन । विध्य ।बृहस्पते । आयुधैः । जेषि । शत्रून् । द्रुहे । रिषन्तम् । परि । धेहि । राजन् ॥

transliteration.text: yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ sánutyaḥ ǀ utá ǀ vā ǀ jighatnúḥ ǀ abhi-khyā́ya ǀ tám ǀ tigiténa ǀ vidhya ǀbṛ́haspate ǀ ā́yudhaiḥ ǀ jeṣi ǀ śátrūn ǀ druhé ǀ ríṣantam ǀ pári ǀ dhehi ǀ rājan ǁ

Sukta 30.translation: “Detecting him who is lying in ambush (against us), who is purposing our death, pierce him,Bṛhaspati, with your sharp (thunderbolt), and overthrow (our) enemies with (your) weapons; hurl, monarch, your destroying (shaft) against the oppressor.”
Sukta 30.sanskrit_wisdomlib: यो न॒: सनु॑त्य उ॒त वा॑ जिघ॒त्नुर॑भि॒ख्याय॒ तं ति॑गि॒तेन॑ विध्य । बृह॑स्पत॒ आयु॑धैर्जेषि॒ शत्रू॑न्द्रु॒हे रीष॑न्तं॒ परि॑ धेहि राजन्

devanagari.text: अस्माकेभिः सत्वभिः शूर शूरैर्वीर्या कृधि यानि ते कर्त्वानि ।ज्योगभूवन्ननुधूपितासो हत्वी तेषामा भरा नो वसूनि ॥
अस्माकेभिः । सत्वऽभिः । शूर । शूरैः । वीर्या । कृधि । यानि । ते । कर्त्वानि ।ज्योक् । अभूवन् । अनुऽधूपितासः । हत्वी । तेषाम् । आ । भर । नः । वसूनि ॥

transliteration.text: asmā́kebhiḥ ǀ sátva-bhiḥ ǀ śūra ǀ śū́raiḥ ǀ vīryā́ ǀ kṛdhi ǀ yā́ni ǀ te ǀ kártvāni ǀjyók ǀ abhūvan ǀ ánu-dhūpitāsaḥ ǀ hatvī́ ǀ téṣām ǀ ā́ ǀ bhara ǀ naḥ ǀ vásūni ǁ

Sukta 30.translation: “Achieve, hero, along with our valiant heroes, the exploits that are to be achieved by you; long have (our enemies) been inflated (with pride); slay them, and bring to us their treasures.”
Sukta 30.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒स्माके॑भि॒: सत्व॑भिः शूर॒ शूरै॑र्वी॒र्या॑ कृधि॒ यानि॑ ते॒ कर्त्वा॑नि । ज्योग॑भूव॒न्ननु॑धूपितासो ह॒त्वी तेषा॒मा भ॑रा नो॒ वसू॑नि

devanagari.text: तं वः शर्धं मारुतं सुम्नयुर्गिरोप ब्रुवे नमसा दैव्यं जनं ।यथा रयिं सर्ववीरं नशामहा अपत्यसाचं श्रुत्यं दिवेदिवे ॥

transliteration.text: tám ǀ vaḥ ǀ śárdham ǀ mā́rutam ǀ sumna-yúḥ ǀ girā́ ǀ úpa ǀ bruve ǀ námasā ǀ dáivyam ǀ jánam ǀyáthā ǀ rayím ǀ sárva-vīram ǀ náśāmahai ǀ apatya-sā́cam ǀ śrútyam ǀ divé-dive ǁ

Sukta 30.translation: “Desirous of felicity,Maruts, I glorify with praise and homage you divine, manifest and congregated strength; that we may thereby daily enjoy distinguished affluence, accompanied by valiant dependants and posterity.”
Sukta 30.sanskrit_wisdomlib: तं व॒: शर्धं॒ मारु॑तं सुम्न॒युर्गि॒रोप॑ ब्रुवे॒ नम॑सा॒ दैव्यं॒ जन॑म् । यथा॑ र॒यिं सर्व॑वीरं॒ नशा॑महा अपत्य॒साचं॒ श्रुत्यं॑ दि॒वेदि॑वे

devanagari.text: अस्माकं मित्रावरुणावतं रथमादित्यै रुद्रैर्वसुभिः सचाभुवा ।प्र यद्वयो न पप्तन्वस्मनस्परि श्रवस्यवो हृषीवंतो वनर्षदः ॥
अस्माकम् । मित्रावरुणा । अवतम् । रथम् । आदित्यैः । रुद्रैः । वसुऽभिः । सचाऽभुवा ।प्र । यत् । वयः । न । पप्तन् । वस्मनः । परि । श्रवस्यवः । हृषीऽवन्तः । वनऽसदः ॥

transliteration.text: asmā́kam ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ avatam ǀ rátham ǀ ādityáiḥ ǀ rudráiḥ ǀ vásu-bhiḥ ǀ sacā-bhúvā ǀprá ǀ yát ǀ váyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ páptan ǀ vásmanaḥ ǀ pári ǀ śravasyávaḥ ǀ hṛ́ṣī-vantaḥ ǀ vana-sádaḥ ǁ

Sukta 31.translation: “MitraandVaruṇa, associated with theĀdityas, theRudrasand theVasus, protect our (sacrificial) chariot, when (it goes) about (from one plural ce to another); like birds that fly down, seeking for food, rejoicing, and resting in the woods.”
Sukta 31.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒स्माकं॑ मित्रावरुणावतं॒ रथ॑मादि॒त्यै रु॒द्रैर्वसु॑भिः सचा॒भुवा॑ । प्र यद्वयो॒ न पप्त॒न्वस्म॑न॒स्परि॑ श्रव॒स्यवो॒ हृषी॑वन्तो वन॒र्षद॑:

devanagari.text: अध स्मा न उदवता सजोषसो रथं देवासो अभि विक्षु वाजयुं ।यदाशवः पद्याभिस्तित्रतो रजः पृथिव्याः सानौ जंघनंत पाणिभिः ॥
अध । स्म । नः । उत् । अवत । सऽजोषसः । रथम् । देवासः । अभि । विक्षु । वाजऽयुम् ।यत् । आशवः । पद्याभिः । तित्रतः । रजः । पृथिव्याः । सानौ । जङ्घनन्त । पाणिऽभिः ॥

transliteration.text: ádha ǀ sma ǀ naḥ ǀ út ǀ avata ǀ sa-joṣasaḥ ǀ rátham ǀ devāsaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ vikṣú ǀ vāja-yúm ǀyát ǀ āśávaḥ ǀ pádyābhiḥ ǀ títrataḥ ǀ rájaḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ sā́nau ǀ jáṅghananta ǀ pāṇí-bhiḥ ǁ

Sukta 31.translation: “Propitiated divinities, protect our chariot, gone forth in quest of food among the people, when the quick (horses), raising the dust with their paces, trample with their feet upon the high plural ces of the earth.”
Sukta 31.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अध॑ स्मा न॒ उद॑वता सजोषसो॒ रथं॑ देवासो अ॒भि वि॒क्षु वा॑ज॒युम् । यदा॒शव॒: पद्या॑भि॒स्तित्र॑तो॒ रज॑: पृथि॒व्याः सानौ॒ जङ्घ॑नन्त पा॒णिभि॑:

devanagari.text: उत स्य न इंद्रो विश्वचर्षणिर्दिवः शर्धेन मारुतेन सुक्रतुः ।अनु नु स्थात्यवृकाभिरूतिभी रथं महे सनये वाजसातये ॥

Sukta 31.translation: “Or, may that all beholdingIndra, the accomplisher of great deeds, by the collective vigour of theMaruts, (coming) from heaven, protect our chariot with unassailable protection, (for the sake of securing to us) ample wealth and abundant food.”
Sukta 31.sanskrit_wisdomlib: उ॒त स्य न॒ इन्द्रो॑ वि॒श्वच॑र्षणिर्दि॒वः शर्धे॑न॒ मारु॑तेन सु॒क्रतु॑: । अनु॒ नु स्था॑त्यवृ॒काभि॑रू॒तिभी॒ रथं॑ म॒हे स॒नये॒ वाज॑सातये

devanagari.text: उत स्य देवो भुवनस्य सक्षणिस्त्वष्टा ग्नाभिः सजोषा जूजुवद्रथं ।इळा भगो बृहद्दिवोत रोदसी पूषा पुरंधिरश्विनावधा पती ॥

Sukta 31.translation: “Or, may the divineTvaṣṭā, the defender of the world, together with the wives (of the gods), well plural ased, urge on the chariot; or may Iḷā, the resplendentBhaga, Heaven and Earth, the sagaciousPūṣan, and theAśvins, the two husbands (ofSūryā), urge on the chariot.”
Sukta 31.sanskrit_wisdomlib: उ॒त स्य दे॒वो भुव॑नस्य स॒क्षणि॒स्त्वष्टा॒ ग्नाभि॑: स॒जोषा॑ जूजुव॒द्रथ॑म् । इळा॒ भगो॑ बृहद्दि॒वोत रोद॑सी पू॒षा पुरं॑धिर॒श्विना॒वधा॒ पती॑

Sukta 31.translation: “Or, may the two divine auspicious and mutually contemplating Day and Night, the animators of moving (creatures, urge it on); and, Earth and Heaven, whilst I praise you both with a new hymn, I offer you food of the standing (corn), although provided with the three (sorts of sacrificial) viands.”
Sukta 31.sanskrit_wisdomlib: उ॒त त्ये दे॒वी सु॒भगे॑ मिथू॒दृशो॒षासा॒नक्ता॒ जग॑तामपी॒जुवा॑ । स्तु॒षे यद्वां॑ पृथिवि॒ नव्य॑सा॒ वच॑: स्था॒तुश्च॒ वय॒स्त्रिव॑या उप॒स्तिरे॑

devanagari.text: उत वः शंसमुशिजामिव श्मस्यहिर्बुध्न्योऽज एकपादुत ।त्रित ऋभुक्षाः सविता चनो दधेऽपां नपादाशुहेमा धिया शमि ॥

Sukta 31.translation: “We desire, gods, to repeat the praise of you, who are propitiated by praise; mayAhirbudhnya, Aja ekapād,Trita,Ṛbhukṣin,Savitā, bestow upon us food, and may the swift-moving grandson of the waters, (Agni, be gratified by) our praises and our worship.”
Sukta 31.sanskrit_wisdomlib: उ॒त व॒: शंस॑मु॒शिजा॑मिव श्म॒स्यहि॑र्बु॒ध्न्यो॒३॒॑ऽज एक॑पादु॒त । त्रि॒त ऋ॑भु॒क्षाः स॑वि॒ता चनो॑ दधे॒ऽपां नपा॑दाशु॒हेमा॑ धि॒या शमि॑

devanagari.text: एता वो वश्म्युद्यता यजत्रा अतक्षन्नायवो नव्यसे सं ।श्रवस्यवो वाजं चकानाः सप्तिर्न रथ्यो अह धीतिमश्याः ॥

Sukta 31.translation: “Adorable (gods), I desire that these (my) earnest praises (should plural ase) you; men wishing for food, desirous of vigour, have constructed (hymns) for your celebration; may you hasten like a (swift) chariot-horse to our (pious) rite].”
Sukta 31.sanskrit_wisdomlib: ए॒ता वो॑ व॒श्म्युद्य॑ता यजत्रा॒ अत॑क्षन्ना॒यवो॒ नव्य॑से॒ सम् । श्र॒व॒स्यवो॒ वाजं॑ चका॒नाः सप्ति॒र्न रथ्यो॒ अह॑ धी॒तिम॑श्याः

Sukta 32.translation: “Heaven and Earth, be the protectors of me your worshipper, anxious to propitiate you by worship and adoration, for of you two is abundant food; desiring riches, I glorify you both and celebrate you with great (laudation).”
Sukta 32.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒स्य मे॑ द्यावापृथिवी ऋताय॒तो भू॒तम॑वि॒त्री वच॑स॒: सिषा॑सतः । ययो॒रायु॑: प्रत॒रं ते इ॒दं पु॒र उप॑स्तुते वसू॒युर्वां॑ म॒हो द॑धे

Sukta 32.translation: “Let not the secret guile of man, (Indra), harm us by day (or night); leave us not subject to the malevolent, disunite us not from your frienship; regard us with the favourable thoughts that (spring) from it; we ask this (boon) of you.”
Sukta 32.sanskrit_wisdomlib: मा नो॒ गुह्या॒ रिप॑ आ॒योरह॑न्दभ॒न्मा न॑ आ॒भ्यो री॑रधो दु॒च्छुना॑भ्यः । मा नो॒ वि यौ॑: स॒ख्या वि॒द्धि तस्य॑ नः सुम्नाय॒ता मन॑सा॒ तत्त्वे॑महे

Sukta 32.translation: “Bring to us, with benignant mind, the well-nourished and compactly-limbed cow, yielding milk, and conferring happiness; daily I glorify you, who are adored by many, quick in (your) steps, and rapid in (your) words.”
Sukta 32.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अहे॑ळता॒ मन॑सा श्रु॒ष्टिमा व॑ह॒ दुहा॑नां धे॒नुं पि॒प्युषी॑मस॒श्चत॑म् । पद्या॑भिरा॒शुं वच॑सा च वा॒जिनं॒ त्वां हि॑नोमि पुरुहूत वि॒श्वहा॑

Sukta 32.translation: “I invoke, with suitable praise,Rākā, who is worthily invoked; may she, who is auspicious of good fortune, hear us, and spontaneously understand (our purpose); may she sew her work with an infallible needle; may she grant us excellent and opulent descendants.”
Sukta 32.sanskrit_wisdomlib: रा॒काम॒हं सु॒हवां॑ सुष्टु॒ती हु॑वे शृ॒णोतु॑ नः सु॒भगा॒ बोध॑तु॒ त्मना॑ । सीव्य॒त्वप॑: सू॒च्याच्छि॑द्यमानया॒ ददा॑तु वी॒रं श॒तदा॑यमु॒क्थ्य॑म्

Sukta 32.translation: “Rākā, with those your kind and gracious intentions, wherewith you grant riches to the donor (of oblations), approach us today; you who are auspicious of good fortune, favourably inclined, and bestowing a thousand blessings.”
Sukta 32.sanskrit_wisdomlib: यास्ते॑ राके सुम॒तय॑: सु॒पेश॑सो॒ याभि॒र्ददा॑सि दा॒शुषे॒ वसू॑नि । ताभि॑र्नो अ॒द्य सु॒मना॑ उ॒पाग॑हि सहस्रपो॒षं सु॑भगे॒ ररा॑णा

Sukta 33.translation: “Worthy (of reverence), you bear arrows and a bow; worthy (of praise), you wear an adorable and omniform necklace; worthy (of adoration), you preseve all this vast universe; there is no one more powerful than you.”

transliteration.text: stuhí ǀ śrutám ǀ garta-sádam ǀ yúvānam ǀ mṛgám ǀ ná ǀ bhīmám ǀ upa-hatnúm ǀ ugrám ǀmṛḷá ǀ jaritré ǀ rudra ǀ stávānaḥ ǀ anyám ǀ te ǀ asmát ǀ ní ǀ vapantu ǀ sénāḥ ǁ

Sukta 33.translation: “Glorify the renownedRudra, riding in his car, ever youthful, destructive, fierce like a formidable wild beast; Rudra, propitiated by praise, grant happiness to him who praises (you), and let your hosts destroy him who is our adversary.”
Sukta 33.sanskrit_wisdomlib: स्तु॒हि श्रु॒तं ग॑र्त॒सदं॒ युवा॑नं मृ॒गं न भी॒ममु॑पह॒त्नुमु॒ग्रम् । मृ॒ळा ज॑रि॒त्रे रु॑द्र॒ स्तवा॑नो॒ऽन्यं ते॑ अ॒स्मन्नि व॑पन्तु॒ सेना॑:

devanagari.text: कुमारश्चित्पितरं वंदमानं प्रति नानाम रुद्रोपयंतं ।भूरेर्दातारं सत्पतिं गृणीषे स्तुतस्त्वं भेषजा रास्यस्मे ॥

transliteration.text: kumāráḥ ǀ cit ǀ pitáram ǀ vándamānam ǀ práti ǀ nanāma ǀ rudra ǀ upa-yántam ǀbhū́reḥ ǀ dātā́ram ǀ sát-patim ǀ gṛṇīṣe ǀ stutáḥ ǀ tvám ǀ bheṣajā́ ǀ rāsi ǀ asmé íti ǁ

Sukta 33.translation: “I bow,Rudra, to you, approaching (our rite), as a boy to his father when pronouncing a blessing upon him; I glorify you, the giver of much (wealth), the protector of the virtuous; do you, thus glorified, bestow healing herbs upon me.”
Sukta 33.sanskrit_wisdomlib: कु॒मा॒रश्चि॑त्पि॒तरं॒ वन्द॑मानं॒ प्रति॑ नानाम रुद्रोप॒यन्त॑म् । भूरे॑र्दा॒तारं॒ सत्प॑तिं गृणीषे स्तु॒तस्त्वं भे॑ष॒जा रा॑स्य॒स्मे

Sukta 33.translation: “Maruts, I solicit of you those medicaments which are pure; those, showerers (of benefits), which give great plural asure; those which fonfer felicity; those which (our) sire,Manu, selected; and those (medicaments) ofRudrawhich are the alleviation (of disease), and defence (against danger).”
Sukta 33.sanskrit_wisdomlib: या वो॑ भेष॒जा म॑रुत॒: शुची॑नि॒ या शंत॑मा वृषणो॒ या म॑यो॒भु । यानि॒ मनु॒रवृ॑णीता पि॒ता न॒स्ता शं च॒ योश्च॑ रु॒द्रस्य॑ वश्मि

devanagari.text: परि णो हेती रुद्रस्य वृज्याः परि त्वेषस्य दुर्मतिर्मही गात् ।अव स्थिरा मघवद्भ्यस्तनुष्व मीढ्वस्तोकाय तनयाय मृळ ॥

Sukta 33.translation: “May the javelin ofRudraavoid us; may the great displeasure of the radiant deity pass away (from us); showerer of benefits, turn away your strong (bow) from the wealthy (offerers of oblations), and bestow happiness upon (our) sons and grandsons.”
Sukta 33.sanskrit_wisdomlib: परि॑ णो हे॒ती रु॒द्रस्य॑ वृज्या॒: परि॑ त्वे॒षस्य॑ दुर्म॒तिर्म॒ही गा॑त् । अव॑ स्थि॒रा म॒घव॑द्भ्यस्तनुष्व॒ मीढ्व॑स्तो॒काय॒ तन॑याय मृळ

transliteration.text: evá ǀ babhro íti ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ cekitāna ǀ yáthā ǀ deva ǀ ná ǀ hṛṇīṣé ǀ ná ǀ háṃsi ǀhavana-śrút ǀ naḥ ǀ rudra ǀ ihá ǀ bodhi ǀ bṛhát ǀ vadema ǀ vidáthe ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ

Sukta 33.translation: “Cherisher of the world, showerer (of benefits), omniscient and divine (Rudra), hearer of our invocation, so consider us on this occasion, that you may not be irate, nor slay us; but that, blessed with excellent descendants, we may worthily glorify you at this sacrifice.”
Sukta 33.sanskrit_wisdomlib: ए॒वा ब॑भ्रो वृषभ चेकितान॒ यथा॑ देव॒ न हृ॑णी॒षे न हंसि॑ । ह॒व॒न॒श्रुन्नो॑ रुद्रे॒ह बो॑धि बृ॒हद्व॑देम वि॒दथे॑ सु॒वीरा॑:

devanagari.text: धारावरा मरुतो धृष्ण्वोजसो मृगा न भीमास्तविषीभिरर्चिनः ।अग्नयो न शुशुचाना ऋजीषिणो भृमिं धमंतो अप गा अवृण्वत ॥

transliteration.text: dhārāvarā́ḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ dhṛṣṇú-ojasaḥ ǀ mṛgā́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ bhīmā́ḥ ǀ táviṣībhiḥ ǀ arcínaḥ ǀagnáyaḥ ǀ ná ǀ śuśucānā́ḥ ǀ ṛjīṣíṇaḥ ǀ bhṛ́mim ǀ dhámantaḥ ǀ ápa ǀ gā́ḥ ǀ avṛṇvata ǁ

Sukta 34.translation: “TheMaruts, shedders of showers, endowed with resistless might, like formidable lions, reverencing (the world) by their energies, resplendent as fires, laden with water, and blowing about the wandering cloud, give vent to its (collected) rain.”
Sukta 34.sanskrit_wisdomlib: धा॒रा॒व॒रा म॒रुतो॑ धृ॒ष्ण्वो॑जसो मृ॒गा न भी॒मास्तवि॑षीभिर॒र्चिन॑: । अ॒ग्नयो॒ न शु॑शुचा॒ना ऋ॑जी॒षिणो॒ भृमिं॒ धम॑न्तो॒ अप॒ गा अ॑वृण्वत

Sukta 34.translation: “Since, golden-breastedMaruts, the vigorous (Rudra) begot you of the pure wombofPṛśnī, therefore they, the devourers (of their enemies), are conspicuous (by their ornaments), as the heavens are by the constellations; and, senders of rain, they are brilliant as the cloud-born (lightning).”
Sukta 34.sanskrit_wisdomlib: द्यावो॒ न स्तृभि॑श्चितयन्त खा॒दिनो॒ व्य१॒॑भ्रिया॒ न द्यु॑तयन्त वृ॒ष्टय॑: । रु॒द्रो यद्वो॑ मरुतो रुक्मवक्षसो॒ वृषाज॑नि॒ पृश्न्या॑: शु॒क्र ऊध॑नि

Sukta 34.translation: “They sprinkle the wide-extended (lands) with water, as (men sprinkle) horses (when heated) in battles; and they rush along with swift (horses) on the skirts of the sounding (cloud);Maruts, golden-helmeted, andof one mind, agitating (the trees), come with your spotted deer to (receive the sacrificial) food.”
Sukta 34.sanskrit_wisdomlib: उ॒क्षन्ते॒ अश्वाँ॒ अत्याँ॑ इवा॒जिषु॑ न॒दस्य॒ कर्णै॑स्तुरयन्त आ॒शुभि॑: । हिर॑ण्यशिप्रा मरुतो॒ दवि॑ध्वतः पृ॒क्षं या॑थ॒ पृष॑तीभिः समन्यवः

transliteration.text: pṛkṣé ǀ tā́ ǀ víśvā ǀ bhúvanā ǀ vavakṣire ǀ mitrā́ya ǀ vā ǀ sádam ǀ ā́ ǀ jīrá-dānavaḥ ǀpṛ́ṣat-aśvāsaḥ ǀ anavabhrá-rādhasaḥ ǀ ṛjipyā́saḥ ǀ ná ǀ vayúneṣu ǀ dhūḥ-sádaḥ ǁ

Sukta 34.translation: “The prompt-givingMarutsever confer upon the (offerer of sacrificial) food, as upon a friend, all these (world-supporting) waters; they who have spotted deer for steeds, who are possessed of inexhaustible riches, and who, seated in their chariots, (proceed) amongst the moving (clouds), like horses going straight (to the goal).”
Sukta 34.sanskrit_wisdomlib: पृ॒क्षे ता विश्वा॒ भुव॑ना ववक्षिरे मि॒त्राय॑ वा॒ सद॒मा जी॒रदा॑नवः । पृष॑दश्वासो अनव॒भ्ररा॑धस ऋजि॒प्यासो॒ न व॒युने॑षु धू॒र्षद॑:

transliteration.text: índhanva-bhiḥ ǀ dhenú-bhiḥ ǀ rapśádūdha-bhiḥ ǀ adhvasmá-bhiḥ ǀ pathí-bhiḥ ǀ bhrājat-ṛṣṭayaḥ ǀā́ ǀ haṃsā́saḥ ǀ ná ǀ svásarāṇi ǀ gantana ǀ mádhoḥ ǀ mádāya ǀ marutaḥ ǀ sa-manyavaḥ ǁ

Sukta 34.translation: “Maruts, who are of one mind, and are armed with shining lances, come with the bright, full-uddered kine, by obstructed paths, to partake of the exhilaration of the (Soma) juice, as swans (fly) to their nests.”
Sukta 34.sanskrit_wisdomlib: इन्ध॑न्वभिर्धे॒नुभी॑ र॒प्शदू॑धभिरध्व॒स्मभि॑: प॒थिभि॑र्भ्राजदृष्टयः । आ हं॒सासो॒ न स्वस॑राणि गन्तन॒ मधो॒र्मदा॑य मरुतः समन्यवः

आ । नः । ब्रह्माणि । मरुतः । सऽमन्यवः । नराम् । न । शंसः । सवनानि । गन्तन ।अश्वाम्ऽइव । पिप्यत । धेनुम् । ऊधनि । कर्ता । धियम् । जरित्रे । वाजऽपेशसम् ॥

transliteration.text: ā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ bráhmāṇi ǀ marutaḥ ǀ sa-manyavaḥ ǀ narā́m ǀ ná ǀ śáṃsaḥ ǀ sávanāni ǀ gantana ǀáśvām-iva ǀ pipyata ǀ dhenúm ǀ ū́dhani ǀ kártā ǀ dhíyam ǀ jaritré ǀ vā́ja-peśasam ǁ

Sukta 34.translation: “Maruts, who are of one mind, come to the food that is offered at (our) sacrifices, as (you come) to the praises of men; nourish the cow, (the cloud), so that it may be like a mare with a full udder, and render the pious rite productive of abundant food to the worshipper.”
Sukta 34.sanskrit_wisdomlib: आ नो॒ ब्रह्मा॑णि मरुतः समन्यवो न॒रां न शंस॒: सव॑नानि गन्तन । अश्वा॑मिव पिप्यत धे॒नुमूध॑नि॒ कर्ता॒ धियं॑ जरि॒त्रे वाज॑पेशसम्

devanagari.text: तं नो दात मरुतो वाजिनं रथ आपानं ब्रह्म चितयद्दिवेदिवे ।इषं स्तोतृभ्यो वृजनेषु कारवे सनिं मेधामरिष्टं दुष्टरं सहः ॥

Sukta 34.translation: “Bestow upon us,Maruts, that (son) who shall enjoy abundance, and who shall be repeating your appropriate praises day by day to (induce) your coming; give food to those who praise you; to him who glorifies you in battles; (grant him) liberality, intelligence, and unimpaired unsurpassable vigour.”
Sukta 34.sanskrit_wisdomlib: तं नो॑ दात मरुतो वा॒जिनं॒ रथ॑ आपा॒नं ब्रह्म॑ चि॒तय॑द्दि॒वेदि॑वे । इषं॑ स्तो॒तृभ्यो॑ वृ॒जने॑षु का॒रवे॑ स॒निं मे॒धामरि॑ष्टं दु॒ष्टरं॒ सह॑:

devanagari.text: यद्युंजते मरुतो रुक्मवक्षसोऽश्वान्रथेषु भग आ सुदानवः ।धेनुर्न शिश्वे स्वसरेषु पिन्वते जनाय रातहविषे महीमिषं ॥

Sukta 34.translation: “When the golden-breasted munificentMaruts, yoke their horses to their chariots on an auspicious (occasion), they shed in their peculiar (directions) abundant food upon him who offers them oblations, as a cow (gives milk) to her calf.”
Sukta 34.sanskrit_wisdomlib: यद्यु॒ञ्जते॑ म॒रुतो॑ रु॒क्मव॑क्ष॒सोऽश्वा॒न्रथे॑षु॒ भग॒ आ सु॒दान॑वः । धे॒नुर्न शिश्वे॒ स्वस॑रेषु पिन्वते॒ जना॑य रा॒तह॑विषे म॒हीमिष॑म्

devanagari.text: यो नो मरुतो वृकताति मर्त्यो रिपुर्दधे वसवो रक्षता रिषः ।वर्तयत तपुषा चक्रियाभि तमव रुद्रा अशसो हंतना वधः ॥

transliteration.text: yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ vṛká-tāti ǀ mártyaḥ ǀ ripúḥ ǀ dadhé ǀ vasavaḥ ǀ rákṣata ǀ riṣáḥ ǀvartáyata ǀ tápuṣā ǀ cakríyā ǀ abhí ǀ tám ǀ áva ǀ rudrāḥ ǀ aśásaḥ ǀ hantana ǀ vádharíti ǁ

Sukta 34.translation: “Maruts, granters of dwellings, protect us from the malignity of the man who cherishes wolf-like enmity against us; encompass him with your burning diseases; ward off the murderous (weapon) of the devourer.”
Sukta 34.sanskrit_wisdomlib: यो नो॑ मरुतो वृ॒कता॑ति॒ मर्त्यो॑ रि॒पुर्द॒धे व॑सवो॒ रक्ष॑ता रि॒षः । व॒र्तय॑त॒ तपु॑षा च॒क्रिया॒भि तमव॑ रुद्रा अ॒शसो॑ हन्तना॒ वध॑:

devanagari.text: चित्रं तद्वो मरुतो याम चेकिते पृश्न्या यदूधरप्यापयो दुहुः ।यद्वा निदे नवमानस्य रुद्रियास्त्रितं जराय जुरतामदाभ्याः ॥

transliteration.text: citrám ǀ tát ǀ vaḥ ǀ marutaḥ ǀ yā́ma ǀ cekite ǀ pṛ́śnyāḥ ǀ yát ǀ ū́dhaḥ ǀ ápi ǀ āpáyaḥ ǀ duhúḥ ǀyát ǀ vā ǀ nidé ǀ návamānasya ǀ rudriyāḥ ǀ tritám ǀ járāya ǀ juratā́m ǀ adābhyāḥ ǁ

Sukta 34.translation: “Maruts, your marvellous energy is well known, whereby, seizing the udder of heaven, you milked it (of the rain, destroyed) the reviler of your worshipper, and (came), irresistible sons ofRudra, toTritafor the destruction of enemies.”
Sukta 34.sanskrit_wisdomlib: चि॒त्रं तद्वो॑ मरुतो॒ याम॑ चेकिते॒ पृश्न्या॒ यदूध॒रप्या॒पयो॑ दु॒हुः । यद्वा॑ नि॒दे नव॑मानस्य रुद्रियास्त्रि॒तं जरा॑य जुर॒ताम॑दाभ्याः

devanagari.text: तान्वो महो मरुत एवयाव्नो विष्णोरेषस्य प्रभृथे हवामहे ।हिरण्यवर्णान्ककुहान्यतस्रुचो ब्रह्मण्यंतः शंस्यं राध ईमहे ॥

transliteration.text: tā́n ǀ vaḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ marútaḥ ǀ eva-yā́vnaḥ ǀ víṣṇoḥ ǀ eṣásya ǀ pra-bhṛthé ǀ havāmahe ǀhíraṇya-varṇān ǀ kakuhā́n ǀ yatá-srucaḥ ǀ brahmaṇyántaḥ ǀ śáṃsyam ǀ rā́dhaḥ ǀ īmahe ǁ

Sukta 34.translation: “We invoke you, mightyMaruts, who frequent such sacrifices (as this, to be present) at the offering of the diffusive and desirable (libation); lifting up our ladles, and reciting their praise, we solicit the golden-hued and lofty Maruts for excellent wealth.”
Sukta 34.sanskrit_wisdomlib: तान्वो॑ म॒हो म॒रुत॑ एव॒याव्नो॒ विष्णो॑रे॒षस्य॑ प्रभृ॒थे ह॑वामहे । हिर॑ण्यवर्णान्ककु॒हान्य॒तस्रु॑चो ब्रह्म॒ण्यन्त॒: शंस्यं॒ राध॑ ईमहे

devanagari.text: ते दशग्वाः प्रथमा यज्ञमूहिरे ते नो हिन्वंतूषसो व्युष्टिषु ।उषा न रामीररुणैरपोर्णुते महो ज्योतिषा शुचता गोअर्णसा ॥

transliteration.text: té ǀ dáśa-gvāḥ ǀ prathamā́ḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ ūhire ǀ té ǀ naḥ ǀ hinvantu ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ ví-uṣṭiṣu ǀuṣā́ḥ ǀ ná ǀ rāmī́ḥ ǀ aruṇáiḥ ǀ ápa ǀ ūrṇute ǀ maháḥ ǀ jyótiṣā ǀ śucatā́ ǀ gó-arṇasā ǁ

Sukta 34.translation: “May they, who, the first celebrators of the ten-months' rite, accomplished this sacrifice, reanimate us at the rising dawn; for as the dawn with purple rays drives away the night, so (do they scatter the darkness) with great, and pure, and mist-dispelling radiance.”
Sukta 34.sanskrit_wisdomlib: ते दश॑ग्वाः प्रथ॒मा य॒ज्ञमू॑हिरे॒ ते नो॑ हिन्वन्तू॒षसो॒ व्यु॑ष्टिषु । उ॒षा न रा॒मीर॑रु॒णैरपो॑र्णुते म॒हो ज्योति॑षा शुच॒ता गोअ॑र्णसा

devanagari.text: ते क्षोणीभिररुणेभिर्नांजिभी रुद्रा ऋतस्य सदनेषु वावृधुः ।निमेघमाना अत्येन पाजसा सुश्चंद्रं वर्णं दधिरे सुपेशसं ॥

transliteration.text: té ǀ kṣoṇī́bhiḥ ǀ aruṇébhiḥ ǀ ná ǀ añjí-bhiḥ ǀ rudrā́ḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ sádaneṣu ǀ vavṛdhuḥ ǀni-méghamānāḥ ǀ átyena ǀ pā́jasā ǀ su-candrám ǀ várṇam ǀ dadhire ǀ su-péśasam ǁ

Sukta 34.translation: “They, theRudras, (equipped) with melodious (lutes), and decorated with purple ornaments, exult in the dwellings of the waters; and scattering the clouds with rappid vigour, they are endowed with delightful and beautiful forms.”
Sukta 34.sanskrit_wisdomlib: ते क्षो॒णीभि॑ररु॒णेभि॒र्नाञ्जिभी॑ रु॒द्रा ऋ॒तस्य॒ सद॑नेषु वावृधुः । नि॒मेघ॑माना॒ अत्ये॑न॒ पाज॑सा सुश्च॒न्द्रं वर्णं॑ दधिरे सु॒पेश॑सम्

devanagari.text: ताँ इयानो महि वरूथमूतय उप घेदेना नमसा गृणीमसि ।त्रितो न यान्पंच होतॄनभिष्टय आववर्तदवरांचक्रियावसे ॥

Sukta 34.translation: “Imploring them for ample wealth, and (having recourse to him) for protection, we glorify them with this praise; like the five chief priests whomTritadetained for the (performance of) the sacrifice, and to protect it with their weapons.”
Sukta 34.sanskrit_wisdomlib: ताँ इ॑या॒नो महि॒ वरू॑थमू॒तय॒ उप॒ घेदे॒ना नम॑सा गृणीमसि । त्रि॒तो न यान्पञ्च॒ होतॄ॑न॒भिष्ट॑य आव॒वर्त॒दव॑राञ्च॒क्रियाव॑से

Sukta 34.translation: “Maruts, may that protection wherewith you convey the worshipper beyond sin, wherewith you rescue the reciter of your praise from the scoffer, be present with us; may your benign disposition tend towards us, like a lowing (cow towards her calf).”
Sukta 34.sanskrit_wisdomlib: यया॑ र॒ध्रं पा॒रय॒थात्यंहो॒ यया॑ नि॒दो मु॒ञ्चथ॑ वन्दि॒तार॑म् । अ॒र्वाची॒ सा म॑रुतो॒ या व॑ ऊ॒तिरो षु वा॒श्रेव॑ सुम॒तिर्जि॑गातु

devanagari.text: उपेमसृक्षि वाजयुर्वचस्यां चनो दधीत नाद्यो गिरो मे ।अपां नपादाशुहेमा कुवित्स सुपेशसस्करति जोषिषद्धि ॥

Sukta 35.translation: “Desiring food, I put forth this laudatory hymn; may the sounding and swift-moving grandson of the waters bestow abundant food upon me his worshipper; may he make us of goodly appearance, for verily he is propitiated by praise.”
Sukta 35.sanskrit_wisdomlib: उपे॑मसृक्षि वाज॒युर्व॑च॒स्यां चनो॑ दधीत ना॒द्यो गिरो॑ मे । अ॒पां नपा॑दाशु॒हेमा॑ कु॒वित्स सु॒पेश॑सस्करति॒ जोषि॑ष॒द्धि

transliteration.text: imám ǀ sú ǀ asmai ǀ hṛdáḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sú-taṣṭam ǀ mántram ǀ vocema ǀ kuvít ǀ asya ǀ védat ǀapā́m ǀ nápāt ǀ asuryásya ǀ mahnā́ ǀ víśvāni ǀ aryáḥ ǀ bhúvanā ǀ jajāna ǁ

Sukta 35.translation: “Let us address to him the prayer that is conceived in our hearts, and may he fully understand (its purport); for he, the lord, the grandson of the waters, has genitive rated all beings by the greatness of his might.”
Sukta 35.sanskrit_wisdomlib: इ॒मं स्व॑स्मै हृ॒द आ सुत॑ष्टं॒ मन्त्रं॑ वोचेम कु॒विद॑स्य॒ वेद॑त् । अ॒पां नपा॑दसु॒र्य॑स्य म॒ह्ना विश्वा॑न्य॒र्यो भुव॑ना जजान

devanagari.text: समन्या यंत्युप यंत्यन्याः समानमूर्वं नद्यः पृणंति ।तमू शुचिं शुचयो दीदिवांसमपां नपातं परि तस्थुरापः ॥

Sukta 35.translation: “Some waters collect together (from the rain); others, (already collected on earth), unite with them; as rivers, they flow together to propitiate the ocean-fire; the pure waters are gathered round the pure and brilliant grandsons of the waters.”
Sukta 35.sanskrit_wisdomlib: सम॒न्या यन्त्युप॑ यन्त्य॒न्याः स॑मा॒नमू॒र्वं न॒द्य॑: पृणन्ति । तमू॒ शुचिं॒ शुच॑यो दीदि॒वांस॑म॒पां नपा॑तं॒ परि॑ तस्थु॒राप॑:

devanagari.text: तमस्मेरा युवतयो युवानं मर्मृज्यमानाः परि यंत्यापः ।स शुक्रेभिः शिक्वभी रेवदस्मे दीदायानिध्मो घृतनिर्णिगप्सु ॥

Sukta 35.translation: “The young and modest (waters) wait upon the youth, assiduous in bathing him, and he, although unfed with fuel, yet cleansed with clarified butter, shines with bright rays amidst the waters, the abundance (may be) to us.”
Sukta 35.sanskrit_wisdomlib: तमस्मे॑रा युव॒तयो॒ युवा॑नं मर्मृ॒ज्यमा॑ना॒: परि॑ य॒न्त्याप॑: । स शु॒क्रेभि॒: शिक्व॑भी रे॒वद॒स्मे दी॒दाया॑नि॒ध्मो घृ॒तनि॑र्णिग॒प्सु

devanagari.text: अस्मै तिस्रो अव्यथ्याय नारीर्देवाय देवीर्दिधिषंत्यन्नं ।कृता इवोप हि प्रसर्स्रे अप्सु स पीयूषं धयति पूर्वसूनां ॥

Sukta 35.translation: “THree divine feminine les present food to that uninjurable divinity; as if formed in the waters they spread abroad, and he drinks the ambrosia of the first-created (elements).”
Sukta 35.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒स्मै ति॒स्रो अ॑व्य॒थ्याय॒ नारी॑र्दे॒वाय॑ दे॒वीर्दि॑धिष॒न्त्यन्न॑म् । कृता॑ इ॒वोप॒ हि प्र॑स॒र्स्रे अ॒प्सु स पी॒यूषं॑ धयति पूर्व॒सूना॑म्

devanagari.text: अश्वस्यात्र जनिमास्य च स्वर्द्रुहो रिषः संपृचः पाहि सूरीन् ।आमासु पूर्षु परो अप्रमृष्यं नारातयो वि नशन्नानृतानि ॥

Sukta 35.translation: “In him is the birth of the horse, of him is (the origin of) the world; do you, grandson of the (waters), protect the pious worshippers from the malevolence of the oppressor; those who give no offerings, those who practise untruths, attain not the inconceivable deity, whether abiding in the  immature or the perfect waters.”
Sukta 35.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अश्व॒स्यात्र॒ जनि॑मा॒स्य च॒ स्व॑र्द्रु॒हो रि॒षः स॒म्पृच॑: पाहि सू॒रीन् । आ॒मासु॑ पू॒र्षु प॒रो अ॑प्रमृ॒ष्यं नारा॑तयो॒ वि न॑श॒न्नानृ॑तानि

devanagari.text: स्व आ दमे सुदुघा यस्य धेनुः स्वधां पीपाय सुभ्वन्नमत्ति ।सो अपां नपादूर्जयन्नप्स्वंतर्वसुदेयाय विधते वि भाति ॥

Sukta 35.translation: “He, the grandson of the waters, who abides in his own dwelling; of whom is the readily-milked cow; who augments the nectar (of the skies), and (thence) eats the sacrificial food; he, gathering strength in the midst of the waters, shines for the sake of conferring wealth upon his worshipper.”
Sukta 35.sanskrit_wisdomlib: स्व आ दमे॑ सु॒दुघा॒ यस्य॑ धे॒नुः स्व॒धां पी॑पाय सु॒भ्वन्न॑मत्ति । सो अ॒पां नपा॑दू॒र्जय॑न्न॒प्स्व१॒॑न्तर्व॑सु॒देया॑य विध॒ते वि भा॑ति

Sukta 35.translation: “All other beings are, as it were, branches of him, who, truthful, eternal, and vast, shines amid the waters with pure and divine (radiance); and the shrubs, with their products, are born (of him).”
Sukta 35.sanskrit_wisdomlib: यो अ॒प्स्वा शुचि॑ना॒ दैव्ये॑न ऋ॒तावाज॑स्र उर्वि॒या वि॒भाति॑ । व॒या इद॒न्या भुव॑नान्यस्य॒ प्र जा॑यन्ते वी॒रुध॑श्च प्र॒जाभि॑:

Sukta 35.translation: “The grandson of the waters has ascended the firmament above (the region) of the tortuously-moving (clouds), arrayed in lightning; the broad and golden-coloured (rivers) spread around, bearing (to all quarters) his exceeding glory.”
Sukta 35.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒पां नपा॒दा ह्यस्था॑दु॒पस्थं॑ जि॒ह्माना॑मू॒र्ध्वो वि॒द्युतं॒ वसा॑नः । तस्य॒ ज्येष्ठं॑ महि॒मानं॒ वह॑न्ती॒र्हिर॑ण्यवर्णा॒: परि॑ यन्ति य॒ह्वीः

Sukta 35.translation: “The grandson of the waters is of olden form, of golden aspect, of golden hue, and (shines) seated upon a seat of gold; the givers of gold (at solemn rites) present to him (sacrificial) food.”
Sukta 35.sanskrit_wisdomlib: हिर॑ण्यरूप॒: स हिर॑ण्यसंदृग॒पां नपा॒त्सेदु॒ हिर॑ण्यवर्णः । हि॒र॒ण्यया॒त्परि॒ योने॑र्नि॒षद्या॑ हिरण्य॒दा द॑द॒त्यन्न॑मस्मै

Sukta 35.translation: “Beautiful is his form (of aggregated lustre, beautiful) is the name of the grandson of the waters; (both) flourish, though  hidden (by the clouds); the youthful w2aters collectively kindle the golden-coloured divinity in the firmament, for water is his food.”
Sukta 35.sanskrit_wisdomlib: तद॒स्यानी॑कमु॒त चारु॒ नामा॑पी॒च्यं॑ वर्धते॒ नप्तु॑र॒पाम् । यमि॒न्धते॑ युव॒तय॒: समि॒त्था हिर॑ण्यवर्णं घृ॒तमन्न॑मस्य

Sukta 35.translation: “To him our friend, the first of many (deities), we offer worship with sacrifices, oblations, and prostration; I decorate the high plural ce (of his presence); I nourish him with fuel; I sustain him with (sacrificial) viands; I glorify him with hymns.”
Sukta 35.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒स्मै ब॑हू॒नाम॑व॒माय॒ सख्ये॑ य॒ज्ञैर्वि॑धेम॒ नम॑सा ह॒विर्भि॑: । सं सानु॒ मार्ज्मि॒ दिधि॑षामि॒ बिल्मै॒र्दधा॒म्यन्नै॒: परि॑ वन्द ऋ॒ग्भिः

devanagari.text: स ईं वृषाजनयत्तासु गर्भं स ईं शिशुर्धयति तं रिहंति ।सो अपां नपादनभिम्लातवर्णोऽन्यस्येवेह तन्वा विवेष ॥

Sukta 35.translation: “Vigorous, he has genitive rated himself as an embryo in those (waters); he is their infant; he sucks them; they bedew him (with moisture); the grandson of the waters of untarnished splendour has descended to this (earth) in the form of a different (fire).”

Sukta 35.translation: “The abundant waters, bearing sustenance to their grandson, flow round him with spontaneous movements; when abiding in his supreme sphere, and shining daily with imperishable (rays).”

Sukta 35.translation: “I have come,Agni, to you, (the giver) of good dwellings, for the sake of offspring; I have come with a propitiatory hymn for the sake of the opulent (offerers of oblations); may all the good which the gods defend (be ours); that, blessed with excellent descendants, we may worthily glorify you at this sacrifice.”

Sukta 36.translation: “(The libation) that is being presented,Indra, to you, comprises the (products of the) cow, and he (consecrated) water; and the leaders (of the rite) have expressed it with stones, and strained it through woollen (filters); do you, Indra, who are the first (of the gods), and rule (over the world), drink theSomaoffered by theHotā, and sanctified by the exclamationssvāhāand vaṣat.”

Sukta 36.translation: “Maruts, together worshipped with sacrifices, standing in the car drawn by spotted mares, radiant with lances, and delighted by ornaments, sons ofBharata, leaders in the firmament, seated on the sacred grass, drink theSomapresented by thePotā.”

Sukta 36.translation: “Do you, who are devoutly invoked, come to us together, and, seated on the sacrificial grass, enjoy your rest; and then,Tvaṣṭā, who head a brilliant cohort (come) with the gods and their wives, and rejoice being plural ased with the (sacrificial) food.”

Sukta 37.translation: “May these your bearers, by whom you are borne along, be satisfied; lord of the forest, be firm, doing no injury, steadfast of resolve; come and being gracious, drink, Draviṇodas, along with the Ṛtus, theSoma, the offering of theNeṣṭā.”

Sukta 37.translation: “Yoke today,Aśvins, your rolling car conveying (you), the leaders (of the rite); and setting yu down before us; mix the oblations with the sweet juice; come you are affluent with (abundant) food, and drink theSoma.”

Sukta 37.translation: “Be plural ased,Agni, with the fuel; be plural ased with the oblation; be plural ased with the sacred prayer that is good for man; be plural ased with holy praise, asylum of all; Agni, willing (to accept oblations), render all the great gods desirous (of the same), and with them all, and with the Ṛtu drink the oblation.”

Sukta 38.translation: “In truth, the divineSavitā, the bearer (of the world), has perpetually been present for the genitive ration (of mankind), for such is his office; verily he grants wealth to the pious (worshippers); may he, therefore, bestow upon the offerer of the oblation (sufficient) for his well-being.”
Sukta 38.sanskrit_wisdomlib: उदु॒ ष्य दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता स॒वाय॑ शश्वत्त॒मं तद॑पा॒ वह्नि॑रस्थात् । नू॒नं दे॒वेभ्यो॒ वि हि धाति॒ रत्न॒मथाभ॑जद्वी॒तिहो॑त्रं स्व॒स्तौ

Sukta 38.translation: “The divine, vast-handed (Savitā), having risen, stretches forth his arms for the delight of all; the purifying waters (flow) for (the fulfilment of) his rites, and this circumambient air sports (in the firmament).”

Sukta 38.translation: “The moving (Sun) is liberated by his rapid rays; verily he has stopped the traveller from his journey; he restraisn the desire of warriors for combat, for night follows (the cessation of) the function ofSavitā.”

Sukta 38.translation: “She, (Night), enwraps the extended (world) like (a woman) weaving (a garment); the prudent man lays aside the work he is able (to execute) in the midst (of his labour); but all spring up (from repose) when the divine, unwearied Sun, who has divided the seasons, again appears.”

Sukta 38.translation: “The engendered domestic radiance ofAgnispreads through various dwellings, and presides over all (sorts of sacrificial) food; the mother, (Dawn), has assigned to her son, (Agni), the best portion (at sacrifices), which is the manifestation of him imparted bySavitā.”

Sukta 38.translation: “The warrior, eager for victory, who has gone forth (to battle), turns back; (for) home is the desire of  moving beiings; abandoning his half-wrought toil, the labourer returns (home) when the function of the divineSavitā(is suspended).”

transliteration.text: hástā-iva ǀ śaktím ǀ abhí ǀ sandadī́ íti sam-dadī́ ǀ naḥ ǀ kṣā́mā-iva ǀ naḥ ǀ sám ǀ ajatam ǀ rájāṃsi ǀimā́ḥ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ aśvinā ǀ yuṣma-yántīḥ ǀ kṣṇótreṇa-iva ǀ svá-dhitim ǀ sám ǀ śiśītam ǁ

Sukta 39.translation: “Like twohands,Aśvins, be ever investing us with vigour; like heaven and earth, bestow upon us rain; give sharpness to the praises that are addressed to you, as they whet an axe upon a grindstone.”
Sukta 39.sanskrit_wisdomlib: हस्ते॑व श॒क्तिम॒भि सं॑द॒दी न॒: क्षामे॑व न॒: सम॑जतं॒ रजां॑सि । इ॒मा गिरो॑ अश्विना युष्म॒यन्ती॒: क्ष्णोत्रे॑णेव॒ स्वधि॑तिं॒ सं शि॑शीतम्

transliteration.text: etā́ni ǀ vām ǀ aśvinā ǀ várdhanāni ǀ bráhma ǀ stómam ǀ gṛtsa-madā́saḥ ǀ akran ǀtā́ni ǀ narā ǀ jujuṣāṇā́ ǀ úpa ǀ yātam ǀ bṛhát ǀ vadema ǀ vidáthe ǀ su-vī́rāḥ ǁ

Sukta 39.translation: “TheGṛtsamadashave composed this prayer, these praises,Aśvins, for your exaltation; be propitiated by them, leaders of ceremonies, and come hither; that, blessed with excellent descendants, we may worthily glorify you at this sacrifice.”
Sukta 39.sanskrit_wisdomlib: ए॒तानि॑ वामश्विना॒ वर्ध॑नानि॒ ब्रह्म॒ स्तोमं॑ गृत्सम॒दासो॑ अक्रन् । तानि॑ नरा जुजुषा॒णोप॑ यातं बृ॒हद्व॑देम वि॒दथे॑ सु॒वीरा॑:

devanagari.text: सोमापूषणा जनना रयीणां जनना दिवो जनना पृथिव्याः ।जातौ विश्वस्य भुवनस्य गोपौ देवा अकृण्वन्नमृतस्य नाभिं ॥

transliteration.text: sómāpūṣaṇā ǀ jánanā ǀ rayīṇā́m ǀ jánanā ǀ diváḥ ǀ jánanā ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀjātáu ǀ víśvasya ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ gopáu ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ akṛṇvan ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ nā́bhim ǁ

Sukta 40.translation: “SomaandPūṣaṇ, you two are the genitive rators of riches, the genitive rators of heaven, the genitive rators of earth; as soon as born you are the guardians of the whole world; the gods have made you the source of immortality.”
Sukta 40.sanskrit_wisdomlib: सोमा॑पूषणा॒ जन॑ना रयी॒णां जन॑ना दि॒वो जन॑ना पृथि॒व्याः । जा॒तौ विश्व॑स्य॒ भुव॑नस्य गो॒पौ दे॒वा अ॑कृण्वन्न॒मृत॑स्य॒ नाभि॑म्

devanagari.text: इमौ देवौ जायमानौ जुषंतेमौ तमांसि गूहतामजुष्टा ।आभ्यामिंद्रः पक्वमामास्वंतः सोमापूषभ्यां जनदुस्रियासु ॥

transliteration.text: imáu ǀ deváu ǀ jā́yamānau ǀ juṣanta ǀ imáu ǀ támāṃsi ǀ gūhatām ǀ ájuṣṭā ǀābhyā́m ǀ índraḥ ǀ pakvám ǀ āmā́su ǀ antáríti ǀ somāpūṣá-bhyām ǀ janat ǀ usríyāsu ǁ

Sukta 40.translation: “(The gods) propitiate these two divinities at the moment of the ir birth, for they drive away the disagreeable glooms; with these two,SomaandPūṣaṇ,Indragenitive rates the mature (milk) in the immature heifers.”
Sukta 40.sanskrit_wisdomlib: इ॒मौ दे॒वौ जाय॑मानौ जुषन्ते॒मौ तमां॑सि गूहता॒मजु॑ष्टा । आ॒भ्यामिन्द्र॑: प॒क्वमा॒मास्व॒न्तः सो॑मापू॒षभ्यां॑ जनदु॒स्रिया॑सु

devanagari.text: सोमापूषणा रजसो विमानं सप्तचक्रं रथमविश्वमिन्वं ।विषूवृतं मनसा युज्यमानं तं जिन्वथो वृषणा पंचरश्मिं ॥

Sukta 40.translation: “SomaandPūṣaṇ, showerers (of benefits)m direct towards us the seven-wheeled car, the measure of the spheres, undistinguishable from the universe, everywhere existing, (guided) by five reins, and to be harnessed by the mind.”
Sukta 40.sanskrit_wisdomlib: सोमा॑पूषणा॒ रज॑सो वि॒मानं॑ स॒प्तच॑क्रं॒ रथ॒मवि॑श्वमिन्वम् । वि॒षू॒वृतं॒ मन॑सा यु॒ज्यमा॑नं॒ तं जि॑न्वथो वृषणा॒ पञ्च॑रश्मिम्

devanagari.text: दिव्यन्यः सदनं चक्र उच्चा पृथिव्यामन्यो अध्यंतरिक्षे ।तावस्मभ्यं पुरुवारं पुरुक्षुं रायस्पोषं वि ष्यतां नाभिमस्मे ॥

transliteration.text: diví ǀ anyáḥ ǀ sádanam ǀ cakré ǀ uccā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ anyáḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ antárikṣe ǀtáu ǀ asmábhyam ǀ puru-vā́ram ǀ puru-kṣúm ǀ rāyáḥ ǀ póṣam ǀ ví ǀ syatām ǀ nā́bhim ǀ asmé íti ǁ

Sukta 40.translation: “One of them, (Pūṣaṇ), has made his dwelling above in the heaven; the other (Soma), upon earth, and in the firmament; may they both grant us much-desired and much-commended abundant wealth of cattle, the source to us (of enjoyment).”
Sukta 40.sanskrit_wisdomlib: दि॒व्य१॒॑न्यः सद॑नं च॒क्र उ॒च्चा पृ॑थि॒व्याम॒न्यो अध्य॒न्तरि॑क्षे । ताव॒स्मभ्यं॑ पुरु॒वारं॑ पुरु॒क्षुं रा॒यस्पोषं॒ वि ष्य॑तां॒ नाभि॑म॒स्मे

devanagari.text: विश्वान्यन्यो भुवना जजान विश्वमन्यो अभिचक्षाण एति ।सोमापूषणाववतं धियं मे युवाभ्यां विश्वाः पृतना जयेम ॥

transliteration.text: víśvāni ǀ anyáḥ ǀ bhúvanā ǀ jajā́na ǀ víśvam ǀ anyáḥ ǀ abhi-cákṣāṇaḥ ǀ eti ǀsómāpūṣaṇau ǀ ávatam ǀ dhíyam ǀ me ǀ yuvā́bhyām ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ pṛ́tanāḥ ǀ jayema ǁ

Sukta 40.translation: “One of you, (Soma) has genitive rated all beings; the other proceeds looking upon the universe: Soma andPūṣaṇ, protect my (pious) rite; through you, may we overcome all the hosts of our enemies.”
Sukta 40.sanskrit_wisdomlib: विश्वा॑न्य॒न्यो भुव॑ना ज॒जान॒ विश्व॑म॒न्यो अ॑भि॒चक्षा॑ण एति । सोमा॑पूषणा॒वव॑तं॒ धियं॑ मे यु॒वाभ्यां॒ विश्वा॒: पृत॑ना जयेम

devanagari.text: धियं पूषा जिन्वतु विश्वमिन्वो रयिं सोमो रयिपतिर्दधातु ।अवतु देव्यदितिरनर्वा बृहद्वदेम विदथे सुवीराः ॥

Sukta 40.translation: “MayPūṣaṇ, who is the benefactor of all, be propitious to (this pious) rite; maySoma, the lord of wealth, grant us affluence; mayAditi, who is without an adversary, protect us, so that, blessed with excellent descendants, we may worthily glorify (you) at this sacrifice.”
Sukta 40.sanskrit_wisdomlib: धियं॑ पू॒षा जि॑न्वतु विश्वमि॒न्वो र॒यिं सोमो॑ रयि॒पति॑र्दधातु । अव॑तु दे॒व्यदि॑तिरन॒र्वा बृ॒हद्व॑देम वि॒दथे॑ सु॒वीरा॑:

devanagari.text: वायो ये ते सहस्रिणो रथासस्तेभिरा गहि ।नियुत्वान्त्सोमपीतये ॥

Sukta 41.translation: “Vāyu, whose are a thousand chariots, and theNiyutsteeds, come to drink theSoma.”
Sukta 41.sanskrit_wisdomlib: वायो॒ ये ते॑ सह॒स्रिणो॒ रथा॑स॒स्तेभि॒रा ग॑हि । नि॒युत्वा॒न्त्सोम॑पीतये

devanagari.text: नियुत्वान्वायवा गह्ययं शुक्रो अयामि ते ।गंतासि सुन्वतो गृहं ॥
नियुत्वान् । वायो इति । आ । गहि । अयम् । शुक्रः । अयामि । ते ।गन्ता । असि । सुन्वतः । गृहम् ॥

transliteration.text: niyútvān ǀ vāyo íti ǀ ā́ ǀ gahi ǀ ayám ǀ śukráḥ ǀ ayāmi ǀ te ǀgántā ǀ asi ǀ sunvatáḥ ǀ gṛhám ǁ

Sukta 41.translation: “Vāyu,of theNiyutsteds, approach; this bright (juice) has been accepted by you, for you go to the dwelling of the offerer of the libation.”
Sukta 41.sanskrit_wisdomlib: नि॒युत्वा॑न्वाय॒वा ग॑ह्य॒यं शु॒क्रो अ॑यामि ते । गन्ता॑सि सुन्व॒तो गृ॒हम्

devanagari.text: शुक्रस्याद्य गवाशिर इंद्रवायू नियुत्वतः ।आ यातं पिबतं नरा ॥
शुक्रस्य । अद्य । गोऽआशिरः । इन्द्रवायू इति । नियुत्वतः ।आ । यातम् । पिबतम् । नरा ॥

transliteration.text: śukrásya ǀ adyá ǀ gó-āśiraḥ ǀ índravāyū íti ǀ niyútvataḥ ǀā́ ǀ yātam ǀ píbatam ǀ narā ǁ

Sukta 41.translation: “Leaders (of rites),IndraandVāyu, lords of theNiyutsteeds, come and drink today the mixture of milk and of the pureSoma.”
Sukta 41.sanskrit_wisdomlib: शु॒क्रस्या॒द्य गवा॑शिर॒ इन्द्र॑वायू नि॒युत्व॑तः । आ या॑तं॒ पिब॑तं नरा

devanagari.text: अयं वां मित्रावरुणा सुतः सोम ऋतावृधा ।ममेदिह श्रुतं हवं ॥
अयम् । वाम् । मित्रावरुणा । सुतः । सोमः । ऋतऽवृधा ।मम । इत् । इह । श्रुतम् । हवम् ॥

transliteration.text: ayám ǀ vām ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ sutáḥ ǀ sómaḥ ǀ ṛta-vṛdhā ǀmáma ǀ ít ǀ ihá ǀ śrutam ǀ hávam ǁ

Sukta 41.translation: “This libation is offered to you,MitraandVaruṇa, cherishers of truth; hear, verily, this my present invocatioṇ ”
Sukta 41.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒यं वां॑ मित्रावरुणा सु॒तः सोम॑ ऋतावृधा । ममेदि॒ह श्रु॑तं॒ हव॑म्

devanagari.text: राजानावनभिद्रुहा ध्रुवे सदस्युत्तमे ।सहस्रस्थूण आसाते ॥
राजानौ । अनभिऽद्रुहा । ध्रुवे । सदसि । उत्ऽतमे ।सहस्रऽस्थूणे । आसाते इति ॥

Sukta 41.translation: “Sovereigns, exercising no oppression, sit down in this substantial and elegant hall, (built) with a thousand columns.”
Sukta 41.sanskrit_wisdomlib: राजा॑ना॒वन॑भिद्रुहा ध्रु॒वे सद॑स्युत्त॒मे । स॒हस्र॑स्थूण आसाते

devanagari.text: ता सम्राजा घृतासुती आदित्या दानुनस्पती ।सचेते अनवह्वरं ॥
ता । सम्ऽराजा । घृतासुती इति घृतऽआसुती । आदित्या । दानुनः । पती इति ।सचेते इति । अनवऽह्वरम् ॥

transliteration.text: tā́ ǀ sam-rā́jā ǀ ghṛtā́sutī íti ghṛtá-āsutī ǀ ādityā́ ǀ dā́nunaḥ ǀ pátī íti ǀsácete íti ǀ ánava-hvaram ǁ

Sukta 41.translation: “May these two universal monarchs, fed with clarified butter, sons ofAditi, lords of liberality, show favour to their sincere (worshipper).”

Sukta 43.translation: “When uttering your cry, O Bird, proclaim good fortune; when sitting silently cherish kind thoughts towards us; when you cry as you are flying, let the sound be like that of a lute; so that, blessed with excellent descendants, we may worthily praise you at this sacrifice.”

Sukta 1.translation: “Aggregated in the womb of the waters, (his rays) spread abroad; and omniform, are here effective for the diffusion of the sweet (Soma), like kine full uddered; the mighty (Heaven and Earth) are the fitting parents of the gracefulAgni.”
Sukta 1.sanskrit_wisdomlib: स्ती॒र्णा अ॑स्य सं॒हतो॑ वि॒श्वरू॑पा घृ॒तस्य॒ योनौ॑ स्र॒वथे॒ मधू॑नाम् । अस्थु॒रत्र॑ धे॒नव॒: पिन्व॑माना म॒ही द॒स्मस्य॑ मा॒तरा॑ समी॒ची

devanagari.text: बभ्राणः सूनो सहसो व्यद्यौद्दधानः शुक्रा रभसा वपूंषि ।श्चोतंति धारा मधुनो घृतस्य वृषा यत्र वावृधे काव्येन ॥

transliteration.text: babhrāṇáḥ ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ ví ǀ adyaut ǀ dádhānaḥ ǀ śukrā́ ǀ rabhasā́ ǀ vápūṃṣi ǀścótanti ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ mádhunaḥ ǀ ghṛtásya ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ yátra ǀ vavṛdhé ǀ kā́vyena ǁ

Sukta 1.translation: “Son of strength, sustained by all, you shine, possessing bright and rapid rays; when the vigorousAgniis magnified by praise, then the showers of sweet rain descend.”
Sukta 1.sanskrit_wisdomlib: ब॒भ्रा॒णः सू॑नो सहसो॒ व्य॑द्यौ॒द्दधा॑नः शु॒क्रा र॑भ॒सा वपूं॑षि । श्चोत॑न्ति॒ धारा॒ मधु॑नो घृ॒तस्य॒ वृषा॒ यत्र॑ वावृ॒धे काव्ये॑न

devanagari.text: पितुश्चिदूधर्जनुषा विवेद व्यस्य धारा असृजद्वि धेनाः ।गुहा चरंतं सखिभिः शिवेभिर्दिवो यह्वीभिर्न गुहा बभूव ॥

transliteration.text: pitúḥ ǀ cit ǀ ū́dhaḥ ǀ janúṣā ǀ viveda ǀ ví ǀ asya ǀ dhā́rāḥ ǀ asṛjat ǀ ví ǀ dhénāḥ ǀgúhā ǀ cárantam ǀ sákhi-bhiḥ ǀ śivébhiḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ yahvī́bhiḥ ǀ ná ǀ gúhā ǀ babhūva ǁ

Sukta 1.translation: “At his birth he knew the udder of his parent and let forth its torrents, and its speech (of thunder); there was no one to detect him, lurking in the deep, with his auspicious associates, (the winds), and the many (waters) of the firmament.”
Sukta 1.sanskrit_wisdomlib: पि॒तुश्चि॒दूध॑र्ज॒नुषा॑ विवेद॒ व्य॑स्य॒ धारा॑ असृज॒द्वि धेना॑: । गुहा॒ चर॑न्तं॒ सखि॑भिः शि॒वेभि॑र्दि॒वो य॒ह्वीभि॒र्न गुहा॑ बभूव

devanagari.text: पितुश्च गर्भं जनितुश्च बभ्रे पूर्वीरेको अधयत्पीप्यानाः ।वृष्णे सपत्नी शुचये सबंधू उभे अस्मै मनुष्येनि पाहि ॥

transliteration.text: pitúḥ ǀ ca ǀ gárbham ǀ janitúḥ ǀ ca ǀ babhre ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǀ adhayat ǀ pī́pyānāḥ ǀvṛ́ṣṇe ǀ sapátnī íti sa-pátnī ǀ śúcaye ǀ sábandhū íti sá-bandhū ǀ ubhé íti ǀ asmai ǀ manuṣyé íti ǀ ní ǀ pāhi ǁ

Sukta 1.translation: “He cherishes the embryo of the parent (firmament), and of the genitive rator (of the world); he alone consumes many flourishing (plural nts); the associated brides (of the Sun, Heaven and Earth), who are kind to man, are both of kin to that pure showerer (of blessings); do you,Agni, ever preserve them.”
Sukta 1.sanskrit_wisdomlib: पि॒तुश्च॒ गर्भं॑ जनि॒तुश्च॑ बभ्रे पू॒र्वीरेको॑ अधय॒त्पीप्या॑नाः । वृष्णे॑ स॒पत्नी॒ शुच॑ये॒ सब॑न्धू उ॒भे अ॑स्मै मनु॒ष्ये॒३॒॑ नि पा॑हि

devanagari.text: उरौ महाँ अनिबाधे ववर्धापो अग्निं यशसः सं हि पूर्वीः ।ऋतस्य योनावशयद्दमूना जामीनामग्निरपसि स्वसॄणां ॥

transliteration.text: uráu ǀ mahā́n ǀ ani-bādhé ǀ vavardha ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ agním ǀ yaśásaḥ ǀ sám ǀ hí ǀ pūrvī́ḥ ǀṛtásya ǀ yónau ǀ aśayat ǀ dámūnāḥ ǀ jāmīnā́m ǀ agníḥ ǀ apási ǀ svásṝṇām ǁ

Sukta 1.translation: “The greatAgniincreases on the broad unbounded (firmament), for the waters supply abundant nutriment, and plural cid, he sleeps in the birth-plural ce of the waters for the service of the sister streams.”
Sukta 1.sanskrit_wisdomlib: उ॒रौ म॒हाँ अ॑निबा॒धे व॑व॒र्धापो॑ अ॒ग्निं य॒शस॒: सं हि पू॒र्वीः । ऋ॒तस्य॒ योना॑वशय॒द्दमू॑ना जामी॒नाम॒ग्निर॒पसि॒ स्वसॄ॑णाम्

devanagari.text: अक्रो न बभ्रिः समिथे महीनां दिदृक्षेयः सूनवे भाऋजीकः ।उदुस्रिया जनिता यो जजानापां गर्भो नृतमो यह्वो अग्निः ॥

transliteration.text: akráḥ ǀ ná ǀ babhríḥ ǀ sam-ithé ǀ mahī́nām ǀ didṛkṣéyaḥ ǀ sūnáve ǀ bhā́ḥ-ṛjīkaḥ ǀút ǀ usríyāḥ ǀ jánitā ǀ yáḥ ǀ jajā́na ǀ apā́m ǀ gárbhaḥ ǀ nṛ́-tamaḥ ǀ yahváḥ ǀ agníḥ ǁ

Sukta 1.translation: “The invincibleAgni, the cherisher of the valiant in battle, the seen of all, shining by his own lustre, the genitive rator (of the world), the embryo of the waters, the chief of leaders, the mighty, is he who has begotton the waters for (the benefit of) the offerer of the libation.”
Sukta 1.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒क्रो न ब॒भ्रिः स॑मि॒थे म॒हीनां॑ दिदृ॒क्षेय॑: सू॒नवे॒ भाऋ॑जीकः । उदु॒स्रिया॒ जनि॑ता॒ यो ज॒जाना॒पां गर्भो॒ नृत॑मो य॒ह्वो अ॒ग्निः

devanagari.text: अपां गर्भं दर्शतमोषधीनां वना जजान सुभगा विरूपं ।देवासश्चिन्मनसा सं हि जग्मुः पनिष्ठं जातं तवसं दुवस्यन् ॥

transliteration.text: apā́m ǀ gárbham ǀ darśatám ǀ óṣadhīnām ǀ vánā ǀ jajāna ǀ su-bhágā ǀ ví-rūpam ǀdevā́saḥ ǀ cit ǀ mánasā ǀ sám ǀ hí ǀ jagmúḥ ǀ pániṣṭham ǀ jātám ǀ tavásam ǀ duvasyan ǁ

Sukta 1.translation: “The auspicious timber has genitive rated the graceful and multiform embryo of the waters and the plural nts; the gods approached him with reverence, and worshipped the adorable and mighty (Agni) as soon as born.”
Sukta 1.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒पां गर्भं॑ दर्श॒तमोष॑धीनां॒ वना॑ जजान सु॒भगा॒ विरू॑पम् । दे॒वास॑श्चि॒न्मन॑सा॒ सं हि ज॒ग्मुः पनि॑ष्ठं जा॒तं त॒वसं॑ दुवस्यन्

devanagari.text: बृहंत इद्भानवो भाऋजीकमग्निं सचंत विद्युतो न शुक्राः ।गुहेव वृद्धं सदसि स्वे अंतरपार ऊर्वे अमृतं दुहानाः ॥

transliteration.text: bṛhántaḥ ǀ ít ǀ bhānávaḥ ǀ bhā́ḥ-ṛjīkam ǀ agním ǀ sacanta ǀ vi-dyútaḥ ǀ ná ǀ śukrā́ḥ ǀgúhā-iva ǀ vṛddhám ǀ sádasi ǀ své ǀ antáḥ ǀ apāré ǀ ūrvé ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ dúhānāḥ ǁ

Sukta 1.translation: “Mighty sins, like brilliant lightning, associate with the self-shiningAgni, great in his own abode, as if in a (deep) cavern, as they milk forth ambrosia into the boundless and vast ocean.”
Sukta 1.sanskrit_wisdomlib: बृ॒हन्त॒ इद्भा॒नवो॒ भाऋ॑जीकम॒ग्निं स॑चन्त वि॒द्युतो॒ न शु॒क्राः । गुहे॑व वृ॒द्धं सद॑सि॒ स्वे अ॒न्तर॑पा॒र ऊ॒र्वे अ॒मृतं॒ दुहा॑नाः

devanagari.text: ईळे च त्वा यजमानो हविर्भिरीळे सखित्वं सुमतिं निकामः ।देवैरवो मिमीहि सं जरित्रे रक्षा च नो दम्येभिरनीकैः ॥

transliteration.text: ī́ḷe ǀ ca ǀ tvā ǀ yájamānaḥ ǀ havíḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ī́ḷe ǀ sakhi-tvám ǀ su-matím ǀ ní-kāmaḥ ǀdeváiḥ ǀ ávaḥ ǀ mimīhi ǀ sám ǀ jaritré ǀ rákṣa ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ dámyebhiḥ ǀ ánīkaiḥ ǁ

Sukta 1.translation: “I, the instrumental tutor of the rite, worship you with oblations; desirous of your favour, I implore your friendship; grant, along with the gods, protection to him who praises you, preserve us with your well-regulated rays.”
Sukta 1.sanskrit_wisdomlib: ईळे॑ च त्वा॒ यज॑मानो ह॒विर्भि॒रीळे॑ सखि॒त्वं सु॑म॒तिं निका॑मः । दे॒वैरवो॑ मिमीहि॒ सं ज॑रि॒त्रे रक्षा॑ च नो॒ दम्ये॑भि॒रनी॑कैः

devanagari.text: उपक्षेतारस्तव सुप्रणीतेऽग्ने विश्वानि धन्या दधानाः ।सुरेतसा श्रवसा तुंजमाना अभि ष्याम पृतनायूँरदेवान् ॥

transliteration.text: upa-kṣetā́raḥ ǀ táva ǀ su-pranīte ǀ agne ǀ víśvāni ǀ dhányā ǀ dádhānāḥ ǀsu-rétasā ǀ śrávasā ǀ túñjamānāḥ ǀ abhí ǀ syāma ǀ pṛtanā-yū́n ǀ ádevān ǁ

Sukta 1.translation: “Approaching you, benevolentAgni, and performing all holy acts that are the cause of opulence, offering oblations with earnestness and in abundance, may we overcome the hostile hosts that are without gods.”
Sukta 1.sanskrit_wisdomlib: उ॒प॒क्षे॒तार॒स्तव॑ सुप्रणी॒तेऽग्ने॒ विश्वा॑नि॒ धन्या॒ दधा॑नाः । सु॒रेत॑सा॒ श्रव॑सा॒ तुञ्ज॑माना अ॒भि ष्या॑म पृतना॒यूँरदे॑वान्

devanagari.text: आ देवानामभवः केतुरग्ने मंद्रो विश्वानि काव्यानि विद्वान् ।प्रति मर्ताँ अवासयो दमूना अनु देवान्रथिरो यासि साधन् ॥

transliteration.text: ā́ ǀ devā́nām ǀ abhavaḥ ǀ ketúḥ ǀ agne ǀ mandráḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ kā́vyāni ǀ vidvā́n ǀpráti ǀ mártān ǀ avāsayaḥ ǀ dámūnāḥ ǀ ánu ǀ devā́n ǀ rathiráḥ ǀ yāsi ǀ sā́dhan ǁ

Sukta 1.translation: “You,Agni, are the commendable announcer of the gods, cognizant of all sacred rites; plural cid, you abide among mortals, and, like a charioteer, you follow the gods, accomplishing (their wishes).”
Sukta 1.sanskrit_wisdomlib: आ दे॒वाना॑मभवः के॒तुर॑ग्ने म॒न्द्रो विश्वा॑नि॒ काव्या॑नि वि॒द्वान् । प्रति॒ मर्ताँ॑ अवासयो॒ दमू॑ना॒ अनु॑ दे॒वान्र॑थि॒रो या॑सि॒ साध॑न्

devanagari.text: नि दुरोणे अमृतो मर्त्यानां राजा ससाद विदथानि साधन् ।घृतप्रतीक उर्विया व्यद्यौदग्निर्विश्वानि काव्यानि विद्वान् ॥

transliteration.text: ní ǀ duroṇé ǀ amṛ́taḥ ǀ mártyānām ǀ rā́jā ǀ sasāda ǀ vidáthāni ǀ sā́dhan ǀghṛtá-pratīkaḥ ǀ urviyā́ ǀ ví ǀ adyaut ǀ agníḥ ǀ víśvāni ǀ kā́vyāni ǀ vidvā́n ǁ

Sukta 1.translation: “The immortal being has sat down in the dwelling of mortals, accomplishing (their) sacrifices;Agni, who is cognizant of all sacred rites, shines with expanded bulk when fed with clarified butter.”
Sukta 1.sanskrit_wisdomlib: नि दु॑रो॒णे अ॒मृतो॒ मर्त्या॑नां॒ राजा॑ ससाद वि॒दथा॑नि॒ साध॑न् । घृ॒तप्र॑तीक उर्वि॒या व्य॑द्यौद॒ग्निर्विश्वा॑नि॒ काव्या॑नि वि॒द्वान्

Sukta 1.translation: “Come to us with friendly, auspicious, and mighty aids, you who are great and all-pervading; besto wupon us ample riches, safe from injury, well-spoken of, desirable, and renowned.”

Sukta 1.translation: “I address to you,Agni, who are of old, these eternal as well as recent adorations; these solemn sacrifices are offered to the showerer of benefits, who in every birth is established (among men), cognizant of all that exists.”

Sukta 1.translation: “The undecayingJātavedas, who in every birth is established (among men), is kindled by theViśvāmitras; may we, (enjoying) his favour, ever be (held) in the auspicious good-will of that adorable (deity).”

Sukta 1.translation: “PowerfulAgni, (fulfiller) of good works, convey, rejoicing this our sacrifice towards the gods; invoker of the gods, bestow upon us abundant food; grant us, Agni, great wealth.”

Sukta 1.translation: “Grant,Agni, to the offerer of the oblation, the earth, the bestower of cattle, the means of many (pious rites), such that it may be perpetual; may there be to us sons and grandsons born in our race, and may your good-will ever be upon us.”

Sukta 2.translation: “Agni, of purifying lustre, invoker of the gods, men desirous of worshipping (you), having strewn the sacred grass, repair to your appropriate abode at sacrifices; bestow upon them wealth.”

Sukta 4.translation: “Tanūnapāt, whom the deities,Mitra,VaruṇaandAgni, worship daily thrice a day, render this our sacred rain-engendering sacrifice productive of water.”
Sukta 4.sanskrit_wisdomlib: यं दे॒वास॒स्त्रिरह॑न्ना॒यज॑न्ते दि॒वेदि॑वे॒ वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॒ग्निः । सेमं य॒ज्ञं मधु॑मन्तं कृधी न॒स्तनू॑नपाद्घृ॒तयो॑निं वि॒धन्त॑म्

devanagari.text: प्र दीधितिर्विश्ववारा जिगाति होतारमिळः प्रथमं यजध्यै ।अच्छा नमोभिर्वृषभं वंदध्यै स देवान्यक्षदिषितो यजीयान् ॥

Sukta 4.translation: “May the all-approved praise reach the invoker of the gods; may Iḷā first proceed to worship and to praise with prostrations the showerer (of benefits) in his presence; may the adorable (Agni), instrumental gated (by us), worship the gods.”
