Sukta 4.translation: “An upward path has been prepared for you both in the sacrifice; the blazing oblations soar aloft; the invoker of the gods has sat down in the centre of the radiant (hall); let us strew the sacred grass for the seats of the gods.”
Sukta 4.sanskrit_wisdomlib: ऊ॒र्ध्वो वां॑ गा॒तुर॑ध्व॒रे अ॑कार्यू॒र्ध्वा शो॒चींषि॒ प्रस्थि॑ता॒ रजां॑सि । दि॒वो वा॒ नाभा॒ न्य॑सादि॒ होता॑ स्तृणी॒महि॑ दे॒वव्य॑चा॒ वि ब॒र्हिः

Sukta 4.translation: “The gods who gratify the universe with rain are present at the seven offerings (of the ministering priests), when solicited with (sincerity of) mind; may the many deities who are engendered in sensible shapes at sacrifices come to this our rite.”

Sukta 4.translation: “May the adored Day and Night, combined or separate, be manifest in bodily form, so thatMitra,Varuṇa,Indra, or (the latter), attended by theMaruts, may rejoice us by their glories.”

Sukta 4.translation: “I propitiate the two chief divine invokers of the gods; the seven offerers of (sacrificial) food, expectant of water, gratify (Agni) with oblations; the illustrious observers of sacred rites have saluted him in every ceremony as (identifiable), verily, with water.”

Sukta 4.translation: “MayBhāratī, associated with theBhāratīs; Iḷā with the gods and men; andAgni, andSarasvatīwith theSārasvatas; may the three goddesses sit down upon the sacred grass (strewn) before them.”

Sukta 4.translation: “DivineTvaṣṭā, being well plural ased, give issue to our procreative vigour, whence (a son), manly, devout, vigorous, wielder of the (Soma-bruising) stone, and reverencing the gods, may be born.”

Sukta 4.translation: “Vanaspati, bring the gods nigh; mayAgni, the immolator, prepare the victim; let him who is truth officiate as the ministering priest, for, verily, he knows the birth of the gods.”

Sukta 4.translation: “Agni, kindled into flame, come to our presence in the same chariot withIndraand with the swift-moving gods; mayAditi, the mother of excellent sons, sit down on the sacred grass, and may the immortal gods be satisfied with the reverentially-offered oblation.”

Sukta 5.translation: “The sagaciousAgni, cognizant of the dawn, is awakened to (follow) the paths of the sages; the luminousVahni, kindled by the devout, has thrown open the gates of darkness.”

Sukta 5.translation: “The adorableAgniis magnified by the hymns, the prayers, the praises, of (his) worshippers; emulating the many glories of the sun, the messenger (of the gods) shines forth at the glimmering of the dawn.”
Sukta 5.sanskrit_wisdomlib: प्रेद्व॒ग्निर्वा॑वृधे॒ स्तोमे॑भिर्गी॒र्भिः स्तो॑तॄ॒णां न॑म॒स्य॑ उ॒क्थैः । पू॒र्वीॠ॒तस्य॑ सं॒दृश॑श्चका॒नः सं दू॒तो अ॑द्यौदु॒षसो॑ विरो॒के

devanagari.text: अधाय्यग्निर्मानुषीषु विक्ष्वपां गर्भो मित्र ऋतेन साधन् ।आ हर्यतो यजतः सान्वस्थादभूदु विप्रो हव्यो मतीनां ॥

Sukta 5.translation: “Agni, the embryo of the waters, the friend (of the pious), accomplishing (all desires) with truth, has been plural ced (by the gods) among men, the descendants ofManu; desirable and adorable, he has taken his station on high, where the wise Agni is to receive the oblations of the devout.”
Sukta 5.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अधा॑य्य॒ग्निर्मानु॑षीषु वि॒क्ष्व१॒॑पां गर्भो॑ मि॒त्र ऋ॒तेन॒ साध॑न् । आ ह॑र्य॒तो य॑ज॒तः सान्व॑स्था॒दभू॑दु॒ विप्रो॒ हव्यो॑ मती॒नाम्

devanagari.text: मित्रो अग्निर्भवति यत्समिद्धो मित्रो होता वरुणो जातवेदाः ।मित्रो अध्वर्युरिषिरो दमूना मित्रः सिंधूनामुत पर्वतानां ॥

Sukta 5.translation: “Agni, when kindled, isMitra; and, as Mitra, is the invoker (of the gods);VaruṇaisJātavedas; Mitra is the ministering priest; Damunas is the agitator (Vāyu); Mitra (is the associate) of rivers and mountains.”
Sukta 5.sanskrit_wisdomlib: मि॒त्रो अ॒ग्निर्भ॑वति॒ यत्समि॑द्धो मि॒त्रो होता॒ वरु॑णो जा॒तवे॑दाः । मि॒त्रो अ॑ध्व॒र्युरि॑षि॒रो दमू॑ना मि॒त्रः सिन्धू॑नामु॒त पर्व॑तानाम्

devanagari.text: पाति प्रियं रिपो अग्रं पदं वेः पाति यह्वश्चरणं सूर्यस्य ।पाति नाभा सप्तशीर्षाणमग्निः पाति देवानामुपमादमृष्वः ॥

transliteration.text: pā́ti ǀ priyám ǀ ripáḥ ǀ ágram ǀ padám ǀ véḥ ǀ pā́ti ǀ yahváḥ ǀ cáraṇam ǀ sū́ryasya ǀpā́ti ǀ nā́bhā ǀ saptá-śīrṣāṇam ǀ agníḥ ǀ pā́ti ǀ devā́nām ǀ upa-mā́dam ǀ ṛṣváḥ ǁ

Sukta 5.translation: “The graceful (Agni) protects the primary station of the moving earth; mighty, he protects the path of the sun; he protects the seven-headed (troop of theMaruts) in the centre between heaven and earth; he protects the exhilarating (oblations) of the gods.”
Sukta 5.sanskrit_wisdomlib: पाति॑ प्रि॒यं रि॒पो अग्रं॑ प॒दं वेः पाति॑ य॒ह्वश्चर॑णं॒ सूर्य॑स्य । पाति॒ नाभा॑ स॒प्तशी॑र्षाणम॒ग्निः पाति॑ दे॒वाना॑मुप॒माद॑मृ॒ष्वः

devanagari.text: ऋभुश्चक्र ईड्यं चारु नाम विश्वानि देवो वयुनानि विद्वान् ।ससस्य चर्म घृतवत्पदं वेस्तदिदग्नी रक्षत्यप्रयुच्छन् ॥

transliteration.text: ṛbhúḥ ǀ cakre ǀ ī́ḍyam ǀ cā́ru ǀ nā́ma ǀ víśvāni ǀ deváḥ ǀ vayúnāni ǀ vidvā́n ǀsasásya ǀ cárma ǀ ghṛtá-vat ǀ padám ǀ véḥ ǀ tát ǀ ít ǀ agníḥ ǀ rakṣati ǀ ápra-yucchan ǁ

Sukta 5.translation: “The mighty, divineAgniknowing all (things) that are to be known, made the commendable and beautiful water, the glossy skin, the station of the diffused slumbering (Agni), and, ever vigilant preserves it.”
Sukta 5.sanskrit_wisdomlib: ऋ॒भुश्च॑क्र॒ ईड्यं॒ चारु॒ नाम॒ विश्वा॑नि दे॒वो व॒युना॑नि वि॒द्वान् । स॒सस्य॒ चर्म॑ घृ॒तव॑त्प॒दं वेस्तदिद॒ग्नी र॑क्ष॒त्यप्र॑युच्छन्

devanagari.text: आ योनिमग्निर्घृतवंतमस्थात्पृथुप्रगाणमुशंतमुशानः ।दीद्यानः शुचिर्ऋष्वः पावकः पुनःपुनर्मातरा नव्यसी कः ॥

transliteration.text: ā́ ǀ yónim ǀ agníḥ ǀ ghṛtá-vantam ǀ asthāt ǀ pṛthú-pragānam ǀ uśántam ǀ uśānáḥ ǀdī́dyānaḥ ǀ śúciḥ ǀ ṛṣváḥ ǀ pāvakáḥ ǀ púnaḥ-punaḥ ǀ mātárā ǀ návyasī íti ǀ karíti kaḥ ǁ

Sukta 5.translation: “Agnihas taken his station in an asylum, brilliant, much-lauded, and as desirous (of receiving him) as he is (torepair to it); radiant, pure, vast and purifying, he repeatedly renovates his parents, (Heaven and Earth).”
Sukta 5.sanskrit_wisdomlib: आ योनि॑म॒ग्निर्घृ॒तव॑न्तमस्थात्पृ॒थुप्र॑गाणमु॒शन्त॑मुशा॒नः । दीद्या॑न॒: शुचि॑ॠ॒ष्वः पा॑व॒कः पुन॑:पुनर्मा॒तरा॒ नव्य॑सी कः

Sukta 5.translation: “As soon as genitive rated he is borne aloft by the plural nts, which grow flourishing by moisture, as the beautifying waters descend; may he, in the bosom of his parents, protect us.”
Sukta 5.sanskrit_wisdomlib: स॒द्यो जा॒त ओष॑धीभिर्ववक्षे॒ यदी॒ वर्ध॑न्ति प्र॒स्वो॑ घृ॒तेन॑ । आप॑ इव प्र॒वता॒ शुम्भ॑माना उरु॒ष्यद॒ग्निः पि॒त्रोरु॒पस्थे॑

devanagari.text: उदु ष्टुतः समिधा यह्वो अद्यौद्वर्ष्मंदिवो अधि नाभा पृथिव्याः ।मित्रो अग्निरीड्यो मातरिश्वा दूतो वक्षद्यजथाय देवान् ॥

Sukta 5.translation: “Praised and (nourished) by fuel, the mightyAgni, stationed on the (altar the) navel of the earth, in the form of the firmament, has shone (brightly); may the friendly and adorable Agni who respires in the mid-heaven, the messenger (of the gods), bring them to the sacrifice.”
Sukta 5.sanskrit_wisdomlib: उदु॑ ष्टु॒तः स॒मिधा॑ य॒ह्वो अ॑द्यौ॒द्वर्ष्म॑न्दि॒वो अधि॒ नाभा॑ पृथि॒व्याः । मि॒त्रो अ॒ग्निरीड्यो॑ मात॒रिश्वा दू॒तो व॑क्षद्य॒जथा॑य दे॒वान्

devanagari.text: उदस्तंभीत्समिधा नाकमृष्वोऽग्निर्भवन्नुत्तमो रोचनानां ।यदी भृगुभ्यः परि मातरिश्वा गुहा संतं हव्यवाहं समीधे ॥

Sukta 5.translation: “The mightyAgni, being the best of the heavenly luminaries, sustained the heaven with radiance, when the wind kindled the bearer of oblations, (till then concealed) in a cave from theBhṛgus.”
Sukta 5.sanskrit_wisdomlib: उद॑स्तम्भीत्स॒मिधा॒ नाक॑मृ॒ष्वो॒३॒॑ऽग्निर्भव॑न्नुत्त॒मो रो॑च॒नाना॑म् । यदी॒ भृगु॑भ्य॒: परि॑ मात॒रिश्वा॒ गुहा॒ सन्तं॑ हव्य॒वाहं॑ समी॒धे

transliteration.text: íḷām ǀ agne ǀ puru-dáṃsam ǀ saním ǀ góḥ ǀ śaśvat-tamám ǀ hávamānāya ǀ sādha ǀsyā́t ǀ naḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ tánayaḥ ǀ vijā́-vā ǀ agne ǀ sā́ ǀ te ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ bhūtu ǀ asmé íti ǁ

Sukta 5.translation: “Grant,Agni, to the offerer of the oblation the earth, the bestower of cattle, the means of many (pious rites); such that it may be perpetual; may there be to us sons and grandsons born in our race, and may your good-will ever be upon us.”
Sukta 5.sanskrit_wisdomlib: इळा॑मग्ने पुरु॒दंसं॑ स॒निं गोः श॑श्वत्त॒मं हव॑मानाय साध । स्यान्न॑: सू॒नुस्तन॑यो वि॒जावाग्ने॒ सा ते॑ सुम॒तिर्भू॑त्व॒स्मे

devanagari.text: प्र कारवो मनना वच्यमाना देवद्रीचीं नयत देवयंतः ।दक्षिणावाड्वाजिनी प्राच्येति हविर्भरंत्यग्नये घृताची ॥

transliteration.text: prá ǀ kāravaḥ ǀ mananā́ ǀ vacyámānāḥ ǀ devadrī́cīn ǀ nayata ǀ deva-yántaḥ ǀdakṣiṇā-vā́ṭ ǀ vājínī ǀ prā́cī ǀ eti ǀ havíḥ ǀ bhárantī ǀ agnáye ǀ ghṛtā́cī ǁ

Sukta 6.translation: “Devout ministrants, who are to be inspired by prayer, bring forth (the ladle) destined for the worship of the gods, which is to be conveyed to the south (of the fire-altar), and which, charged with (sacrificial) food, pointed to the east, containing the oblation, and, filled with liquefied butter, proceeds toAgni.”
Sukta 6.sanskrit_wisdomlib: प्र का॑रवो मन॒ना व॒च्यमा॑ना देव॒द्रीचीं॑ नयत देव॒यन्त॑: । द॒क्षि॒णा॒वाड्वा॒जिनी॒ प्राच्ये॑ति ह॒विर्भर॑न्त्य॒ग्नये॑ घृ॒ताची॑

devanagari.text: आ रोदसी अपृणा जायमान उत प्र रिक्था अध नु प्रयज्यो ।दिवश्चिदग्ने महिना पृथिव्या वच्यंतां ते वह्नयः सप्तजिह्वाः ॥

Sukta 6.translation: “Agni, as soon as born, occupy both heaven and earth; for you, to whom sacrifice is to be offered, exceed in magnitude the firmament and the earth; may your seven-tongued fires be glorified.”

Sukta 6.translation: “The firmament and the earth and the adorable (gods) propitiate you their invoker, for the (completion of the) sacrifice, whenever the descendants ofManu, pious, and bearing oblations, glorify your radiant flame.”

Sukta 6.translation: “The great and adorableAgniis firm seated on his spacious throne between heaven and earth; and the powerful fellow-brides (of the sun), the imperishable uninjurable (heaven and earth) are the two milk-yielding cows of the wide-extending (Agni).”

Sukta 6.translation: “Great,Agni, are the deeds of you the mighty one; you have spread abroad by your power the heaven and earth; you have been the messenger (of the gods); as soon as begotten you have become the leader of men.”

Sukta 6.translation: “Harness with traces, to your car, your long-maned, ruddy (steeds, to come) to the sacrifice; bring hither, divineJātavedas, all the gods, and make them propitious to the oblation.”

Sukta 6.translation: “When,Agni, you abide in the woods, consuming the waters at your plural asure, then your rays illuminate the heavens, and you shine like many former radiant dawns; the gods themselves commend (the brilliancy) of their praise-meriting invoker.”

Sukta 6.translation: “The deities who sport in the spacious (firmament); those who are in the luminous sphere of heaven; the adorable Umas, who come when worthily invoked; the horses,Agni, that are fit for your car.”

Sukta 6.translation: “With all these in one chariot,Agni, or in many (chariots), come to our presence, for your horses are able; bring the three and thirty divinities with their wives, for the sake of (the sacrificial) food, and exhilarate them (all with theSoma).”

Sukta 6.translation: “He is the invoker (of the gods), whom the spacious heaven and earth glorify, for the sake of increase, at repeated sacrifices; charged with water, they await like holy rites, propitious to the real presence of him who is born of truth. ”

Sukta 6.translation: “Grant,Agni, to the offerer of the oblation, the earth, the bestower of cattle, the means of many (pious rites); such that it may be perpetual; may there be to us sons and grandsons born in our race, and may our good-will ever be upon us.”

Sukta 7.translation: “The (rays) of the blackbacked, all-sustaining (Agni) have arisen, and pervaded the parents (earth and heaven) and the flowing rivers; the surrounding parents co-operate with him, and bestow long life for the sake of assiduous worship.”
Sukta 7.sanskrit_wisdomlib: प्र य आ॒रुः शि॑तिपृ॒ष्ठस्य॑ धा॒सेरा मा॒तरा॑ विविशुः स॒प्त वाणी॑: । प॒रि॒क्षिता॑ पि॒तरा॒ सं च॑रेते॒ प्र स॑र्स्राते दी॒र्घमायु॑: प्र॒यक्षे॑

transliteration.text: divákṣasaḥ ǀ dhenávaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣṇaḥ ǀ áśvāḥ ǀ devī́ḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ tasthau ǀ mádhu-mat ǀ váhantīḥ ǀṛtásya ǀ tvā ǀ sádasi ǀ kṣema-yántam ǀ pári ǀ ékā ǀ carati ǀ vartaním ǀ gáuḥ ǁ

Sukta 7.translation: “The sky-traversing steeds of the showerer (of benefits) are the kine (ofAgni); as he attains the divine (rivers), bearers of sweet (water). One sacred soudn glorifies you (Agni), who are desirous of repose, pacifying your flames) in the abode of the water (the firmament).”
Sukta 7.sanskrit_wisdomlib: दि॒वक्ष॑सो धे॒नवो॒ वृष्णो॒ अश्वा॑ दे॒वीरा त॑स्थौ॒ मधु॑म॒द्वह॑न्तीः । ऋ॒तस्य॑ त्वा॒ सद॑सि क्षेम॒यन्तं॒ पर्येका॑ चरति वर्त॒निं गौः

Sukta 7.translation: “Their lord has mounted on his well-trained mares the sagacious selector of treasures, the blackbacked, many-limbed (Agni) has granted them a plural ce of rest for the cherishing of (their) rapid speed.”
Sukta 7.sanskrit_wisdomlib: आ सी॑मरोहत्सु॒यमा॒ भव॑न्ती॒: पति॑श्चिकि॒त्वान्र॑यि॒विद्र॑यी॒णाम् । प्र नील॑पृष्ठो अत॒सस्य॑ धा॒सेस्ता अ॑वासयत्पुरु॒धप्र॑तीकः

Sukta 7.translation: “The flowing (rivers) invigorating him, bear along the great son ofTvaṣṭā, the undecaying upholder (of the world), radiant with various forms in the vicinity (of the firmament);Agniis associated with heaven and earth, as (a husband with) one only wife.”
Sukta 7.sanskrit_wisdomlib: महि॑ त्वा॒ष्ट्रमू॒र्जय॑न्तीरजु॒र्यं स्त॑भू॒यमा॑नं व॒हतो॑ वहन्ति । व्यङ्गे॑भिर्दिद्युता॒नः स॒धस्थ॒ एका॑मिव॒ रोद॑सी॒ आ वि॑वेश

devanagari.text: जानंति वृष्णो अरुषस्य शेवमुत ब्रध्नस्य शासने रणंति ।दिवोरुचः सुरुचो रोचमाना इळा येषां गण्या माहिना गीः ॥

Sukta 7.translation: “Men comprehend the service of the uninjurable showerer (of benefits), and exult in the commands of the mighty (Agni); their frequent and earnest hymns of praise, bright and radiant, are illuminating heaven.”
Sukta 7.sanskrit_wisdomlib: जा॒नन्ति॒ वृष्णो॑ अरु॒षस्य॒ शेव॑मु॒त ब्र॒ध्नस्य॒ शास॑ने रणन्ति । दि॒वो॒रुच॑: सु॒रुचो॒ रोच॑माना॒ इळा॒ येषां॒ गण्या॒ माहि॑ना॒ गीः

devanagari.text: उतो पितृभ्यां प्रविदानु घोषं महो महद्भ्यामनयंत शूषं ।उक्षा ह यत्र परि धानमक्तोरनु स्वं धाम जरितुर्ववक्ष ॥

Sukta 7.translation: “Verily (men) bring great delight toAgniby glorifying aloud the mighty parents (heaven and earth), when the shedder of rain approximates his own radiance to the worshipper, (wherewith) to invest the night.”
Sukta 7.sanskrit_wisdomlib: उ॒तो पि॒तृभ्यां॑ प्र॒विदानु॒ घोषं॑ म॒हो म॒हद्भ्या॑मनयन्त शू॒षम् । उ॒क्षा ह॒ यत्र॒ परि॒ धान॑म॒क्तोरनु॒ स्वं धाम॑ जरि॒तुर्व॒वक्ष॑

devanagari.text: अध्वर्युभिः पंचभिः सप्त विप्राः प्रियं रक्षंते निहितं पदं वेः ।प्रांचो मदंत्युक्षणो अजुर्या देवा देवानामनु हि व्रता गुः ॥

Sukta 7.translation: “Seven sages with five ministering priests attend the station that is prepared for the rapid (Agni); the undecaying divine (sages), with their faces to the east, sprinkling (the libations), rejoice as they celebrate the worship of the gods.”
Sukta 7.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒ध्व॒र्युभि॑: प॒ञ्चभि॑: स॒प्त विप्रा॑: प्रि॒यं र॑क्षन्ते॒ निहि॑तं प॒दं वेः । प्राञ्चो॑ मदन्त्यु॒क्षणो॑ अजु॒र्या दे॒वा दे॒वाना॒मनु॒ हि व्र॒ता गुः

devanagari.text: दैव्या होतारा प्रथमा न्यृंजे सप्त पृक्षासः स्वधया मदंति ।ऋतं शंसंत ऋतमित्त आहुरनु व्रतं व्रतपा दीध्यानाः ॥

Sukta 7.translation: “I propitiate the two first divine offerers of sacrifices; the seven (priests) rejoice with the libation; the illustrious celebrators of holy worship, reciting (his) praises, have calledAgnithe true (object) of every rite.”
Sukta 7.sanskrit_wisdomlib: दैव्या॒ होता॑रा प्रथ॒मा न्यृ॑ञ्जे स॒प्त पृ॒क्षास॑: स्व॒धया॑ मदन्ति । ऋ॒तं शंस॑न्त ऋ॒तमित्त आ॑हु॒रनु॑ व्र॒तं व्र॑त॒पा दीध्या॑नाः

Sukta 7.translation: “Divine invoker of the gods, the vast and widespreading rays shed (moisture) for you, the mighty, the victorius, the wonderful, the showerer (of benefits); do you who are all knowing, joy-bestowing, bring hither the great gods, and heaven and earth.”
Sukta 7.sanskrit_wisdomlib: वृ॒षा॒यन्ते॑ म॒हे अत्या॑य पू॒र्वीर्वृष्णे॑ चि॒त्राय॑ र॒श्मय॑: सुया॒माः । देव॑ होतर्म॒न्द्रत॑रश्चिकि॒त्वान्म॒हो दे॒वान्रोद॑सी॒ एह व॑क्षि

Sukta 7.translation: “Ever-moving (Agni) may the mornings rise for us, abounding with oblations, with pious prayers, and with auspicious signs, and conferring wealth; and do you with the might of your (diffusive flame), consume all sin on behalf of your respectable (worshipper).”
Sukta 7.sanskrit_wisdomlib: पृ॒क्षप्र॑यजो द्रविणः सु॒वाच॑: सुके॒तव॑ उ॒षसो॑ रे॒वदू॑षुः । उ॒तो चि॑दग्ने महि॒ना पृ॑थि॒व्याः कृ॒तं चि॒देन॒: सं म॒हे द॑शस्य

Sukta 7.translation: “Grant,Agni, to the offerer of the oblation, the earth, the bestower of cattle, the means of many (pious rites), such that it may be perpetual; may there be to us sons and grandsons, and may your good-will ever be upon us (productive of benefit to us).”
Sukta 7.sanskrit_wisdomlib: इळा॑मग्ने पुरु॒दंसं॑ स॒निं गोः श॑श्वत्त॒मं हव॑मानाय साध । स्यान्न॑: सू॒नुस्तन॑यो वि॒जावाग्ने॒ सा ते॑ सुम॒तिर्भू॑त्व॒स्मे

Sukta 8.translation: “Vanaspati, the devout anoint you with sacred butter at the sacrifice; and whether you stand erect, or your abode be on the lap of this your mother (earth), grant us riches.”

Sukta 9.translation: “You wish exceedingly to convey satisfaction (to your worshippers) and are thereto well-disposed; of those in whose friendship you are cherished, some precede while others sit around.”

Sukta 9.translation: “The benignant and long-lived deities have discovered you,Agni, when required to go against their constant and assembled foes, hidden in the waters like a lion (in a cave).”

Sukta 9.translation: “Mātariśvantherefore brought for the gods from afar,Agni, hiding of himself, and genitive rated by attrition, as (a father brings back) a fugitive (son).”
Sukta 9.sanskrit_wisdomlib: स॒सृ॒वांस॑मिव॒ त्मना॒ग्निमि॒त्था ति॒रोहि॑तम् । ऐनं॑ नयन्मात॒रिश्वा॑ परा॒वतो॑ दे॒वेभ्यो॑ मथि॒तं परि॑

Sukta 9.translation: “Bearer of oblations,men apprehend you (thus concealed) for the service of the gods, and that you youngest (of the deities) and friendly to manking, may recompense by your acts all their pious rites.”
Sukta 9.sanskrit_wisdomlib: तं त्वा॒ मर्ता॑ अगृभ्णत दे॒वेभ्यो॑ हव्यवाहन । विश्वा॒न्यद्य॒ज्ञाँ अ॑भि॒पासि॑ मानुष॒ तव॒ क्रत्वा॑ यविष्ठ्य

devanagari.text: तद्भद्रं तव दंसना पाकाय चिच्छदयति ।त्वां यदग्ने पशवः समासते समिद्धमपिशर्वरे ॥

Sukta 9.translation: “Auspicious is your worship for it prospers the ignorant (worshipper), wherefore animals reverence, youAgni, kindled in the beginning of the night.”
Sukta 9.sanskrit_wisdomlib: तद्भ॒द्रं तव॑ दं॒सना॒ पाका॑य चिच्छदयति । त्वां यद॑ग्ने प॒शव॑: स॒मास॑ते॒ समि॑द्धमपिशर्व॒रे

Sukta 9.translation: “Offer oblations to the object of holy sacrifice, the brilliant purifier, who is dormant (in fuel); worship quietly the pervader (of the rite), the messenger (of the gods), the rapid, the ancient deity who is entitled to laudation.”
Sukta 9.sanskrit_wisdomlib: आ जु॑होता स्वध्व॒रं शी॒रं पा॑व॒कशो॑चिषम् । आ॒शुं दू॒तम॑जि॒रं प्र॒त्नमीड्यं॑ श्रु॒ष्टी दे॒वं स॑पर्यत

Sukta 9.translation: “Three thousand three hundred and thirty-nine divinities have worshippedAgni; they have sprinkled him with melted butter; they have spread for him the sacred grass; and have seated him upon it as their ministrant priest.”

devanagari.text: त्वामग्ने मनीषिणः सम्राजं चर्षणीनां ।देवं मर्तास इंधते समध्वरे ॥

Sukta 10.translation: “You, the king of men;Agni, the divine; prudent mortals kindle you at the sacrifice.”

Sukta 10.translation: “May ourhymns exaltAgni, so that he may be born more worthy of praise, and may become manifest for the purpose of (bestowing) abundant food and riches.”

Sukta 10.translation: “Agni, you are to be especially worshipped at the sacrifice; worship the gods (on behalf of) the devout (worshiper); you shine the invoker (of the gods) the exhilarator (of the pious) overcoming your foes.”

Sukta 10.translation: “Do you, our purifier, light up for us a brilliant progeny; be ever nigh to those who praise you for their well-being.”

Sukta 10.translation: “The wise, intelligent, and vigilant (worshipers) kindle you, such as you (have been described), the bearer of oblations, the immortal, genitive rated by strength.”
Sukta 10.sanskrit_wisdomlib: तं त्वा॒ विप्रा॑ विप॒न्यवो॑ जागृ॒वांस॒: समि॑न्धते । ह॒व्य॒वाह॒मम॑र्त्यं सहो॒वृध॑म्

devanagari.text: अग्निर्होता पुरोहितोऽध्वरस्य विचर्षणिः ।स वेद यज्ञमानुषक् ॥
अग्निः । होता । पुरःऽहितः । अध्वरस्य । विऽचर्षणिः ।सः । वेद । यज्ञम् । आनुषक् ॥

transliteration.text: agníḥ ǀ hótā ǀ puráḥ-hitaḥ ǀ adhvarásya ǀ ví-carṣaṇiḥ ǀsáḥ ǀ veda ǀ yajñám ǀ ānuṣák ǁ

Sukta 11.translation: “Agni, the invoker of the gods, the minister (of the gods), the supervisor of the sacrifice, understands the solemn rite in its due course.”
Sukta 11.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒ग्निर्होता॑ पु॒रोहि॑तोऽध्व॒रस्य॒ विच॑र्षणिः । स वे॑द य॒ज्ञमा॑नु॒षक्

devanagari.text: स हव्यवाळमर्त्य उशिग्दूतश्चनोहितः ।अग्निर्धिया समृण्वति ॥
सः । हव्यऽवाट् । अमर्त्यः । उशिक् । दूतः । चनःऽहितः ।अग्निः । धिया । सम् । ऋण्वति ॥

transliteration.text: sáḥ ǀ havya-vā́ṭ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀ uśík ǀ dūtáḥ ǀ cánaḥ-hitaḥ ǀagníḥ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ sám ǀ ṛṇvati ǁ

Sukta 11.translation: “ThatAgni, who is the bearer of oblations, the immortal, the desirer (of offerings), the messenger (of the gods), and is the receiver of sacrificial viands, is associated with understanding.”
Sukta 11.sanskrit_wisdomlib: स ह॑व्य॒वाळम॑र्त्य उ॒शिग्दू॒तश्चनो॑हितः । अ॒ग्निर्धि॒या समृ॑ण्वति

devanagari.text: अग्निर्धिया स चेतति केतुर्यज्ञस्य पूर्व्यः ।अर्थं ह्यस्य तरणि ॥
अग्निः । धिया । सः । चेतति । केतुः । यज्ञस्य । पूर्व्यः ।अर्थम् । हि । अस्य । तरणि ॥

transliteration.text: agníḥ ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ cetati ǀ ketúḥ ǀ yajñásya ǀ pūrvyáḥ ǀártham ǀ hí ǀ asya ǀ taráṇi ǁ

Sukta 11.translation: “Agni, the ancient banner (flag) of sacrifice, knows (all things) through understanding; his radiance traverses (the darkness).”
Sukta 11.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒ग्निर्धि॒या स चे॑तति के॒तुर्य॒ज्ञस्य॑ पू॒र्व्यः । अर्थं॒ ह्य॑स्य त॒रणि॑

devanagari.text: अग्निं सूनुं सनश्रुतं सहसो जातवेदसं ।वह्निं देवा अकृण्वत ॥
अग्निम् । सूनुम् । सनऽश्रुतम् । सहसः । जातऽवेदसम् ।वह्निम् । देवाः । अकृण्वत ॥

transliteration.text: agním ǀ sūnúm ǀ sána-śrutam ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ jātá-vedasam ǀváhnim ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ akṛṇvata ǁ

Sukta 11.translation: “The gods have madeAgni, who is the son of strength, the eternally-renowned, the knower of all that is born, the bearer (of oblations).”
Sukta 11.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒ग्निं सू॒नुं सन॑श्रुतं॒ सह॑सो जा॒तवे॑दसम् । वह्निं॑ दे॒वा अ॑कृण्वत

devanagari.text: अदाभ्यः पुरएता विशामग्निर्मानुषीणां ।तूर्णी रथः सदा नवः ॥
अदाभ्यः । पुरःऽएता । विशाम् । अग्निः । मानुषीणाम् ।तूर्णिः । रथः । सदा । नवः ॥

transliteration.text: ádābhyaḥ ǀ puraḥ-etā́ ǀ viśā́m ǀ agníḥ ǀ mā́nuṣīṇām ǀtū́rṇiḥ ǀ ráthaḥ ǀ sádā ǀ návaḥ ǁ

Sukta 11.translation: “Agni, the preceder of human beings, (ever) alert, the vehicle of their offerings, is ever new, is unsusceptible of harm.”
Sukta 11.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अदा॑भ्यः पुरए॒ता वि॒शाम॒ग्निर्मानु॑षीणाम् । तूर्णी॒ रथ॒: सदा॒ नव॑:

devanagari.text: साह्वान्विश्वा अभियुजः क्रतुर्देवानाममृक्तः ।अग्निस्तुविश्रवस्तमः ॥
सह्वान् । विश्वाः । अभिऽयुजः । क्रतुः । देवानाम् । अमृक्तः ।अग्निः । तुविश्रवःऽतमः ॥

transliteration.text: sahvā́n ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ abhi-yújaḥ ǀ krátuḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ ámṛktaḥ ǀagníḥ ǀ tuvíśravaḥ-tamaḥ ǁ

Sukta 11.translation: “Agni, the most liberal contributor of food, is able to resist all assailants unharmed, the nourisher of the gods.”
Sukta 11.sanskrit_wisdomlib: सा॒ह्वान्विश्वा॑ अभि॒युज॒: क्रतु॑र्दे॒वाना॒ममृ॑क्तः । अ॒ग्निस्तु॒विश्र॑वस्तमः

devanagari.text: अभि प्रयांसि वाहसा दाश्वाँ अश्नोति मर्त्यः ।क्षयं पावकशोचिषः ॥
अभि । प्रयांसि । वाहसा । दाश्वान् । अश्नोति । मर्त्यः ।क्षयम् । पावकऽशोचिषः ॥

transliteration.text: abhí ǀ práyāṃsi ǀ vā́hasā ǀ dāśvā́n ǀ aśnoti ǀ mártyaḥ ǀkṣáyam ǀ pāvaká-śociṣaḥ ǁ

Sukta 11.translation: “FromAgniof purifying radiance the mortal presenter (of offerings) obtains by his conveyance (of them to the gods) abundant viands and a dwelling.”
Sukta 11.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒भि प्रयां॑सि॒ वाह॑सा दा॒श्वाँ अ॑श्नोति॒ मर्त्य॑: । क्षयं॑ पाव॒कशो॑चिषः

devanagari.text: परि विश्वानि सुधिताग्नेरश्याम मन्मभिः ।विप्रासो जातवेदसः ॥
परि । विश्वानि । सुऽधिता । अग्नेः । अश्याम । मन्मऽभिः ।विप्रासः । जातऽवेदसः ॥

transliteration.text: pári ǀ víśvāni ǀ sú-dhitā ǀ agnéḥ ǀ aśyāma ǀ mánma-bhiḥ ǀvíprāsaḥ ǀ jātá-vedasaḥ ǁ

Sukta 11.translation: “May we, endowed with intelligence, obtain all good things by our praises ofAgni, to whom all is known.”
Sukta 11.sanskrit_wisdomlib: परि॒ विश्वा॑नि॒ सुधि॑ता॒ग्नेर॑श्याम॒ मन्म॑भिः । विप्रा॑सो जा॒तवे॑दसः

devanagari.text: अग्ने विश्वानि वार्या वाजेषु सनिषामहे ।त्वे देवास एरिरे ॥
अग्ने । विश्वानि । वार्या । वाजेषु । सनिषामहे ।त्वे इति । देवासः । आ । ईरिरे ॥

transliteration.text: ágne ǀ víśvāni ǀ vā́ryā ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ saniṣāmahe ǀtvé íti ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ īrire ǁ

Sukta 11.translation: “May we obtain,Agni, all precious things (as booty) in battles, since the gods are concentrated in you.”
Sukta 11.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अग्ने॒ विश्वा॑नि॒ वार्या॒ वाजे॑षु सनिषामहे । त्वे दे॒वास॒ एरि॑रे

devanagari.text: इंद्राग्नी आ गतं सुतं गीर्भिर्नभो वरेण्यं ।अस्य पातं धियेषिता ॥
इन्द्राग्नी इति । आ । गतम् । सुतम् । गीःऽभिः । नभः । वरेण्यम् ।अस्य । पातम् । धिया । इषिता ॥

transliteration.text: índrāgnī íti ǀ ā́ ǀ gatam ǀ sutám ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ nábhaḥ ǀ váreṇyam ǀasyá ǀ pātam ǀ dhiyā́ ǀ iṣitā́ ǁ

Sukta 12.translation: “IndraandAgni, come to this acceptable libation, (brought) by our praises from heaven, and induced by (our) devotion to drink of it.”
Sukta 12.sanskrit_wisdomlib: इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ आ ग॑तं सु॒तं गी॒र्भिर्नभो॒ वरे॑ण्यम् । अ॒स्य पा॑तं धि॒येषि॒ता

devanagari.text: इंद्राग्नी जरितुः सचा यज्ञो जिगाति चेतनः ।अया पातमिमं सुतं ॥
इन्द्राग्नी इति । जरितुः । सचा । यज्ञः । जिगाति । चेतनः ।अया । पातम् । इमम् । सुतम् ॥

transliteration.text: índrāgnī íti ǀ jaritúḥ ǀ sácā ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ jigāti ǀ cétanaḥ ǀayā́ ǀ pātam ǀ imám ǀ sutám ǁ

Sukta 12.translation: “IndraandAgni, the conscious sacrifice associated with the worshipper proceeds to you; (summoned) by this (invocation) drink the libation.”
Sukta 12.sanskrit_wisdomlib: इन्द्रा॑ग्नी जरि॒तुः सचा॑ य॒ज्ञो जि॑गाति॒ चेत॑नः । अ॒या पा॑तमि॒मं सु॒तम्

devanagari.text: इंद्रमग्निं कविच्छदा यज्ञस्य जूत्या वृणे ।ता सोमस्येह तृंपतां ॥
इन्द्रम् । अग्निम् । कविऽछदा । यज्ञस्य । जूत्या । वृणे ।ता । सोमस्य । इह । तृम्पताम् ॥

transliteration.text: índram ǀ agním ǀ kavi-chádā ǀ yajñásya ǀ jūtyā́ ǀ vṛṇe ǀtā́ ǀ sómasya ǀ ihá ǀ tṛmpatām ǁ

Sukta 12.translation: “Urged by the energy of the sacrifice, I have recourse toIndraandAgni, the protectors of the pious; may they be satiated with theSomahere presented.”
Sukta 12.sanskrit_wisdomlib: इन्द्र॑म॒ग्निं क॑वि॒च्छदा॑ य॒ज्ञस्य॑ जू॒त्या वृ॑णे । ता सोम॑स्ये॒ह तृ॑म्पताम्

devanagari.text: तोशा वृत्रहणा हुवे सजित्वानापराजिता ।इंद्राग्नी वाजसातमा ॥
तोशा । वृत्रऽहना । हुवे । सऽजित्वाना । अपराऽजिता ।इन्द्राग्नी इति । वाजऽसातमा ॥

transliteration.text: tośā́ ǀ vṛtra-hánā ǀ huve ǀ sa-jítvānā ǀ áparā-jitā ǀindrāgnī́ íti ǀ vāja-sā́tamā ǁ

Sukta 12.translation: “I invokeIndraandAgni, the discomfiters of foes, the destroyers ofVṛtra, the victorious, the invincible, the bestowers of most abundant food.”
Sukta 12.sanskrit_wisdomlib: तो॒शा वृ॑त्र॒हणा॑ हुवे स॒जित्वा॒नाप॑राजिता । इ॒न्द्रा॒ग्नी वा॑ज॒सात॑मा

devanagari.text: प्र वामर्चंत्युक्थिनो नीथाविदो जरितारः ।इंद्राग्नी इष आ वृणे ॥
प्र । वाम् । अर्चन्ति । उक्थिनः । नीथऽविदः । जरितारः ।इन्द्राग्नी इति । इषः । आ । वृणे ॥

transliteration.text: prá ǀ vām ǀ arcanti ǀ ukthínaḥ ǀ nītha-vídaḥ ǀ jaritā́raḥ ǀíndrāgnī íti ǀ íṣaḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ vṛṇe ǁ

Sukta 12.translation: “The reciters of prayers, the repeaters of praise, who are skilled in sacred song, worship you both; I have recourse toIndraandAgnifor food.”
Sukta 12.sanskrit_wisdomlib: प्र वा॑मर्चन्त्यु॒क्थिनो॑ नीथा॒विदो॑ जरि॒तार॑: । इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ इष॒ आ वृ॑णे

devanagari.text: इंद्राग्नी नवतिं पुरो दासपत्नीरधूनुतं ।साकमेकेन कर्मणा ॥
इन्द्राग्नी इति । नवतिम् । पुरः । दासऽपत्नीः । अधूनुतम् ।साकम् । एकेन । कर्मणा ॥

transliteration.text: índrāgnī íti ǀ navatím ǀ púraḥ ǀ dāsá-patnīḥ ǀ adhūnutam ǀsākám ǀ ékena ǀ kármaṇā ǁ

Sukta 12.translation: “IndraandAgni, with one united effort you over-threw ninety cities ruled over by (your) foes.”
Sukta 12.sanskrit_wisdomlib: इन्द्रा॑ग्नी नव॒तिं पुरो॑ दा॒सप॑त्नीरधूनुतम् । सा॒कमेके॑न॒ कर्म॑णा

devanagari.text: इंद्राग्नी अपसस्पर्युप प्र यंति धीतयः ।ऋतस्य पथ्या अनु ॥
इन्द्राग्नी इति । अपसः । परि । उप । प्र । यन्ति । धीतयः ।ऋतस्य । पथ्याः । अनु ॥

transliteration.text: índrāgnī íti ǀ ápasaḥ ǀ pári ǀ úpa ǀ prá ǀ yanti ǀ dhītáyaḥ ǀṛtásya ǀ pathyā́ḥ ǀ ánu ǁ

Sukta 12.translation: “IndraandAgnithe pious ministers, are present at our holy rite, according to the wave of worship.”
Sukta 12.sanskrit_wisdomlib: इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ अप॑स॒स्पर्युप॒ प्र य॑न्ति धी॒तय॑: । ऋ॒तस्य॑ प॒थ्या॒३॒॑ अनु॑

devanagari.text: इंद्राग्नी तविषाणि वां सधस्थानि प्रयांसि च ।युवोरप्तूर्यं हितं ॥
इन्द्राग्नी इति । तविषाणि । वाम् । सधऽस्थानि । प्रयांसि । च ।युवोः । अप्ऽतूर्यम् । हितम् ॥

transliteration.text: índrāgnī íti ǀ taviṣā́ṇi ǀ vām ǀ sadhá-sthāni ǀ práyāṃsi ǀ ca ǀyuvóḥ ǀ ap-tū́ryam ǀ hitám ǁ

Sukta 12.translation: “IndraandAgni, in you, vigour and food are abiding together, and therefore in you is deposited the dispensing of water.”
Sukta 12.sanskrit_wisdomlib: इन्द्रा॑ग्नी तवि॒षाणि॑ वां स॒धस्था॑नि॒ प्रयां॑सि च । यु॒वोर॒प्तूर्यं॑ हि॒तम्

devanagari.text: इंद्राग्नी रोचना दिवः परि वाजेषु भूषथः ।तद्वां चेति प्र वीर्यं ॥
इन्द्राग्नी इति । रोचना । दिवः । परि । वाजेषु । भूषथः ।तत् । वाम् । चेति । प्र । वीर्यम् ॥

transliteration.text: índrāgnī íti ǀ rocanā́ ǀ diváḥ ǀ pári ǀ vā́jeṣu ǀ bhūṣathaḥ ǀtát ǀ vām ǀ ceti ǀ prá ǀ vīryám ǁ

Sukta 12.translation: “IndraandAgni, illuminators of heaven, be ever graced (with victory) in battles, for such your prowess proclaims.”
Sukta 12.sanskrit_wisdomlib: इन्द्रा॑ग्नी रोच॒ना दि॒वः परि॒ वाजे॑षु भूषथः । तद्वां॑ चेति॒ प्र वी॒र्य॑म्

devanagari.text: प्र वो देवायाग्नये बर्हिष्ठमर्चास्मै ।गमद्देवेभिरा स नो यजिष्ठो बर्हिरा सदत् ॥
प्र । वः । देवाय । अग्नये । बर्हिष्ठम् । अर्च । अस्मै ।गमत् । देवेभिः । आ । सः । नः । यजिष्ठः । बर्हिः । आ । सदत् ॥

transliteration.text: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ devā́ya ǀ agnáye ǀ bárhiṣṭham ǀ arca ǀ asmai ǀgámat ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ yájiṣṭhaḥ ǀ barhíḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ sadat ǁ

Sukta 13.translation: “(Priests) utter devout (praises) to this your divineAgni, that so glorified he may come to us with gods, and sit down on the sacrificial grass.”
Sukta 13.sanskrit_wisdomlib: प्र वो॑ दे॒वाया॒ग्नये॒ बर्हि॑ष्ठमर्चास्मै । गम॑द्दे॒वेभि॒रा स नो॒ यजि॑ष्ठो ब॒र्हिरा स॑दत्

devanagari.text: ऋतावा यस्य रोदसी दक्षं सचंत ऊतयः ।हविष्मंतस्तमीळते तं सनिष्यंतोऽवसे ॥

Sukta 13.translation: “The devout kindle (the fire) with his wealth-obtaining rites, (to worship) the radiant, unprecededAgni, the invoker (of the gods), the protector of men.”

Sukta 13.translation: “Perfect our prayer, invoker of the gods, as well as our hymns;Agni, who increases with the winds and the giver of thousands, augment our felicity.”

Sukta 13.translation: “Grant us indeed,Agni, wealth (that may be counted) by thousands, and comprising offspring, nourishment, brilliant treasure, and vigour, and be infinite and inexhaustible.”

Sukta 14.translation: “The invoker (of the gods), the exhilarator (of his worshippers), the true, the offerer of sacrifice, the most wise, the creator, is present at our sacred rites.Agni, the son of strength, whose chariot is the lightning, whose hair is flame, manifests his glory on the earth.”

Sukta 14.translation: “May the good-bestowing day and night hasten to you while you,Agnimeet them on the paths of the wind; since (the priests) ever worship you preceding (them) with oblations, whilst they (united) like the pole (and the yoke of a wagon), abide successively in our dwelling.”

Sukta 14.translation: “Divine (Agni), mighty and omniscient, these (are the offerings) which we mortals present to you in the sacrifice; do you be cognizant of every respectable worshipper, and partake, immortal of all (his offerings) on this occasion.”
Sukta 14.sanskrit_wisdomlib: तुभ्यं॑ दक्ष कविक्रतो॒ यानी॒मा देव॒ मर्ता॑सो अध्व॒रे अक॑र्म । त्वं विश्व॑स्य सु॒रथ॑स्य बोधि॒ सर्वं॒ तद॑ग्ने अमृत स्वदे॒ह

Sukta 15.translation: “Radiant with great glory, repel the hostilerākṣasasandpiśācas; may I be in (the enjoyment) of the favour of the great (Agni), the giver of prosperity, and in the service of (him who is) easily invoked.”

Sukta 15.translation: “Consider yourself our protector at the breaking of the dawn today and when the sun has risen;Agni, who is engendered with (embodied) form, be plural ased with my constant praise, as a father (is plural ased with) his son.”

Sukta 15.translation: “Showerer (of benefits),beholder of men, radiant amid darkness, shine,Agni, with abundant (rays) in due order; granter of dwellings, conduct us (to good), keep off all ill, and youngest (of all the gods), gratify our desires for wealth.”

Sukta 15.translation: “Agni, who is irresistible and the showerer (of benefits), consume victorious all the cities (of the foe) and (all their) precious things; do you, the duly worshipped, the knower of all that is born, (be for us) the conductor of the first great preserving sacrifice.”
Sukta 15.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अषा॑ळ्हो अग्ने वृष॒भो दि॑दीहि॒ पुरो॒ विश्वा॒: सौभ॑गा संजिगी॒वान् । य॒ज्ञस्य॑ ने॒ता प्र॑थ॒मस्य॑ पा॒योर्जात॑वेदो बृह॒तः सु॑प्रणीते

Sukta 15.translation: “Destroyer (of the world), do you who is endowed with intelligence and radiance celebrate many faultless sacred rites in honour of the gods, and restraining (your impatience), convey to them like a wagon our (sacrificial) food; illume (with your rays) the beautiful heaven and earth.”

Sukta 15.translation: “Be propitious, showerer (of benefits); grant (abundant) food,Agni; (make) heaven and earth yield us milk; divine (Agni), associated with the gods, shining with bright radiance, let not the ill-will of any mortal prevail against us.”

Sukta 15.translation: “Grant,Agni, to the offerer of the oblation, earth the giver of cattle the means of many sacred rites, such that it may long endure; may there be to us sons and grandsons, and may your favour, Agni, be productive of good to us.”

Sukta 16.translation: “Maruts, leaders (of rites), associate with this augmenter (of our prosperity), in whom (abide) riches contributing to felicity, you who (are victorious) over (your) enemies in battle, who daily humble (your) foes.”

devanagari.text: मा नो अग्नेऽमतये मावीरतायै रीरधः ।मागोतायै सहसस्पुत्र मा निदेऽप द्वेषांस्या कृधि ॥

transliteration.text: mā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ ámataye ǀ mā́ ǀ avī́ratāyai ǀ rīradhaḥ ǀmā́ ǀ agótāyai ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ putra ǀ mā́ ǀ nidé ǀ ápa ǀ dvéṣāṃsi ǀ ā́ ǀ kṛdhi ǁ

Sukta 16.translation: “Consign us not,Agnito malignity; (doom) us not to the absence of posterity; nor, son of strength, to the want of cattle, nor to reproach; drive away (all) animosities.”
Sukta 16.sanskrit_wisdomlib: मा नो॑ अ॒ग्नेऽम॑तये॒ मावीर॑तायै रीरधः । मागोता॑यै सहसस्पुत्र॒ मा नि॒देऽप॒ द्वेषां॒स्या कृ॑धि

devanagari.text: शग्धि वाजस्य सुभग प्रजावतोऽग्ने बृहतो अध्वरे ।सं राया भूयसा सृज मयोभुना तुविद्युम्न यशस्वता ॥

transliteration.text: śagdhí ǀ vā́jasya ǀ su-bhaga ǀ prajā́-vataḥ ǀ ágne ǀ bṛhatáḥ ǀ adhvaré ǀsám ǀ rāyā́ ǀ bhū́yasā ǀ sṛja ǀ mayaḥ-bhúnā ǀ túvi-dyumna ǀ yáśasvatā ǁ

Sukta 16.translation: “AuspiciousAgni, bestow (upon us) at the rite, food (the source of) happiness and renown.”
Sukta 16.sanskrit_wisdomlib: श॒ग्धि वाज॑स्य सुभग प्र॒जाव॒तोऽग्ने॑ बृह॒तो अ॑ध्व॒रे । सं रा॒या भूय॑सा सृज मयो॒भुना॒ तुवि॑द्युम्न॒ यश॑स्वता

devanagari.text: समिध्यमानः प्रथमानु धर्मा समक्तुभिरज्यते विश्ववारः ।शोचिष्केशो घृतनिर्णिक्पावकः सुयज्ञो अग्निर्यजथाय देवान् ॥

transliteration.text: sam-idhyámānaḥ ǀ prathamā́ ǀ ánu ǀ dhárma ǀ sám ǀ aktú-bhiḥ ǀ ajyate ǀ viśvá-vāraḥ ǀśocíḥ-keśaḥ ǀ ghṛtá-nirnik ǀ pāvakáḥ ǀ su-yajñáḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ yajáthāya ǀ devā́n ǁ

Sukta 17.translation: “The righteous (Agni) when first kindled on the several (altars) the object of adoration by all, whose hair is flame, and who is cleansed with butter, the purifier, the worthy-worshipped, is sprinkled with oblations for the worship of the gods.”
Sukta 17.sanskrit_wisdomlib: स॒मि॒ध्यमा॑नः प्रथ॒मानु॒ धर्मा॒ सम॒क्तुभि॑रज्यते वि॒श्ववा॑रः । शो॒चिष्के॑शो घृ॒तनि॑र्णिक्पाव॒कः सु॑य॒ज्ञो अ॒ग्निर्य॒जथा॑य दे॒वान्

devanagari.text: यथायजो होत्रमग्ने पृथिव्या यथा दिवो जातवेदश्चिकित्वान् ।एवानेन हविषा यक्षि देवान्मनुष्वद्यज्ञं प्र तिरेममद्य ॥

Sukta 17.translation: “As you did offer the burnt-offering,Agni, (on behalf of) earth; as you,Jātavedas, who are cognizant (of sacred rites, did offer sacrifice on behalf) of heaven; so with this oblation worship the gods, and perfect this rite today (as you did) that ofManu.”
Sukta 17.sanskrit_wisdomlib: यथाय॑जो हो॒त्रम॑ग्ने पृथि॒व्या यथा॑ दि॒वो जा॑तवेदश्चिकि॒त्वान् । ए॒वानेन॑ ह॒विषा॑ यक्षि दे॒वान्म॑नु॒ष्वद्य॒ज्ञं प्र ति॑रे॒मम॒द्य

devanagari.text: त्रीण्यायूंषि तव जातवेदस्तिस्र आजानीरुषसस्ते अग्ने ।ताभिर्देवानामवो यक्षि विद्वानथा भव यजमानाय शं योः ॥

transliteration.text: trī́ṇi ǀ ā́yūṃṣi ǀ táva ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ tisráḥ ǀ ā-jā́nīḥ ǀ uṣásaḥ ǀ te ǀ agne ǀtā́bhiḥ ǀ devā́nām ǀ ávaḥ ǀ yakṣi ǀ vidvā́n ǀ átha ǀ bhava ǀ yájamānāya ǀ śám ǀ yóḥ ǁ

Sukta 17.translation: “Three are your existencesJātavedas; three,Agni, are your parent dawns; with them offer the oblation of the gods, the knowing (his wishes) be the bestower of happiness on the instrumental tutor of the sacrifice.”
Sukta 17.sanskrit_wisdomlib: त्रीण्यायूं॑षि॒ तव॑ जातवेदस्ति॒स्र आ॒जानी॑रु॒षस॑स्ते अग्ने । ताभि॑र्दे॒वाना॒मवो॑ यक्षि वि॒द्वानथा॑ भव॒ यज॑मानाय॒ शं योः

devanagari.text: अग्निं सुदीतिं सुदृशं गृणंतो नमस्यामस्त्वेड्यं जातवेदः ।त्वां दूतमरतिं हव्यवाहं देवा अकृण्वन्नमृतस्य नाभिं ॥

transliteration.text: agním ǀ su-dītím ǀ su-dṛ́śam ǀ gṛṇántaḥ ǀ namasyā́maḥ ǀ tvā ǀ ī́ḍyam ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀtvā́m ǀ dūtám ǀ aratím ǀ havya-vā́ham ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ akṛṇvan ǀ amṛ́tasya ǀ nā́bhim ǁ

Sukta 17.translation: “Jātavedas, we venerate you, glorifying the brilliant, beautiful, adorableAgni; the gods have made you their messenger, the disinterested bearer of oblations, the centre of ambrosia.”
Sukta 17.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒ग्निं सु॑दी॒तिं सु॒दृशं॑ गृ॒णन्तो॑ नम॒स्याम॒स्त्वेड्यं॑ जातवेदः । त्वां दू॒तम॑र॒तिं ह॑व्य॒वाहं॑ दे॒वा अ॑कृण्वन्न॒मृत॑स्य॒ नाभि॑म्

devanagari.text: यस्त्वद्धोता पूर्वो अग्ने यजीयांद्विता च सत्ता स्वधया च शंभुः ।तस्यानु धर्म प्र यजा चिकित्वोऽथ नो धा अध्वरं देववीतौ ॥

transliteration.text: yáḥ ǀ tvát ǀ hótā ǀ pū́rvaḥ ǀ agne ǀ yájīyān ǀ dvitā́ ǀ ca ǀ sáttā ǀ svadháyā ǀ ca ǀ śam-bhúḥ ǀtásya ǀ ánu ǀ dhárma ǀ prá ǀ yaja ǀ cikitvaḥ ǀ átha ǀ naḥ ǀ dhāḥ ǀ adhvarám ǀ devá-vītau ǁ

Sukta 17.translation: “He is the most diligent offerer of worship who is the presenter of oblations before you are and who in two plural ces (the middling and the best) seated with the sacrificial food is (the source of) happiness (to the worshippers); do you cognizant (of the objects of devotion), officiate in accordance with his piety, and thus render our rite acceptable to the gods.”
Sukta 17.sanskrit_wisdomlib: यस्त्वद्धोता॒ पूर्वो॑ अग्ने॒ यजी॑यान्द्वि॒ता च॒ सत्ता॑ स्व॒धया॑ च श॒म्भुः । तस्यानु॒ धर्म॒ प्र य॑जा चिकि॒त्वोऽथ॑ नो धा अध्व॒रं दे॒ववी॑तौ

devanagari.text: भवा नो अग्ने सुमना उपेतौ सखेव सख्ये पितरेव साधुः ।पुरुद्रुहो हि क्षितयो जनानां प्रति प्रतीचीर्दहतादरातीः ॥

transliteration.text: bháva ǀ naḥ ǀ agne ǀ su-mánāḥ ǀ úpa-itau ǀ sákhā-iva ǀ sákhye ǀ pitárā-iva ǀ sādhúḥ ǀpuru-drúhaḥ ǀ hí ǀ kṣitáyaḥ ǀ jánānām ǀ práti ǀ pratīcī́ḥ ǀ dahatāt ǀ árātīḥ ǁ

Sukta 18.translation: “Be favourably disposedAgni, on approaching us (at this rite); be the fulfiller (of our objects) like a friend (to a friend) or parents (to a child); since men are the grievous oppressors of men, do you consume the foes who come against us.”
Sukta 18.sanskrit_wisdomlib: भवा॑ नो अग्ने सु॒मना॒ उपे॑तौ॒ सखे॑व॒ सख्ये॑ पि॒तरे॑व सा॒धुः । पु॒रु॒द्रुहो॒ हि क्षि॒तयो॒ जना॑नां॒ प्रति॑ प्रती॒चीर्द॑हता॒दरा॑तीः

devanagari.text: तपो ष्वग्ने अंतराँ अमित्राँ तपा शंसमररुषः परस्य ।तपो वसो चिकितानो अचित्तान्वि ते तिष्ठंतामजरा अयासः ॥

transliteration.text: tápo íti ǀ sú ǀ agne ǀ ántarān ǀ amítrān ǀ tápa ǀ śáṃsam ǀ áraruṣaḥ ǀ párasya ǀtápo íti ǀ vaso íti ǀ cikitānáḥ ǀ acíttān ǀ ví ǀ te ǀ tiṣṭhantām ǀ ajárāḥ ǀ ayā́saḥ ǁ

Sukta 18.translation: “Vex thoroughly,Agni, our assailing enemies, disappoint the purpose of the adversary who offers not worship; giver of dwellings, who are cognizant (of sacred rites), vex those who have no thought (of pious acts) so that your undecaying, all-pervading (rays), may ever abide.”
Sukta 18.sanskrit_wisdomlib: तपो॒ ष्व॑ग्ने॒ अन्त॑राँ अ॒मित्रा॒न्तपा॒ शंस॒मर॑रुष॒: पर॑स्य । तपो॑ वसो चिकिता॒नो अ॒चित्ता॒न्वि ते॑ तिष्ठन्ताम॒जरा॑ अ॒यास॑:

devanagari.text: इध्मेनाग्न इच्छमानो घृतेन जुहोमि हव्यं तरसे बलाय ।यावदीशे ब्रह्मणा वंदमान इमां धियं शतसेयाय देवीं ॥

transliteration.text: idhména ǀ agne ǀ icchámānaḥ ǀ ghṛténa ǀ juhómi ǀ havyám ǀ tárase ǀ bálāya ǀyā́vat ǀ ī́śe ǀ bráhmaṇā ǀ vándamānaḥ ǀ imā́m ǀ dhíyam ǀ śata-séyāya ǀ devī́m ǁ

Sukta 18.translation: “Desirous (of wealth) I offer to youAgni, an oblation with butter and with fuel for your speed and invigoration, praising you with a holy prayer as much as I am able; I propitiate you that you may render this praise resplendent with infinite treasure.”
Sukta 18.sanskrit_wisdomlib: इ॒ध्मेना॑ग्न इ॒च्छमा॑नो घृ॒तेन॑ जु॒होमि॑ ह॒व्यं तर॑से॒ बला॑य । याव॒दीशे॒ ब्रह्म॑णा॒ वन्द॑मान इ॒मां धियं॑ शत॒सेया॑य दे॒वीम्

devanagari.text: उच्छोचिषा सहसस्पुत्र स्तुतो बृहद्वयः शशमानेषु धेहि ।रेवदग्ने विश्वामित्रेषु शं योर्मर्मृज्मा ते तन्वंभूरि कृत्वः ॥

transliteration.text: út ǀ śocíṣā ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ putra ǀ stutáḥ ǀ bṛhát ǀ váyaḥ ǀ śaśamānéṣu ǀ dhehi ǀrevát ǀ agne ǀ viśvā́mitreṣu ǀ śám ǀ yóḥ ǀ marmṛjmá ǀ te ǀ tanvám ǀ bhū́ri ǀ kṛ́tvaḥ ǁ

Sukta 18.translation: “Rise up, son of strength, with your splendour when hymned, and bestow abundant food and wealth,Agni, upon the descendants ofViśvāmitracelebrating your praise; and grant them exemption from sickness and danger; encourager of pious works (Agni), we repeatedly sprinkle your substance (with milk and butter).”
Sukta 18.sanskrit_wisdomlib: उच्छो॒चिषा॑ सहसस्पुत्र स्तु॒तो बृ॒हद्वय॑: शशमा॒नेषु॑ धेहि । रे॒वद॑ग्ने वि॒श्वामि॑त्रेषु॒ शं योर्म॑र्मृ॒ज्मा ते॑ त॒न्वं१॒॑ भूरि॒ कृत्व॑:

devanagari.text: कृधि रत्नं सुसनितर्धनानां स घेदग्ने भवसि यत्समिद्धः ।स्तोतुर्दुरोणे सुभगस्य रेवत्सृप्रा करस्ना दधिषे वपूंषि ॥

transliteration.text: kṛdhí ǀ rátnam ǀ su-sanitaḥ ǀ dhánānām ǀ sáḥ ǀ gha ǀ ít ǀ agne ǀ bhavasi ǀ yát ǀ sám-iddhaḥ ǀstotúḥ ǀ duroṇé ǀ su-bhágasya ǀ revát ǀ sṛprā́ ǀ karásnā ǀ dadhiṣe ǀ vápūṃṣi ǁ

Sukta 18.translation: “Liberal donor (of riches) bestow upon us the most precious of treasures, for therefore is it,Agni, that you are kindled; you have aims promptly stretched forth, whose (radiant) forms (bestow) wealth on the dwelling of your fortunate adorer.”
Sukta 18.sanskrit_wisdomlib: कृ॒धि रत्नं॑ सुसनित॒र्धना॑नां॒ स घेद॑ग्ने भवसि॒ यत्समि॑द्धः । स्तो॒तुर्दु॑रो॒णे सु॒भग॑स्य रे॒वत्सृ॒प्रा क॒रस्ना॑ दधिषे॒ वपूं॑षि

Sukta 19.translation: “I have recourse in this sacrifice toAgni, the invoker and praiser (of the gods), theintelligent, the all-knowing the unbeguiled; may he, the adorable, sacrificer for us to the gods, (and) accept the precious (offerings) we make for food and riches.”
Sukta 19.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒ग्निं होता॑रं॒ प्र वृ॑णे मि॒येधे॒ गृत्सं॑ क॒विं वि॑श्व॒विद॒ममू॑रम् । स नो॑ यक्षद्दे॒वता॑ता॒ यजी॑यान्रा॒ये वाजा॑य वनते म॒घानि॑

Sukta 19.translation: “Reverencing the gods, I plural ce before youAgni, the brilliant oblation-yielding, food-bestowing, butter-charged (offering); may you (propitiated) by the present wealth, sanctify (this) sacrifice by your circumambulation.”
Sukta 19.sanskrit_wisdomlib: प्र ते॑ अग्ने ह॒विष्म॑तीमिय॒र्म्यच्छा॑ सुद्यु॒म्नां रा॒तिनीं॑ घृ॒ताची॑म् । प्र॒द॒क्षि॒णिद्दे॒वता॑तिमुरा॒णः सं रा॒तिभि॒र्वसु॑भिर्य॒ज्ञम॑श्रेत्

Sukta 19.translation: “He who isprotected,Agni, by you, becomes endowed with a most luminous mind; bestow upon him excellent progeny; may we ever be under the power of you who is the willing dispenser of riches; glorifying you (may we be) the receptacles of wealth.”
Sukta 19.sanskrit_wisdomlib: स तेजी॑यसा॒ मन॑सा॒ त्वोत॑ उ॒त शि॑क्ष स्वप॒त्यस्य॑ शि॒क्षोः । अग्ने॑ रा॒यो नृत॑मस्य॒ प्रभू॑तौ भू॒याम॑ ते सुष्टु॒तय॑श्च॒ वस्व॑:

Sukta 19.translation: “The ministering priests have concentrated in youAgni, who are divine, many hosts (of flames); do you bring hither the gods, youngest (of the deities), that you may worship today the divine effulgence.”
Sukta 19.sanskrit_wisdomlib: भूरी॑णि॒ हि त्वे द॑धि॒रे अनी॒काग्ने॑ दे॒वस्य॒ यज्य॑वो॒ जना॑सः । स आ व॑ह दे॒वता॑तिं यविष्ठ॒ शर्धो॒ यद॒द्य दि॒व्यं यजा॑सि

Sukta 19.translation: “Inasmuch as the attendant divine (priests) anoint you as the invoker of the gods to offer worship in the sacrifice, therefore do you assent to be our protector on this occasion, and grant abundant food to our descendants.”
Sukta 19.sanskrit_wisdomlib: यत्त्वा॒ होता॑रम॒नज॑न्मि॒येधे॑ निषा॒दय॑न्तो य॒जथा॑य दे॒वाः । स त्वं नो॑ अग्नेऽवि॒तेह बो॒ध्यधि॒ श्रवां॑सि धेहि नस्त॒नूषु॑

Sukta 20.translation: “The bearer (of the oblation) invokes with praises at the break of day,Agni, the dawn, theAśvins, and Dadhikra); may the resplendent divinities, desirous of our sacrifice, hear in unison (the invocation).”

Sukta 20.translation: “Agni, born of sacrifice, three are your viands; three your abiding plural ces, three the tongue satisfying (thegods); three verily are your forms acceptable to the deities, and with them never heedless (of our wishes), bepropitious to our praises.”

Sukta 20.translation: “DivineAgni, knowing all that exists and distributor of food, many are the names of you who are immortal satisffier of all men, friend of the suppliant, the gods have deposited in you whatever are the delusions of the deluding (rākṣasas).”

Sukta 20.translation: “The divineAgniis the guide of devout men, as the sun is the regulator of the seasons; may he, the observer of truth, the slayer ofVṛtra, the ancient, the omniscient convey his adorer (safe) over all difficulties.”
Sukta 20.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒ग्निर्ने॒ता भग॑ इव क्षिती॒नां दैवी॑नां दे॒व ऋ॑तु॒पा ऋ॒तावा॑ । स वृ॑त्र॒हा स॒नयो॑ वि॒श्ववे॑दा॒: पर्ष॒द्विश्वाति॑ दुरि॒ता गृ॒णन्त॑म्

Sukta 20.translation: “I invoke to this rite, Dadhikrā,Agni, the divine Uṣas,Bṛhaspati, the divineSavitā, theAśvins,MitraandVaruṇa,Bhaga, theVasus, theRudras, andĀdityas.”

Sukta 21.translation: “Convey our sacrifice,Jātavedas, to the immortals and do you accept these oblations;Agni, invoker (of the gods) seated (on the altar) first partake of the drops of the marrow and of the butter.”
Sukta 21.sanskrit_wisdomlib: इ॒मं नो॑ य॒ज्ञम॒मृते॑षु धेही॒मा ह॒व्या जा॑तवेदो जुषस्व । स्तो॒काना॑मग्ने॒ मेद॑सो घृ॒तस्य॒ होत॒: प्राशा॑न प्रथ॒मो नि॒षद्य॑

devanagari.text: घृतवंतः पावक ते स्तोकाः श्चोतंति मेदसः ।स्वधर्मंदेववीतये श्रेष्ठं नो धेहि वार्यं ॥

Sukta 21.translation: “The drops of the marrow charged with butter fall, purifier, to you, at your own rite, for the food of the gods; therefore grant us excellent affluence.”
Sukta 21.sanskrit_wisdomlib: घृ॒तव॑न्तः पावक ते स्तो॒काः श्चो॑तन्ति॒ मेद॑सः । स्वध॑र्मन्दे॒ववी॑तये॒ श्रेष्ठं॑ नो धेहि॒ वार्य॑म्

devanagari.text: तुभ्यं स्तोका घृतश्चुतोऽग्ने विप्राय संत्य ।ऋषिः श्रेष्ठः समिध्यसे यज्ञस्य प्राविता भव ॥

Sukta 21.translation: “The drops (of the marrow) dripping with butter are offered,Agni, to you who are wise; you the most excellent ṛṣi are kindled; be the protector of the sacrifice.”
Sukta 21.sanskrit_wisdomlib: तुभ्यं॑ स्तो॒का घृ॑त॒श्चुतोऽग्ने॒ विप्रा॑य सन्त्य । ऋषि॒: श्रेष्ठ॒: समि॑ध्यसे य॒ज्ञस्य॑ प्रावि॒ता भ॑व

Sukta 21.translation: “Irrepressible and powerful,Agni, the drops of marrow and of butter distil for you; therefore you, who are praised by sages, come with great splendour, and be plural ased ever intelligent Agni, with our oblations.”
Sukta 21.sanskrit_wisdomlib: तुभ्यं॑ श्चोतन्त्यध्रिगो शचीवः स्तो॒कासो॑ अग्ने॒ मेद॑सो घृ॒तस्य॑ । क॒वि॒श॒स्तो बृ॑ह॒ता भा॒नुनागा॑ ह॒व्या जु॑षस्व मेधिर

devanagari.text: ओजिष्ठं ते मध्यतो मेद उद्भृतं प्र ते वयं ददामहे ।श्चोतंति ते वसो स्तोका अधि त्वचि प्रति तांदेवशो विहि ॥

transliteration.text: ójiṣṭham ǀ te ǀ madhyatáḥ ǀ médaḥ ǀ út-bhṛtam ǀ prá ǀ te ǀ vayám ǀ dadāmahe ǀścótanti ǀ te ǀ vaso-íti ǀ stokā́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ tvací ǀ práti ǀ tā́n ǀ deva-śáḥ ǀ vihi ǁ

Sukta 21.translation: “We present to you the densest marrow that has been extracted for you from the interior (of the victim); grant of dwellings, the drops fall for you upon the skin; distribute them amongst the gods.”
Sukta 21.sanskrit_wisdomlib: ओजि॑ष्ठं ते मध्य॒तो मेद॒ उद्भृ॑तं॒ प्र ते॑ व॒यं द॑दामहे । श्चोत॑न्ति ते वसो स्तो॒का अधि॑ त्व॒चि प्रति॒ तान्दे॑व॒शो वि॑हि

devanagari.text: अयं सो अग्निर्यस्मिन्त्सोममिंद्रः सुतं दधे जठरे वावशानः ।सहस्रिणं वाजमत्यं न सप्तिं ससवान्त्सन्त्स्तूयसे जातवेदः ॥

Sukta 22.translation: “This is thatAgniin whomIndra, desirous (of the oblation), plural ced the effusedSomafor (his own) belly; you are praised by us,Jātavedas, enjoying the sacrificial food of many sorts like a rapid courser (enjoying many plural asures in battle).”
Sukta 22.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒यं सो अ॒ग्निर्यस्मि॒न्त्सोम॒मिन्द्र॑: सु॒तं द॒धे ज॒ठरे॑ वावशा॒नः । स॒ह॒स्रिणं॒ वाज॒मत्यं॒ न सप्तिं॑ सस॒वान्त्सन्त्स्तू॑यसे जातवेदः

devanagari.text: अग्ने यत्ते दिवि वर्चः पृथिव्यां यदोषधीष्वप्स्वा यजत्र ।येनांतरिक्षमुर्वाततंथ त्वेषः स भानुरर्णवो नृचक्षाः ॥

transliteration.text: ágne ǀ yát ǀ te ǀ diví ǀ várcaḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ yát ǀ óṣadhīṣu ǀ ap-sú ǀ ā́ ǀ yajatra ǀyéna ǀ antárikṣam ǀ urú ǀ ā-tatántha ǀ tveṣáḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ bhānúḥ ǀ arṇaváḥ ǀ nṛ-cákṣāḥ ǁ

Sukta 22.translation: “AdorableAgni, your radiance that is in the heaven, on the earth, in the plural nts, in the waters and wherewith you overspread the firmament, that is shining and resplendent, overlooking man (vast as) the ocean.”
Sukta 22.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अग्ने॒ यत्ते॑ दि॒वि वर्च॑: पृथि॒व्यां यदोष॑धीष्व॒प्स्वा य॑जत्र । येना॒न्तरि॑क्षमु॒र्वा॑त॒तन्थ॑ त्वे॒षः स भा॒नुर॑र्ण॒वो नृ॒चक्षा॑:

devanagari.text: अग्ने दिवो अर्णमच्छा जिगास्यच्छा देवाँ ऊचिषे धिष्ण्या ये ।या रोचने परस्तात्सूर्यस्य याश्चावस्तादुपतिष्ठंत आपः ॥

transliteration.text: ágne ǀ diváḥ ǀ árṇam ǀ áccha ǀ jigāsi ǀ áccha ǀ devā́n ǀ ūciṣe ǀ dhíṣṇyāḥ ǀ yé ǀyā́ḥ ǀ rocané ǀ parástāt ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ yā́ḥ ǀ ca ǀ avástāt ǀ upa-tíṣṭhante ǀ ā́paḥ ǁ

Sukta 22.translation: “You move,Agni, to the vapour in heaven; you congregate the divinities who are the vital airs (of the body); you animate the waters in the bright region above the sun, as well as those that are in the firmament beneath.”
Sukta 22.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अग्ने॑ दि॒वो अर्ण॒मच्छा॑ जिगा॒स्यच्छा॑ दे॒वाँ ऊ॑चिषे॒ धिष्ण्या॒ ये । या रो॑च॒ने प॒रस्ता॒त्सूर्य॑स्य॒ याश्चा॒वस्ता॑दुप॒तिष्ठ॑न्त॒ आप॑:

Sukta 22.translation: “May the benignant fires termed puriṣyās, together with the instrumental uments (that have dug the pits in which they are plural ced) combined, accept the sacrifice (and grant us) salutary and abundant food.”
Sukta 22.sanskrit_wisdomlib: पु॒री॒ष्या॑सो अ॒ग्नय॑: प्राव॒णेभि॑: स॒जोष॑सः । जु॒षन्तां॑ य॒ज्ञम॒द्रुहो॑ऽनमी॒वा इषो॑ म॒हीः

Sukta 22.translation: “Grant,Agni, to the offerer of the oblation earth the giver of cattle, the means of many sacred ries, such that it may long endure; may there be to us sons and grandsons, and may your favour, Agni, be productive of good to us.”
Sukta 22.sanskrit_wisdomlib: इळा॑मग्ने पुरु॒दंसं॑ स॒निं गोः श॑श्वत्त॒मं हव॑मानाय साध । स्यान्न॑: सू॒नुस्तन॑यो वि॒जावाग्ने॒ सा ते॑ सुम॒तिर्भू॑त्व॒स्मे

devanagari.text: निर्मथितः सुधित आ सधस्थे युवा कविरध्वरस्य प्रणेता ।जूर्यत्स्वग्निरजरो वनेष्वत्रा दधे अमृतं जातवेदाः ॥

Sukta 23.translation: “Churned (by the friction of the sticks), duly plural ced in the sacrificial chamber, the young and sage leader of the rite,Jātavedas, the imperishableAgni, (blazing) amidst consuming forests, grants us on this occasion ambrosial (food).”
Sukta 23.sanskrit_wisdomlib: निर्म॑थित॒: सुधि॑त॒ आ स॒धस्थे॒ युवा॑ क॒विर॑ध्व॒रस्य॑ प्रणे॒ता । जूर्य॑त्स्व॒ग्निर॒जरो॒ वने॒ष्वत्रा॑ दधे अ॒मृतं॑ जा॒तवे॑दाः

Sukta 23.translation: “The two sons ofBharata,Devaśravasand Devavāta, have churned the very powerful and wealth-bestowingAgni; look upon us, Agni, with vast riches, and be the bringer of food (to us) every day.”
Sukta 23.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अम॑न्थिष्टां॒ भार॑ता रे॒वद॒ग्निं दे॒वश्र॑वा दे॒ववा॑तः सु॒दक्ष॑म् । अग्ने॒ वि प॑श्य बृह॒ताभि रा॒येषां नो॑ ने॒ता भ॑वता॒दनु॒ द्यून्

transliteration.text: dáśa ǀ kṣípaḥ ǀ pūrvyám ǀ sīm ǀ ajījanan ǀ sú-jātam ǀ mātṛ́ṣu ǀ priyám ǀagním ǀ stuhi ǀ daiva-vātám ǀ deva-śravaḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ jánānām ǀ ásat ǀ vaśī́ ǁ

Sukta 23.translation: “The ten fingers have genitive rated this ancient (Agni); praise,Devaśravas, this well-born, beloved (son) of his parents, genitive rated by Devavāta, Agni, who is the servant of men.”
Sukta 23.sanskrit_wisdomlib: दश॒ क्षिप॑: पू॒र्व्यं सी॑मजीजन॒न्त्सुजा॑तं मा॒तृषु॑ प्रि॒यम् । अ॒ग्निं स्तु॑हि दैववा॒तं दे॑वश्रवो॒ यो जना॑ना॒मस॑द्व॒शी

devanagari.text: नि त्वा दधे वर आ पृथिव्या इळायास्पदे सुदिनत्वे अह्नां ।दृषद्वत्यां मानुष आपयायां सरस्वत्यां रेवदग्ने दिदीहि ॥
नि । त्वा । दधे । वरे । आ । पृथिव्याः । इळायाः । पदे । सुदिनऽत्वे । अह्नाम् ।दृषत्ऽवत्याम् । मानुषे । आपयायाम् । सरस्वत्याम् । रेवत् । अग्ने । दिदीहि ॥

transliteration.text: ní ǀ tvā ǀ dadhe ǀ váre ǀ ā́ ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ íḷāyāḥ ǀ padé ǀ sudina-tvé ǀ áhnām ǀdṛṣát-vatyām ǀ mā́nuṣe ǀ āpayā́yām ǀ sárasvatyām ǀ revát ǀ agne ǀ didīhi ǁ

Sukta 23.translation: “I plural ce you in an excellent spot of earth on an auspicious day of days; do you,Agni, shine on the frequent (banks) of the Dṛṣadvati,ĀpayāandSarasvatīrivers.”
Sukta 23.sanskrit_wisdomlib: नि त्वा॑ दधे॒ वर॒ आ पृ॑थि॒व्या इळा॑यास्प॒दे सु॑दिन॒त्वे अह्ना॑म् । दृ॒षद्व॑त्यां॒ मानु॑ष आप॒यायां॒ सर॑स्वत्यां रे॒वद॑ग्ने दिदीहि

devanagari.text: इळामग्ने पुरुदंसं सनिं गोः शश्वत्तमं हवमानाय साध ।स्यान्नः सूनुस्तनयो विजावाग्ने सा ते सुमतिर्भूत्वस्मे ॥
इळाम् । अग्ने । पुरुऽदंसम् । सनिम् । गोः । शश्वत्ऽतमम् । हवमानाय । साध ।स्यात् । नः । सूनुः । तनयः । विजाऽवा । अग्ने । सा । ते । सुऽमतिः । भूतु । अस्मे इति ॥

transliteration.text: íḷām ǀ agne ǀ puru-dáṃsam ǀ saním ǀ góḥ ǀ śaśvat-tamám ǀ hávamānāya ǀ sādha ǀsyā́t ǀ naḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ tánayaḥ ǀ vijā́-vā ǀ agne ǀ sā́ ǀ te ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ bhūtu ǀ asmé íti ǁ

Sukta 23.translation: “Grant,Agni, to the offerer of the oblation earth the giver of cattle, the means of many sacred rites, such that it may long endure; may there be to us sons and grandsons, and may your favour, Agni, be productive of good to us.”
Sukta 23.sanskrit_wisdomlib: इळा॑मग्ने पुरु॒दंसं॑ स॒निं गोः श॑श्वत्त॒मं हव॑मानाय साध । स्यान्न॑: सू॒नुस्तन॑यो वि॒जावाग्ने॒ सा ते॑ सुम॒तिर्भू॑त्व॒स्मे

devanagari.text: अग्ने सहस्व पृतना अभिमातीरपास्य ।दुष्टरस्तरन्नरातीर्वर्चो धा यज्ञवाहसे ॥
अग्ने । सहस्व । पृतनाः । अभिऽमातीः । अप । अस्य ।दुस्तरः । तरन् । अरातीः । वर्चः । धाः । यज्ञऽवाहसे ॥

transliteration.text: ágne ǀ sáhasva ǀ pṛ́tanāḥ ǀ abhí-mātīḥ ǀ ápa ǀ asya ǀdustáraḥ ǀ táran ǀ árātīḥ ǀ várcaḥ ǀ dhāḥ ǀ yajñá-vāhase ǁ

Sukta 24.translation: “Repel,Agni, (hostile) hosts; drive away (all) assailants; insuperable, foe-surpassing, give food to the instrumental tutor of this sacrifice.”
Sukta 24.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अग्ने॒ सह॑स्व॒ पृत॑ना अ॒भिमा॑ती॒रपा॑स्य । दु॒ष्टर॒स्तर॒न्नरा॑ती॒र्वर्चो॑ धा य॒ज्ञवा॑हसे

devanagari.text: अग्न इळा समिध्यसे वीतिहोत्रो अमर्त्यः ।जुषस्व सू नो अध्वरं ॥
अग्ने । इळा । सम् । इध्यसे । वीतिऽहोत्रः । अमर्त्यः ।जुषस्व । सु । नः । अध्वरम् ॥

transliteration.text: ágne ǀ iḷā́ ǀ sám ǀ idhyase ǀ vītí-hotraḥ ǀ ámartyaḥ ǀjuṣásva ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ adhvarám ǁ

Sukta 24.translation: “Agni(who is) immortal and who is gratified by oblations, you are kindled upon the altar; be plural ased by this our sacrifice.”
Sukta 24.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अग्न॑ इ॒ळा समि॑ध्यसे वी॒तिहो॑त्रो॒ अम॑र्त्यः । जु॒षस्व॒ सू नो॑ अध्व॒रम्

devanagari.text: अग्ने द्युम्नेन जागृवे सहसः सूनवाहुत ।एदं बर्हिः सदो मम ॥
अग्ने । द्युम्नेन । जागृवे । सहसः । सूनो इति । आऽहुत ।आ । इदम् । बर्हिः । सदः । मम ॥

transliteration.text: ágne ǀ dyumnéna ǀ jāgṛve ǀ sáhasaḥ ǀ sūno íti ǀ ā-huta ǀā́ ǀ idám ǀ barhíḥ ǀ sadaḥ ǀ máma ǁ

Sukta 24.translation: “Agni, son of strength, vigilant (in the exercise of) your energy, take your seat when invoked on the sacred grass (strewn at) my (sacrifice).”
Sukta 24.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अग्ने॑ द्यु॒म्नेन॑ जागृवे॒ सह॑सः सूनवाहुत । एदं ब॒र्हिः स॑दो॒ मम॑

devanagari.text: अग्ने विश्वेभिरग्निभिर्देवेभिर्महया गिरः ।यज्ञेषु य उ चायवः ॥
अग्ने । विश्वेभिः । अग्निऽभिः । देवेभिः । महय । गिरः ।यज्ञेषु । ये । ऊं इति । चायवः ॥

transliteration.text: ágne ǀ víśvebhiḥ ǀ agní-bhiḥ ǀ devébhiḥ ǀ mahaya ǀ gíraḥ ǀyajñéṣu ǀ yé ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ cāyávaḥ ǁ

Sukta 24.translation: “Agni, with all the divine fires, respect the praises of those who in (their) sacrifices are (your especial) worshippers.”
Sukta 24.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अग्ने॒ विश्वे॑भिर॒ग्निभि॑र्दे॒वेभि॑र्महया॒ गिर॑: । य॒ज्ञेषु॒ य उ॑ चा॒यव॑:

devanagari.text: अग्ने दा दाशुषे रयिं वीरवंतं परीणसं ।शिशीहि नः सूनुमतः ॥
अग्ने । दाः । दाशुषे । रयिम् । वीरऽवन्तम् । परीणसम् ।शिशीहि । नः । सूनुऽमतः ॥

transliteration.text: ágne ǀ dā́ḥ ǀ dāśúṣe ǀ rayím ǀ vīrá-vantam ǀ párīṇasam ǀśiśīhí ǀ naḥ ǀ sūnu-mátaḥ ǁ

Sukta 24.translation: “Grant,Agni, ample wealth and progeny to the donor (of the oblation); make us prosperous, possessed of offspring.”
Sukta 24.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अग्ने॒ दा दा॒शुषे॑ र॒यिं वी॒रव॑न्तं॒ परी॑णसम् । शि॒शी॒हि न॑: सूनु॒मत॑:

devanagari.text: अग्ने दिवः सूनुरसि प्रचेतास्तना पृथिव्या उत विश्ववेदाः ।ऋधग्देवाँ इह यजा चिकित्वः ॥
अग्ने । दिवः । सूनुः । असि । प्रऽचेताः । तना । पृथिव्याः । उत । विश्वऽवेदाः ।ऋधक् । देवान् । इह । यज । चिकित्वः ॥

transliteration.text: ágne ǀ diváḥ ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ asi ǀ prá-cetāḥ ǀ tánā ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ utá ǀ viśvá-vedāḥ ǀṛ́dhak ǀ devā́n ǀ ihá ǀ yaja ǀ cikitvaḥ ǁ

Sukta 25.translation: “Agni, who is omniscient, and the discriminator (of acts), you are the son of heaven or the son of earth; do you who is intelligent worship severally the gods on this occasion.”
Sukta 25.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अग्ने॑ दि॒वः सू॒नुर॑सि॒ प्रचे॑ता॒स्तना॑ पृथि॒व्या उ॒त वि॒श्ववे॑दाः । ऋध॑ग्दे॒वाँ इ॒ह य॑जा चिकित्वः

devanagari.text: अग्निः सनोति वीर्याणि विद्वान्त्सनोति वाजममृताय भूषन् ।स नो देवाँ एह वहा पुरुक्षो ॥
अग्निः । सनोति । वीर्याणि । विद्वान् । सनोति । वाजम् । अमृताय । भूषन् ।सः । नः । देवान् । आ । इह । वह । पुरुक्षो इति पुरुऽक्षो ॥

transliteration.text: agníḥ ǀ sanoti ǀ vīryā́ṇi ǀ vidvā́n ǀ sanóti ǀ vā́jam ǀ amṛ́tāya ǀ bhū́ṣan ǀsáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ ihá ǀ vaha ǀ purukṣo íti puru-kṣo ǁ

Sukta 25.translation: “The wiseAgnibestows faculties (securing prosperity and descendants); adorning (the world with lustre) he gives (sacrificial food) to the immortals; Agni, (to whom) many oblations (are offered), bring hither to us the gods.”
Sukta 25.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒ग्निः स॑नोति वी॒र्या॑णि वि॒द्वान्त्स॒नोति॒ वाज॑म॒मृता॑य॒ भूष॑न् । स नो॑ दे॒वाँ एह व॑हा पुरुक्षो

devanagari.text: अग्निर्द्यावापृथिवी विश्वजन्ये आ भाति देवी अमृते अमूरः ।क्षयन्वाजैः पुरुश्चंद्रो नमोभिः ॥
अग्निः । द्यावापृथिवी इति । विश्वजन्ये इति विश्वऽजन्ये । आ । भाति । देवी इति । अमृते इति । अमूरः ।क्षयन् । वाजैः । पुरुऽचन्द्रः । नमःऽभिः ॥

transliteration.text: agníḥ ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ viśvájanye íti viśvá-janye ǀ ā́ ǀ bhāti ǀ devī́ íti ǀ amṛ́te íti ǀ ámūraḥ ǀkṣáyan ǀ vā́jaiḥ ǀ puru-candráḥ ǀ námaḥ-bhiḥ ǁ

Sukta 25.translation: “Agni, the unbewildered, the ruler (of the world), the radiant, associated with vigour and food, illumines the divine immortal parents of all things, heaven and earth.”
Sukta 25.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒ग्निर्द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी वि॒श्वज॑न्ये॒ आ भा॑ति दे॒वी अ॒मृते॒ अमू॑रः । क्षय॒न्वाजै॑: पुरुश्च॒न्द्रो नमो॑भिः

devanagari.text: अग्न इंद्रश्च दाशुषो दुरोणे सुतावतो यज्ञमिहोप यातं ।अमर्धंता सोमपेयाय देवा ॥
अग्ने । इन्द्रः । च । दाशुषः । दुरोणे । सुतऽवतः । यज्ञम् । इह । उप । यातम् ।अमर्धन्ता । सोमऽपेयाय । देवा ॥

transliteration.text: ágne ǀ índraḥ ǀ ca ǀ dāśúṣaḥ ǀ duroṇé ǀ sutá-vataḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ ihá ǀ úpa ǀ yātam ǀámardhantā ǀ soma-péyāya ǀ devā ǁ

Sukta 25.translation: “Agni, do you andIndra, gods disdaining not (our rite), come to the sacrifice in the dwelling of the offerer of the libation to drink theSoma.”
Sukta 25.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अग्न॒ इन्द्र॑श्च दा॒शुषो॑ दुरो॒णे सु॒ताव॑तो य॒ज्ञमि॒होप॑ यातम् । अम॑र्धन्ता सोम॒पेया॑य देवा

devanagari.text: अग्ने अपां समिध्यसे दुरोणे नित्यः सूनो सहसो जातवेदः ।सधस्थानि महयमान ऊती ॥
अग्ने । अपाम् । सम् । इध्यसे । दुरोणे । नित्यः । सूनो इति । सहसः । जातऽवेदः ।सधऽस्थानि । महयमानः । ऊती ॥

transliteration.text: ágne ǀ apā́m ǀ sám ǀ idhyase ǀ duroṇé ǀ nítyaḥ ǀ sūno íti ǀ sahasaḥ ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀsadhá-sthāni ǀ maháyamānaḥ ǀ ūtī́ ǁ

Sukta 25.translation: “Agni, son of strength,Jātavedasthe eternal traversing the inhabited regions with your protection, you are kindled in the dwelling of the waters.”
Sukta 25.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अग्ने॑ अ॒पां समि॑ध्यसे दुरो॒णे नित्य॑: सूनो सहसो जातवेदः । स॒धस्था॑नि म॒हय॑मान ऊ॒ती

devanagari.text: वैश्वानरं मनसाग्निं निचाय्या हविष्मंतो अनुषत्यं स्वर्विदं ।सुदानुं देवं रथिरं वसूयवो गीर्भी रण्वं कुशिकासो हवामहे ॥
वैश्वानरम् । मनसा । अग्निम् । निऽचाय्य । हविष्मन्तः । अनुऽसत्यम् । स्वःऽविदम् ।सुऽदानुम् । देवम् । रथिरम् । वसुऽयवः । गीःऽभिः । रण्वम् । कुशिकासः । हवामहे ॥

transliteration.text: vaiśvānarám ǀ mánasā ǀ agním ǀ ni-cā́yya ǀ havíṣmantaḥ ǀ anu-satyám ǀ svaḥ-vídam ǀsu-dā́num ǀ devám ǀ rathirám ǀ vasu-yávaḥ ǀ gīḥ-bhíḥ ǀ raṇvám ǀ kuśikā́saḥ ǀ havāmahe ǁ

Sukta 26.translation: “We of the race ofKuśikaoffering oblations, desirous of wealth, having contemplated him in our minds, invoke with praises the divineVaiśvānara, the observer of truth, the cognizant of heaven, the bountiful, the charioteer, the frequenter (of sacrifices).”
Sukta 26.sanskrit_wisdomlib: वै॒श्वा॒न॒रं मन॑सा॒ग्निं नि॒चाय्या॑ ह॒विष्म॑न्तो अनुष॒त्यं स्व॒र्विद॑म् । सु॒दानुं॑ दे॒वं र॑थि॒रं व॑सू॒यवो॑ गी॒र्भी र॒ण्वं कु॑शि॒कासो॑ हवामहे

devanagari.text: तं शुभ्रमग्निमवसे हवामहे वैश्वानरं मातरिश्वानमुक्थ्यं ।बृहस्पतिं मनुषो देवतातये विप्रं श्रोतारमतिथिं रघुष्यदं ॥
तम् । शुभ्रम् । अग्निम् । अवसे । हवामहे । वैश्वानरम् । मातरिश्वानम् । उक्थ्यम् ।बृहस्पतिम् । मनुषः । देवऽतातये । विप्रम् । श्रोतारम् । अतिथिम् । रघुऽस्यदम् ॥

transliteration.text: tám ǀ śubhrám ǀ agním ǀ ávase ǀ havāmahe ǀ vaiśvānarám ǀ mātaríśvānam ǀ ukthyám ǀbṛ́haspátim ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ devá-tātaye ǀ vípram ǀ śrótāram ǀ átithim ǀ raghu-syádam ǁ

Sukta 26.translation: “We invoke you for our own protection and for the devotions of mankind, the radiantAgni,Vaiśvānara, the illuminator of the firmament, the adorable lord of sacred rites, the wise, the hearer (of supplications), the guest (of man), the quick-moving.”
Sukta 26.sanskrit_wisdomlib: तं शु॒भ्रम॒ग्निमव॑से हवामहे वैश्वान॒रं मा॑त॒रिश्वा॑नमु॒क्थ्य॑म् । बृह॒स्पतिं॒ मनु॑षो दे॒वता॑तये॒ विप्रं॒ श्रोता॑र॒मति॑थिं रघु॒ष्यद॑म्

devanagari.text: अश्वो न क्रंदंजनिभिः समिध्यते वैश्वानरः कुशिकेभिर्युगेयुगे ।स नो अग्निः सुवीर्यं स्वश्व्यं दधातु रत्नममृतेषु जागृविः ॥

Sukta 26.translation: “Vaiśvānarais kindled in every age by theKuśikasas a neighing foal (is nourished) by its mother; may thatAgni, vigilant among the immortals, give us wealth with excellent offspring and good horses.”
Sukta 26.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अश्वो॒ न क्रन्द॒ञ्जनि॑भि॒: समि॑ध्यते वैश्वान॒रः कु॑शि॒केभि॑र्यु॒गेयु॑गे । स नो॑ अ॒ग्निः सु॒वीर्यं॒ स्वश्व्यं॒ दधा॑तु॒ रत्न॑म॒मृते॑षु॒ जागृ॑विः

Sukta 26.translation: “May the swift fires combined with the vigorous winds proceed to the pure (region of the water), uniting the drops (of rain); theMarutsirresistible, all-knowing, agitate the copious-shedding clouds.”
Sukta 26.sanskrit_wisdomlib: प्र य॑न्तु॒ वाजा॒स्तवि॑षीभिर॒ग्नय॑: शु॒भे सम्मि॑श्ला॒: पृष॑तीरयुक्षत । बृ॒ह॒दुक्षो॑ म॒रुतो॑ वि॒श्ववे॑दस॒: प्र वे॑पयन्ति॒ पर्व॑ताँ॒ अदा॑भ्याः

Sukta 26.translation: “The fire-beautified, all-agitatingMaruts; we seek their fierce radiance for protection; they, the sons ofRudra, the bountiful Maruts, whose form is the rain, are loudlike roaring lions.”
Sukta 26.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒ग्नि॒श्रियो॑ म॒रुतो॑ वि॒श्वकृ॑ष्टय॒ आ त्वे॒षमु॒ग्रमव॑ ईमहे व॒यम् । ते स्वा॒निनो॑ रु॒द्रिया॑ व॒र्षनि॑र्णिजः सिं॒हा न हे॒षक्र॑तवः सु॒दान॑वः

Sukta 26.translation: “We solicit the might of theMaruts, the irradiation ofAgniwith solemn prayers in every assembly and company (of worshippers); those Maruts who ahve partly-coloured steeds, who are dispensers of unfailing wealth, firm (of purpose), and frequenters of sacrifices.”
Sukta 26.sanskrit_wisdomlib: व्रातं॑व्रातं ग॒णंग॑णं सुश॒स्तिभि॑र॒ग्नेर्भामं॑ म॒रुता॒मोज॑ ईमहे । पृष॑दश्वासो अनव॒भ्ररा॑धसो॒ गन्ता॑रो य॒ज्ञं वि॒दथे॑षु॒ धीरा॑:

Sukta 26.translation: “I,Agni, am by birth endowed with knowledge of all that exists; clarified butter is my eye; ambrosia is my mouth; I am the living breath of threefold nature, the measure of the firmament, eternal warmth; I am also the oblation.”

Sukta 26.translation: “Agni, thoroughly comprehending the light that is to be understod by the heart, has purified himself (by the three) purifying (forms); he has made himself most excellent treasure by (these) self-manifestations, and has thence contemplated heaven and earth.”

Sukta 26.translation: “Heaven and earth be kind to that stage who is as it were a many-cahnneled and inexhaustible stream (of knowledge); the parent (of his disciples), the collater of holy texts, rejoicing on the lap of his parents,, whose words are truth.”

Sukta 29.translation: “Let the intelligent priest plural ce the lower of the sticks with the face upwards, the upper (with the surface) downwards, so that quickly impregnated it may genitive rate the showerer (of benefits)Agni; then the bright blazing son of Iḷā whose light dissipates the darkness is born of the wood of attrition.”
Sukta 29.sanskrit_wisdomlib: उ॒त्ता॒नाया॒मव॑ भरा चिकि॒त्वान्त्स॒द्यः प्रवी॑ता॒ वृष॑णं जजान । अ॒रु॒षस्तू॑पो॒ रुश॑दस्य॒ पाज॒ इळा॑यास्पु॒त्रो व॒युने॑ऽजनिष्ट

devanagari.text: इळायास्त्वा पदे वयं नाभा पृथिव्या अधि ।जातवेदो नि धीमह्यग्ने हव्याय वोळ्हवे ॥

transliteration.text: íḷāyāḥ ǀ tvā ǀ padé ǀ vayám ǀ nā́bhā ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀjā́ta-vedaḥ ǀ ní ǀ dhīmahi ǀ ágne ǀ havyā́ya ǀ vóḷhave ǁ

Sukta 29.translation: “Agniwho isJātavedas, we plural ce you upon the earth in the centre, in the plural ce of Iḷā, for the purpose of receiving the oblation.”
Sukta 29.sanskrit_wisdomlib: इळा॑यास्त्वा प॒दे व॒यं नाभा॑ पृथि॒व्या अधि॑ । जात॑वेदो॒ नि धी॑म॒ह्यग्ने॑ ह॒व्याय॒ वोळ्ह॑वे

devanagari.text: मंथता नरः कविमद्वयंतं प्रचेतसममृतं सुप्रतीकं ।यज्ञस्य केतुं प्रथमं पुरस्तादग्निं नरो जनयता सुशेवं ॥

transliteration.text: mánthata ǀ naraḥ ǀ kavím ǀ ádvayantam ǀ prá-cetasam ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ su-prátīkam ǀyajñásya ǀ ketúm ǀ prathamám ǀ purástāt ǀ agním ǀ naraḥ ǀ janayata ǀ su-śévam ǁ

Sukta 29.translation: “Conductors of the rite, produce by attrition the far-seeing, single-minded, intelligent, immortal, radiant-limbedAgni; genitive rate him, leaders (of the solemnity), in the first plural ce the chief standard of the sacrifice, who is the source of felicity.”
Sukta 29.sanskrit_wisdomlib: मन्थ॑ता नरः क॒विमद्व॑यन्तं॒ प्रचे॑तसम॒मृतं॑ सु॒प्रती॑कम् । य॒ज्ञस्य॑ के॒तुं प्र॑थ॒मं पु॒रस्ता॑द॒ग्निं न॑रो जनयता सु॒शेव॑म्

devanagari.text: यदी मंथंति बाहुभिर्वि रोचतेऽश्वो न वाज्यरुषो वनेष्वा ।चित्रो न यामन्नश्विनोरनिवृतः परि वृणक्त्यश्मनस्तृणा दहन् ॥

transliteration.text: yádi ǀ mánthanti ǀ bāhú-bhiḥ ǀ ví ǀ rocate ǀ áśvaḥ ǀ ná ǀ vājī́ ǀ aruṣáḥ ǀ váneṣu ǀ ā́ ǀcitráḥ ǀ ná ǀ yā́man ǀ aśvínoḥ ǀ áni-vṛtaḥ ǀ pári ǀ vṛṇakti ǀ áśmanaḥ ǀ tṛ́ṇā ǀ dáhan ǁ

Sukta 29.translation: “When they rub (the sticks) with their arms the radiantAgnibursts forth from the wood like a fleet courser, and like the many-coloured car of theAśvinsunresisted in its course, Agni spreads wide around consuming stones and trees.”
Sukta 29.sanskrit_wisdomlib: यदी॒ मन्थ॑न्ति बा॒हुभि॒र्वि रो॑च॒तेऽश्वो॒ न वा॒ज्य॑रु॒षो वने॒ष्वा । चि॒त्रो न याम॑न्न॒श्विनो॒रनि॑वृत॒: परि॑ वृण॒क्त्यश्म॑न॒स्तृणा॒ दह॑न्

devanagari.text: जातो अग्नी रोचते चेकितानो वाजी विप्रः कविशस्तः सुदानुः ।यं देवास ईड्यं विश्वविदं हव्यवाहमदधुरध्वरेषु ॥

transliteration.text: jātáḥ ǀ agníḥ ǀ rocate ǀ cékitānaḥ ǀ vājī́ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ kavi-śastáḥ ǀ su-dā́nuḥ ǀyám ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ ī́ḍyam ǀ viśva-vídam ǀ havya-vā́ham ǀ ádadhuḥ ǀ adhvaréṣu ǁ

Sukta 29.translation: “As soon as bornAgni, shines intelligent, swift-moving, skilled in rites, praised by the wise, and liberal in gifts; (and it is he) whom the gods have held as the bearer of oblations at sacrifices, adorable and all-knowing.”
Sukta 29.sanskrit_wisdomlib: जा॒तो अ॒ग्नी रो॑चते॒ चेकि॑तानो वा॒जी विप्र॑: कविश॒स्तः सु॒दानु॑: । यं दे॒वास॒ ईड्यं॑ विश्व॒विदं॑ हव्य॒वाह॒मद॑धुरध्व॒रेषु॑

devanagari.text: सीद होतः स्व उ लोके चिकित्वान्त्सादया यज्ञं सुकृतस्य योनौ ।देवावीर्देवान्हविषा यजास्यग्ने बृहद्यजमाने वयो धाः ॥

transliteration.text: sī́da ǀ hotaríti ǀ své ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ loké ǀ cikitvā́n ǀ sādáya ǀ yajñám ǀ su-kṛtásya ǀ yónau ǀdeva-avī́ḥ ǀ devā́n ǀ havíṣā ǀ yajāsi ǀ ágne ǀ bṛhát ǀ yájamāne ǀ váyaḥ ǀ dhāḥ ǁ

Sukta 29.translation: “Offerer of oblations sit down in your own sphere, for you are cognizant (of holy acts), and station the instrumental tutor of the ceremony in the chief plural ce of the sacred rite; cherisher of the gods, worship the gods,Agni, and bestow abundant food on the founder of the sacrifice.”
Sukta 29.sanskrit_wisdomlib: सीद॑ होत॒: स्व उ॑ लो॒के चि॑कि॒त्वान्त्सा॒दया॑ य॒ज्ञं सु॑कृ॒तस्य॒ योनौ॑ । दे॒वा॒वीर्दे॒वान्ह॒विषा॑ यजा॒स्यग्ने॑ बृ॒हद्यज॑माने॒ वयो॑ धाः

devanagari.text: कृणोत धूमं वृषणं सखायोऽस्रेधंत इतन वाजमच्छ ।अयमग्निः पृतनाषाट् सुवीरो येन देवासो असहंत दस्यून् ॥

transliteration.text: kṛṇóta ǀ dhūmám ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇam ǀ sakhāyaḥ ǀ ásredhantaḥ ǀ itana ǀ vā́jam ǀ áccha ǀayám ǀ agníḥ ǀ pṛtanāṣā́ṭ ǀ su-vī́raḥ ǀ yéna ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ ásahanta ǀ dásyūn ǁ

Sukta 29.translation: “Produce, friends, smoke, the showerer (of benefits); indefatigable person st in the contest with (Agni); the heroic Agni is able to encounter hosts, and by him the gods overcome their foes.”
Sukta 29.sanskrit_wisdomlib: कृ॒णोत॑ धू॒मं वृष॑णं सखा॒योऽस्रे॑धन्त इतन॒ वाज॒मच्छ॑ । अ॒यम॒ग्निः पृ॑तना॒षाट् सु॒वीरो॒ येन॑ दे॒वासो॒ अस॑हन्त॒ दस्यू॑न्

devanagari.text: अयं ते योनिर्ऋत्वियो यतो जातो अरोचथाः ।तं जानन्नग्न आ सीदाथा नो वर्धया गिरः ॥

Sukta 29.translation: “This in every season,Agni, is your plural ce, whence, as soon as genitive rated, you have ever shone; knowing that to be so, Agni, there abide, and thrive by our praises.”
Sukta 29.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒यं ते॒ योनि॑ॠ॒त्वियो॒ यतो॑ जा॒तो अरो॑चथाः । तं जा॒नन्न॑ग्न॒ आ सी॒दाथा॑ नो वर्धया॒ गिर॑:

Sukta 29.translation: “When (existing) as an embryo (in the wood),Agniis called Tanunapāt; when he is genitive rated (he is called) theasura-destroying narāśam,sa; when he has displayed (his energy) in the material firmament,Mātariśvan; and the creation of the wind is in his rapid motion.”
Sukta 29.sanskrit_wisdomlib: तनू॒नपा॑दुच्यते॒ गर्भ॑ आसु॒रो नरा॒शंसो॑ भवति॒ यद्वि॒जाय॑ते । मा॒त॒रिश्वा॒ यदमि॑मीत मा॒तरि॒ वात॑स्य॒ सर्गो॑ अभव॒त्सरी॑मणि

devanagari.text: सुनिर्मथा निर्मथितः सुनिधा निहितः कविः ।अग्ने स्वध्वरा कृणु देवांदेवयते यज ॥

transliteration.text: suniḥ-máthā ǀ níḥ-mathitaḥ ǀ su-nidhā́ ǀ ní-hitaḥ ǀ kavíḥ ǀágne ǀ su-adhvarā́ ǀ kṛṇu ǀ devā́n ǀ deva-yaté ǀ yaja ǁ

Sukta 29.translation: “Agni, who is pronounced by reverential attrition, and deposited with reverential care, and who are far-seeing, render our rites (exempt from defects), and worship the gods (on behalf) of the devout worshipper.”
Sukta 29.sanskrit_wisdomlib: सु॒नि॒र्मथा॒ निर्म॑थितः सुनि॒धा निहि॑तः क॒विः । अग्ने॑ स्वध्व॒रा कृ॑णु दे॒वान्दे॑वय॒ते य॑ज

devanagari.text: अजीजनन्नमृतं मर्त्यासोऽस्रेमाणं तरणिं वीळुजंभं ।दश स्वसारो अग्रुवः समीचीः पुमांसं जातमभि सं रभंते ॥

transliteration.text: ájījanan ǀ amṛ́tam ǀ mártyāsaḥ ǀ asremā́ṇam ǀ taráṇim ǀ vīḷú-jambham ǀdáśa ǀ svásāraḥ ǀ agrúvaḥ ǀ sam-īcī́ḥ ǀ púmāṃsam ǀ jātám ǀ abhí ǀ sám ǀ rabhante ǁ

Sukta 29.translation: “Mortals have begotten the immortals, the undecaying (Agni), the devourer of oblations, the conveyance (by which they cross over sin), the ten sister fingers intertwined proclaim him born as if it was amale(infant).”
Sukta 29.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अजी॑जनन्न॒मृतं॒ मर्त्या॑सोऽस्रे॒माणं॑ त॒रणिं॑ वी॒ळुज॑म्भम् । दश॒ स्वसा॑रो अ॒ग्रुव॑: समी॒चीः पुमां॑सं जा॒तम॒भि सं र॑भन्ते

devanagari.text: प्र सप्तहोता सनकादरोचत मातुरुपस्थे यदशोचदूधनि ।न नि मिषति सुरणो दिवेदिवे यदसुरस्य जठरादजायत ॥

transliteration.text: prá ǀ saptá-hotā ǀ sanakā́t ǀ arocata ǀ mātúḥ ǀ upá-sthe ǀ yát ǀ áśocat ǀ ū́dhani ǀná ǀ ní ǀ miṣati ǀ su-ráṇaḥ ǀ divé-dive ǀ yát ǀ ásurasya ǀ jaṭhárāt ǀ ájāyata ǁ

Sukta 29.translation: “Agni, who has seven ministering priests, shines eternally; when he has blazed upon the bosom and lap of his mother (earth), he is vociferous (with delight); day by day he never slumbers after he is born from the interior of the (spark) emitting wood.”
Sukta 29.sanskrit_wisdomlib: प्र स॒प्तहो॑ता सन॒काद॑रोचत मा॒तुरु॒पस्थे॒ यदशो॑च॒दूध॑नि । न नि मि॑षति सु॒रणो॑ दि॒वेदि॑वे॒ यदसु॑रस्य ज॒ठरा॒दजा॑यत

devanagari.text: अमित्रायुधो मरुतामिव प्रयाः प्रथमजा ब्रह्मणो विश्वमिद्विदुः ।द्युम्नवद्ब्रह्म कुशिकास एरिर एकएको दमे अग्निं समीधिरे ॥

transliteration.text: amitra-yúdhaḥ ǀ marútām-iva ǀ pra-yā́ḥ ǀ prathama-jā́ḥ ǀ bráhmaṇaḥ ǀ víśvam ǀ ít ǀ viduḥ ǀdyumná-vat ǀ bráhma ǀ kuśikā́saḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ īrire ǀ ékaḥ-ekaḥ ǀ dáme ǀ agním ǀ sám ǀ īdhire ǁ

Sukta 29.translation: “TheKuśikas, the first-born ofBrahmā, armed against enemies like the energies of theMaruts, comprehend the universe; they have uttered the prayer accompanied by the oblation; they have one by one lightedAgniin this dwelling.”
Sukta 29.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒मि॒त्रा॒युधो॑ म॒रुता॑मिव प्र॒याः प्र॑थम॒जा ब्रह्म॑णो॒ विश्व॒मिद्वि॑दुः । द्यु॒म्नव॒द्ब्रह्म॑ कुशि॒कास॒ एरि॑र॒ एक॑एको॒ दमे॑ अ॒ग्निं समी॑धिरे

devanagari.text: यदद्य त्वा प्रयति यज्ञे अस्मिन्होतश्चिकित्वोऽवृणीमहीह ।ध्रुवमया ध्रुवमुताशमिष्ठाः प्रजानन्विद्वाँ उप याहि सोमं ॥

transliteration.text: yát ǀ adyá ǀ tvā ǀ pra-yatí ǀ yajñé ǀ asmín ǀ hótaríti ǀ cikitvaḥ ǀ ávṛṇīmahi ǀ ihá ǀdhruvám ǀ ayāḥ ǀ dhruvám ǀ utá ǀ aśamiṣṭhāḥ ǀ pra-jānán ǀ vidvā́n ǀ úpa ǀ yāhi ǀ sómam ǁ

Sukta 29.translation: “Agni, offerer of oblations, cognizant of rites, inasmuch as we have recourse to you today in this progressing sacrifice, therefore do you steadily convey (the offering to the gods), or tranquilly be at rest, and knowing (the purport of our acts), and wise (in all respects), approach (and accept) theSoma.”
Sukta 29.sanskrit_wisdomlib: यद॒द्य त्वा॑ प्रय॒ति य॒ज्ञे अ॒स्मिन्होत॑श्चिकि॒त्वोऽवृ॑णीमही॒ह । ध्रु॒वम॑या ध्रु॒वमु॒ताश॑मिष्ठाः प्रजा॒नन्वि॒द्वाँ उप॑ याहि॒ सोम॑म्

devanagari.text: इच्छंति त्वा सोम्यासः सखायः सुन्वंति सोमं दधति प्रयांसि ।तितिक्षंते अभिशस्तिं जनानामिंद्र त्वदा कश्चन हि प्रकेतः ॥

transliteration.text: icchánti ǀ tvā ǀ somyā́saḥ ǀ sákhāyaḥ ǀ sunvánti ǀ sómam ǀ dádhati ǀ práyāṃsi ǀtítikṣante ǀ abhí-śastim ǀ jánānām ǀ índra ǀ tvát ǀ ā́ ǀ káḥ ǀ caná ǀ hí ǀ pra-ketáḥ ǁ

Sukta 30.translation: “The bearers of the libations desire you; your friends pour forth theSoma; they offer copious oblations; (supported by) you they endure patiently the calumny of men, for who is so renowned as you are.”
Sukta 30.sanskrit_wisdomlib: इ॒च्छन्ति॑ त्वा सो॒म्यास॒: सखा॑यः सु॒न्वन्ति॒ सोमं॒ दध॑ति॒ प्रयां॑सि । तिति॑क्षन्ते अ॒भिश॑स्तिं॒ जना॑ना॒मिन्द्र॒ त्वदा कश्च॒न हि प्र॑के॒तः

Sukta 30.translation: “Master of tawny steeds, the remotest regions are not remote for you; then come quickly with your horses; to you the steady showerer (of benefits), these sacrifices are presented; the stones (for bruising theSoma) are ready, as the fire is being kindled.”
Sukta 30.sanskrit_wisdomlib: न ते॑ दू॒रे प॑र॒मा चि॒द्रजां॒स्या तु प्र या॑हि हरिवो॒ हरि॑भ्याम् । स्थि॒राय॒ वृष्णे॒ सव॑ना कृ॒तेमा यु॒क्ता ग्रावा॑णः समिधा॒ने अ॒ग्नौ

devanagari.text: इंद्रः सुशिप्रो मघवा तरुत्रो महाव्रातस्तुविकूर्मिर्ऋघावान् ।यदुग्रो धा बाधितो मर्त्येषु क्व त्या ते वृषभ वीर्याणि ॥

transliteration.text: índraḥ ǀ su-śípraḥ ǀ maghá-vā ǀ tárutraḥ ǀ mahā́-vrātaḥ ǀ tuvi-kūrmíḥ ǀ ṛ́ghāvān ǀyát ǀ ugráḥ ǀ dhā́ḥ ǀ bādhitáḥ ǀ mártyeṣu ǀ kvá ǀ tyā́ ǀ te ǀ vṛṣabha ǀ vīryā́ṇi ǁ

Sukta 30.translation: “Showerer (of benefits), who areIndra, the wearer of the helmet, the professor of opulence, the conveyor (of men beyond the evil), the leader of the numerous troops (of theMaruts), the achiever of many great deeds, the devastation of hostile (regions), the terror of your foes, where are those heroic deeds (which you have performed) against the mortal (asuras) when opposed (by them in battle).”
Sukta 30.sanskrit_wisdomlib: इन्द्र॑: सु॒शिप्रो॑ म॒घवा॒ तरु॑त्रो म॒हाव्रा॑तस्तुविकू॒र्मिॠघा॑वान् । यदु॒ग्रो धा बा॑धि॒तो मर्त्ये॑षु॒ क्व१॒॑ त्या ते॑ वृषभ वी॒र्या॑णि

devanagari.text: त्वं हि ष्मा च्यावयन्नच्युतान्येको वृत्रा चरसि जिघ्नमानः ।तव द्यावापृथिवी पर्वतासोऽनु व्रताय निमितेव तस्थुः ॥

transliteration.text: tvám ǀ hí ǀ sma ǀ cyaváyan ǀ ácyutāni ǀ ékaḥ ǀ vṛtrā́ ǀ cárasi ǀ jíghnamānaḥ ǀtáva ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ párvatāsaḥ ǀ ánu ǀ vratā́ya ǀ nímitā-iva ǀ tasthuḥ ǁ

Sukta 30.translation: “You alone casting down the firmly-footed (asuras) proceed, destroying theVṛtras, and obedient to your command the heaven and earth and the mountains stood as if immoveable.”
Sukta 30.sanskrit_wisdomlib: त्वं हि ष्मा॑ च्या॒वय॒न्नच्यु॑ता॒न्येको॑ वृ॒त्रा चर॑सि॒ जिघ्न॑मानः । तव॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी पर्व॑ता॒सोऽनु॑ व्र॒ताय॒ निमि॑तेव तस्थुः

Sukta 30.translation: “You alone, when invoked by many, and the slayer ofVṛtra, by your prowess, did say firmly (to the gods), fear not!Indra, endowed with opulence, vast is your grasp, wherewith you have seized these unbounded regions, heaven and earth.”
Sukta 30.sanskrit_wisdomlib: उ॒ताभ॑ये पुरुहूत॒ श्रवो॑भि॒रेको॑ दृ॒ळ्हम॑वदो वृत्र॒हा सन् । इ॒मे चि॑दिन्द्र॒ रोद॑सी अपा॒रे यत्सं॑गृ॒भ्णा म॑घवन्का॒शिरित्ते॑

devanagari.text: प्र सू त इंद्र प्रवता हरिभ्यां प्र ते वज्रः प्रमृणन्नेतु शत्रून् ।जहि प्रतीचो अनूचः पराचो विश्वं सत्यं कृणुहि विष्टमस्तु ॥

Sukta 30.translation: “Let (your car),Indra, drawn by your horses (rush) downwards (upon theasuras); let your destroying thunder-bolt fall upon your enemies; slay those that assail in front or in rear, or that fly (from the combat); make the universe (the abode of) truth; (let such power) be concentrated in you.”
Sukta 30.sanskrit_wisdomlib: प्र सू त॑ इन्द्र प्र॒वता॒ हरि॑भ्यां॒ प्र ते॒ वज्र॑: प्रमृ॒णन्ने॑तु॒ शत्रू॑न् । ज॒हि प्र॑ती॒चो अ॑नू॒चः परा॑चो॒ विश्वं॑ स॒त्यं कृ॑णुहि वि॒ष्टम॑स्तु

transliteration.text: yásmai ǀ dhā́yuḥ ǀ ádadhāḥ ǀ mártyāya ǀ ábhaktam ǀ cit ǀ bhajate ǀ gehyám ǀ sáḥ ǀbhadrā́ ǀ te ǀ indra ǀ su-matíḥ ǀ ghṛtā́cī ǀ sahásra-dānā ǀ puru-hūta ǀ rātíḥ ǁ

Sukta 30.translation: “The man to whom you grant, lord of power, (your good-will), enjoys unprecedented domestic (prosperity);Indra, who are invoked by many, your auspicous favour, which is obtained by oblations, is the giver of unbounded wealth.”
Sukta 30.sanskrit_wisdomlib: यस्मै॒ धायु॒रद॑धा॒ मर्त्या॒याभ॑क्तं चिद्भजते गे॒ह्यं१॒॑ सः । भ॒द्रा त॑ इन्द्र सुम॒तिर्घृ॒ताची॑ स॒हस्र॑दाना पुरुहूत रा॒तिः

Sukta 30.translation: “Indra, who is invoked by many, grind to dust the reviling malevolentVṛtraopposing you, dwelling with the mother of theDānavas, and increasing in might, until having deprived him ofhandand foot, you have destroyed him by your strength.”
Sukta 30.sanskrit_wisdomlib: स॒हदा॑नुं पुरुहूत क्षि॒यन्त॑मह॒स्तमि॑न्द्र॒ सं पि॑ण॒क्कुणा॑रुम् । अ॒भि वृ॒त्रं वर्ध॑मानं॒ पिया॑रुम॒पाद॑मिन्द्र त॒वसा॑ जघन्थ

Sukta 30.translation: “You have fixed tranquil in its position the vast unbounded and wandering earth; the showerer (of benefits) has upheld the heaven and the firmament; let the waters engendered by you here descend.”
Sukta 30.sanskrit_wisdomlib: नि सा॑म॒नामि॑षि॒रामि॑न्द्र॒ भूमिं॑ म॒हीम॑पा॒रां सद॑ने ससत्थ । अस्त॑भ्ना॒द्द्यां वृ॑ष॒भो अ॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒मर्ष॒न्त्वाप॒स्त्वये॒ह प्रसू॑ताः

devanagari.text: अलातृणो वल इंद्र व्रजो गोः पुरा हंतोर्भयमानो व्यार ।सुगान्पथो अकृणोन्निरजे गाः प्रावन्वाणीः पुरुहूतं धमंतीः ॥
