Sukta 49.translation: “Like a father (for a son), I brought under subjection toKutsa, at his desire, the Vetasūs and Tugraand Smadibha I have been in plural ce of a sovereign to the worshipper when I bring (to him) as to a son acceptable(gifts) for assailing (his enemies).”
Sukta 49.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒हं पि॒तेव॑ वेत॒सूँर॒भिष्ट॑ये॒ तुग्रं॒ कुत्सा॑य॒ स्मदि॑भं च रन्धयम् । अ॒हं भु॑वं॒ यज॑मानस्य रा॒जनि॒ प्र यद्भरे॒ तुज॑ये॒ न प्रि॒याधृषे॑

devanagari.text: अहं रंधयं मृगयं श्रुतर्वणे यन्माजिहीत वयुना चनानुषक् ।अहं वेशं नम्रमायवेऽकरमहं सव्याय पड्गृभिमरंधयं ॥
अहम् । रन्धयम् । मृगयम् । श्रुतर्वणे । यत् । मा । अजिहीत । वयुना । चन । आनुषक् ।अहम् । वेशम् । नम्रम् । आयवे । अकरम् । अहम् । सव्याय । पट्ऽगृभिम् । अरन्धयम् ॥

transliteration.text: ahám ǀ randhayam ǀ mṛ́gayam ǀ śrutárvaṇe ǀ yát ǀ mā ǀ ájihīta ǀ vayúnā ǀ caná ǀ ānuṣák ǀahám ǀ veśám ǀ namrám ǀ āyáve ǀ akaram ǀ ahám ǀ sávyāya ǀ páṭ-gṛbhim ǀ arandhayam ǁ

Sukta 49.translation: “I have broughtMṛgayaunder subjection to Śrutarvan; when he came to me, (he was) earnestlyengaged in supplication. I humiliatedVeśafor Āyu; I subjugated Padgṛbhi forSavya.”
Sukta 49.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒हं र॑न्धयं॒ मृग॑यं श्रु॒तर्व॑णे॒ यन्माजि॑हीत व॒युना॑ च॒नानु॒षक् । अ॒हं वे॒शं न॒म्रमा॒यवे॑ऽकरम॒हं सव्या॑य॒ पड्गृ॑भिमरन्धयम्

devanagari.text: अहं स यो नववास्त्वं बृहद्रथं सं वृत्रेव दासं वृत्रहारुजं ।यद्वर्धयंतं प्रथयंतमानुषग्दूरे पारे रजसो रोचनाकरं ॥
अहम् । सः । यः । नवऽवास्त्वम् । बृहत्ऽरथम् । सम् । वृत्राऽइव । दासम् । वृत्रऽहा । अरुजम् ।यत् । वर्धयन्तम् । प्रथयन्तम् । आनुषक् । दूरे । पारे । रजसः । रोचना । अकरम् ॥

transliteration.text: ahám ǀ sáḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ náva-vāstvam ǀ bṛhát-ratham ǀ sám ǀ vṛtrā́-iva ǀ dā́sam ǀ vṛtra-hā́ ǀ árujam ǀyát ǀ vardháyantam ǀ pratháyantam ǀ ānuṣák ǀ dūré ǀ pāré ǀ rájasaḥ ǀ rocanā́ ǀ ákaram ǁ

Sukta 49.translation: “I, the slayer ofVṛtra, am he who crushed Navavāstva andBṛhadratha, (who crushed)Dāsalike aVṛtra, when I drove to the distant shore of the shining world, (both) my augmenting and outstretched (foes) oneafter the other.”
Sukta 49.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒हं स यो नव॑वास्त्वं बृ॒हद्र॑थं॒ सं वृ॒त्रेव॒ दासं॑ वृत्र॒हारु॑जम् । यद्व॒र्धय॑न्तं प्र॒थय॑न्तमानु॒षग्दू॒रे पा॒रे रज॑सो रोच॒नाक॑रम्

devanagari.text: अहं सूर्यस्य परि याम्याशुभिः प्रैतशेभिर्वहमान ओजसा ।यन्मा सावो मनुष आह निर्णिज ऋधक्कृषे दासं कृत्व्यं हथैः ॥
अहम् । सूर्यस्य । परि । यामि । आशुऽभिः । प्र । एतशेभिः । वहमानः । ओजसा ।यत् । मा । सावः । मनुषः । आह । निःऽनिजे । ऋधक् । कृषे । दासम् । कृत्व्यम् । हथैः ॥

transliteration.text: ahám ǀ sū́ryasya ǀ pári ǀ yāmi ǀ āśú-bhiḥ ǀ prá ǀ etaśébhiḥ ǀ váhamānaḥ ǀ ójasā ǀyát ǀ mā ǀ sāváḥ ǀ mánuṣaḥ ǀ ā́ha ǀ niḥ-níje ǀ ṛ́dhak ǀ kṛṣe ǀ dā́sam ǀ kṛ́tvyam ǀ háthaiḥ ǁ

Sukta 49.translation: “Conveyed by the swift white horses ofSūrya, I hasten forth by my power; when the effused libation ofa man invokes me to the brilliant form of the sacrifice, I drive off with my weapons the destroyer who is to beslain.”
Sukta 49.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒हं सूर्य॑स्य॒ परि॑ याम्या॒शुभि॒: प्रैत॒शेभि॒र्वह॑मान॒ ओज॑सा । यन्मा॑ सा॒वो मनु॑ष॒ आह॑ नि॒र्णिज॒ ऋध॑क्कृषे॒ दासं॒ कृत्व्यं॒ हथै॑:

devanagari.text: अहं सप्तहा नहुषो नहुष्टरः प्राश्रावयं शवसा तुर्वशं यदुं ।अहं न्यन्यं सहसा सहस्करं नव व्राधतो नवतिं च वक्षयं ॥
अहम् । सप्तऽहा । नहुषः । नहुःऽतरः । प्र । अश्रवयम् । शवसा । तुर्वशम् । यदुम् ।अहम् । नि । अन्यम् । सहसा । सहः । करम् । नव । व्राधतः । नवतिम् । च । वक्षयम् ॥

transliteration.text: ahám ǀ sapta-hā́ ǀ náhuṣaḥ ǀ náhuḥ-taraḥ ǀ prá ǀ aśravayam ǀ śávasā ǀ turváśam ǀ yádum ǀahám ǀ ní ǀ anyám ǀ sáhasā ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ karam ǀ náva ǀ vrā́dhataḥ ǀ navatím ǀ ca ǀ vakṣayam ǁ

Sukta 49.translation: “I am the slayer of seven (asuras); I am the especial bond of bonds; I have madeTurvaśaand Yadufamous through prowess; I have strengthened another (worshipper) with strength; I have demolished ninety andnine powerful (foes).”
Sukta 49.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒हं स॑प्त॒हा नहु॑षो॒ नहु॑ष्टर॒: प्राश्रा॑वयं॒ शव॑सा तु॒र्वशं॒ यदु॑म् । अ॒हं न्य१॒॑न्यं सह॑सा॒ सह॑स्करं॒ नव॒ व्राध॑तो नव॒तिं च॑ वक्षयम्

devanagari.text: अहं सप्त स्रवतो धारयं वृषा द्रवित्न्वः पृथिव्यां सीरा अधि ।अहमर्णांसि वि तिरामि सुक्रतुर्युधा विदं मनवे गातुमिष्टये ॥
अहम् । सप्त । स्रवतः । धारयम् । वृषा । द्रवित्न्वः । पृथिव्याम् । सीराः । अधि ।अहम् । अर्णांसि । वि । तिरामि । सुऽक्रतुः । युधा । विदम् । मनवे । गातुम् । इष्टये ॥

transliteration.text: ahám ǀ saptá ǀ sravátaḥ ǀ dhārayam ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ dravitnváḥ ǀ pṛthivyā́m ǀ sīrā́ḥ ǀ ádhi ǀahám ǀ árṇāṃsi ǀ ví ǀ tirāmi ǀ su-krátuḥ ǀ yudhā́ ǀ vidam ǀ mánave ǀ gātúm ǀ iṣṭáye ǁ

Sukta 49.translation: “The showerer (of rain), I supported the seven rivers flowing and meandering over the earth; doer ofgood deeds, I spread out the waters; I found by war a path for man to go in.”
Sukta 49.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒हं स॒प्त स्र॒वतो॑ धारयं॒ वृषा॑ द्रवि॒त्न्व॑: पृथि॒व्यां सी॒रा अधि॑ । अ॒हमर्णां॑सि॒ वि ति॑रामि सु॒क्रतु॑र्यु॒धा वि॑दं॒ मन॑वे गा॒तुमि॒ष्टये॑

devanagari.text: अहं तदासु धारयं यदासु न देवश्चन त्वष्टाधारयद्रुशत् ।स्पार्हं गवामूधस्सु वक्षणास्वा मधोर्मधु श्वात्र्यं सोममाशिरं ॥
अहम् । तत् । आसु । धारयम् । यत् । आसु । न । देवः । चन । त्वष्टा । अधारयत् । रुशत् ।स्पार्हम् । गवाम् । ऊधःऽसु । वक्षणासु । आ । मधोः । मधु । श्वात्र्यम् । सोमम् । आऽशिरम् ॥

transliteration.text: ahám ǀ tát ǀ āsu ǀ dhārayam ǀ yát ǀ āsu ǀ ná ǀ deváḥ ǀ caná ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ ádhārayat ǀ rúśat ǀspārhám ǀ gávām ǀ ū́dhaḥ-su ǀ vakṣáṇāsu ǀ ā́ ǀ mádhoḥ ǀ mádhu ǀ śvā́tryam ǀ sómam ǀ ā-śíram ǁ

Sukta 49.translation: “I have kept up in them that which no deity, not evenTvaṣṭā, has maintained, bright, desirable,(contained) in the udders of the cows; in the rivers (I uphold) the water up to the (source of the) water, thedelightfulSomaand the milk and curds.”
Sukta 49.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒हं तदा॑सु धारयं॒ यदा॑सु॒ न दे॒वश्च॒न त्वष्टाधा॑रय॒द्रुश॑त् । स्पा॒र्हं गवा॒मूध॑स्सु व॒क्षणा॒स्वा मधो॒र्मधु॒ श्वात्र्यं॒ सोम॑मा॒शिर॑म्

devanagari.text: एवा देवाँ इंद्रो विव्ये नॄन्प्र च्यौत्नेन मघवा सत्यराधाः ।विश्वेत्ता ते हरिवः शचीवोऽभि तुरासः स्वयशो गृणंति ॥
एव । देवान् । इन्द्रः । विव्ये । नॄन् । प्र । च्यौत्नेन । मघऽवा । सत्यऽराधाः ।विश्वा । इत् । ता । ते । हरिऽवः । शचीऽवः । अभि । तुरासः । स्वऽयशः । गृणन्ति ॥

transliteration.text: evá ǀ devā́n ǀ índraḥ ǀ vivye ǀ nṝ́n ǀ prá ǀ cyautnéna ǀ maghá-vā ǀ satyá-rādhāḥ ǀvíśvā ǀ ít ǀ tā́ ǀ te ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ śacī-vaḥ ǀ abhí ǀ turā́saḥ ǀ sva-yaśaḥ ǀ gṛṇanti ǁ

Sukta 49.sanskrit_wisdomlib: ए॒वा दे॒वाँ इन्द्रो॑ विव्ये॒ नॄन्प्र च्यौ॒त्नेन॑ म॒घवा॑ स॒त्यरा॑धाः । विश्वेत्ता ते॑ हरिवः शचीवो॒ऽभि तु॒रास॑: स्वयशो गृणन्ति

devanagari.text: प्र वो महे मंदमानायांधसोऽर्चा विश्वानराय विश्वाभुवे ।इंद्रस्य यस्य सुमखं सहो महि श्रवो नृम्णं च रोदसी सपर्यतः ॥
प्र । वः । महे । मन्दमानाय । अन्धसः । अर्च । विश्वानराय । विश्वऽभुवे ।इन्द्रस्य । यस्य । सुऽमखम् । सहः । महि । श्रवः । नृम्णम् । च । रोदसी इति । सपर्यतः ॥

transliteration.text: prá ǀ vaḥ ǀ mahé ǀ mándamānāya ǀ ándhasaḥ ǀ árca ǀ viśvā́narāya ǀ viśva-bhúve ǀíndrasya ǀ yásya ǀ sú-makham ǀ sáhaḥ ǀ máhi ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ nṛmṇám ǀ ca ǀ ródasī íti ǀ saparyátaḥ ǁ

Sukta 50.translation: “Worship him who is exhilarated by the sacrificiial food, the mightyIndra; the leader of all men, thecreator of all, whose venerable strength and abundant food and wealth, heaven and earth adore.”
Sukta 50.sanskrit_wisdomlib: प्र वो॑ म॒हे मन्द॑माना॒यान्ध॒सोऽर्चा॑ वि॒श्वान॑राय विश्वा॒भुवे॑ । इन्द्र॑स्य॒ यस्य॒ सुम॑खं॒ सहो॒ महि॒ श्रवो॑ नृ॒म्णं च॒ रोद॑सी सप॒र्यत॑:

devanagari.text: सो चिन्नु सख्या नर्य इनः स्तुतश्चर्कृत्य इंद्रो मावते नरे ।विश्वासु धूर्षु वाजकृत्येषु सत्पते वृत्रे वाप्स्वभि शूर मंदसे ॥
सः । चित् । नु । सख्या । नर्यः । इनः । स्तुतः । चर्कृत्यः । इन्द्रः । माऽवते । नरे ।विश्वासु । धूःऽसु । वाजऽकृत्येषु । सत्ऽपते । वृत्रे । वा । अप्ऽसु । अभि । शूर । मन्दसे ॥

transliteration.text: sáḥ ǀ cit ǀ nú ǀ sákhyā ǀ náryaḥ ǀ ináḥ ǀ stutáḥ ǀ carkṛ́tyaḥ ǀ índraḥ ǀ mā́-vate ǀ náre ǀvíśvāsu ǀ dhūḥ-sú ǀ vāja-kṛ́tyeṣu ǀ sat-pate ǀ vṛtré ǀ vā ǀ ap-sú ǀ abhí ǀ śūra ǀ mandase ǁ

Sukta 50.translation: “ThatIndra, kind to man, the lord of all, who is praised by his friend, is to be repeatedly honoured bymen like me; you, hero, protector of the good, are glorified in the all-sustaining food-producing cloud-imprisonedwaters.”
Sukta 50.sanskrit_wisdomlib: सो चि॒न्नु सख्या॒ नर्य॑ इ॒नः स्तु॒तश्च॒र्कृत्य॒ इन्द्रो॒ माव॑ते॒ नरे॑ । विश्वा॑सु धू॒र्षु वा॑ज॒कृत्ये॑षु सत्पते वृ॒त्रे वा॒प्स्व१॒॑भि शू॑र मन्दसे

devanagari.text: के ते नर इंद्र ये त इषे ये ते सुम्नं सधन्यमियक्षान् ।के ते वाजायासुर्याय हिन्विरे के अप्सु स्वासूर्वरासु पौंस्ये ॥
के । ते । नरः । इन्द्र । ये । ते । इषे । ये । ते । सुम्नम् । सऽधन्यम् । इयक्षान् ।के । ते । वाजाय । असुर्याय । हिन्विरे । के । अप्ऽसु । स्वासु । उर्वरासु । पौंस्ये ॥

transliteration.text: ké ǀ té ǀ náraḥ ǀ indra ǀ yé ǀ te ǀ iṣé ǀ yé ǀ te ǀ sumnám ǀ sa-dhanyám ǀ íyakṣān ǀké ǀ te ǀ vā́jāya ǀ asuryā́ya ǀ hinvire ǀ ké ǀ ap-sú ǀ svā́su ǀ urvárāsu ǀ páuṃsye ǁ

Sukta 50.translation: “What men,Indra, are they who (are eminent in offering food to you, who are desirous of obtaining fromthe happiness and opulence, who send you (oblations) for the sake of strength (to fight) theasura, who (sentoblations) for the sake of obtaining spontaneously-flowing waters and cultivable lands, and manly vigour?”
Sukta 50.sanskrit_wisdomlib: के ते नर॑ इन्द्र॒ ये त॑ इ॒षे ये ते॑ सु॒म्नं स॑ध॒न्य१॒॑मिय॑क्षान् । के ते॒ वाजा॑यासु॒र्या॑य हिन्विरे॒ के अ॒प्सु स्वासू॒र्वरा॑सु॒ पौंस्ये॑

devanagari.text: भुवस्त्वमिंद्र ब्रह्मणा महान्भुवो विश्वेषु सवनेषु यज्ञियः ।भुवो नॄंश्च्यौत्नो विश्वस्मिन्भरे ज्येष्ठश्च मंत्रो विश्वचर्षणे ॥
भुवः । त्वम् । इन्द्र । ब्रह्मणा । महान् । भुवः । विश्वेषु । सवनेषु । यज्ञियः ।भुवः । नॄन् । च्यौत्नः । विश्वस्मिन् । भरे । ज्येष्ठः । च । मन्त्रः । विश्वऽचर्षणे ॥

Sukta 50.translation: “Indra, you have become mighty through our praise; you have have become adorable at all sacrifices,in every combat you are the caster down of the leaders (of hosts); beholder of all, you are the best, mostexcellent.”
Sukta 50.sanskrit_wisdomlib: भुव॒स्त्वमि॑न्द्र॒ ब्रह्म॑णा म॒हान्भुवो॒ विश्वे॑षु॒ सव॑नेषु य॒ज्ञिय॑: । भुवो॒ नॄँश्च्यौ॒त्नो विश्व॑स्मि॒न्भरे॒ ज्येष्ठ॑श्च॒ मन्त्रो॑ विश्वचर्षणे

Sukta 50.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अवा॒ नु कं॒ ज्याया॑न्य॒ज्ञव॑नसो म॒हीं त॒ ओमा॑त्रां कृ॒ष्टयो॑ विदुः । असो॒ नु क॑म॒जरो॒ वर्धा॑श्च॒ विश्वेदे॒ता सव॑ना तूतु॒मा कृ॑षे

Sukta 50.translation: “You make swift all those sacrifices which, son of strength, you yourself support; may your protectionbe granted for the repulse (of enemies, may) wealth (be granted) for our support; the sacrifice, the hymn, thesacred text, the voice (is) raised (to you).”
Sukta 50.sanskrit_wisdomlib: ए॒ता विश्वा॒ सव॑ना तूतु॒मा कृ॑षे स्व॒यं सू॑नो सहसो॒ यानि॑ दधि॒षे । वरा॑य ते॒ पात्रं॒ धर्म॑णे॒ तना॑ य॒ज्ञो मन्त्रो॒ ब्रह्मोद्य॑तं॒ वच॑:

Sukta 50.translation: “SageIndra, the reciters of pious hymns to you who assembled together when (theSoma) is effused,(worship you) for the donation of riches and treasures; may they be competent (to acquire) you felicity by thepathway of the mind; when you are exhilarated with the effused Soma food.”
Sukta 50.sanskrit_wisdomlib: ये ते॑ विप्र ब्रह्म॒कृत॑: सु॒ते सचा॒ वसू॑नां च॒ वसु॑नश्च दा॒वने॑ । प्र ते सु॒म्नस्य॒ मन॑सा प॒था भु॑व॒न्मदे॑ सु॒तस्य॑ सो॒म्यस्यान्ध॑सः

devanagari.text: महत्तदुल्बं स्थविरं तदासीद्येनाविष्टितः प्रविवेशिथापः ।विश्वा अपश्यद्बहुधा ते अग्ने जातवेदस्तन्वो देव एकः ॥

transliteration.text: mahát ǀ tát ǀ úlbam ǀ stháviram ǀ tát ǀ āsīt ǀ yéna ǀ ā́-viṣṭitaḥ ǀ pra-vivéśitha ǀ apáḥ ǀvíśvāḥ ǀ apaśyat ǀ bahudhā́ ǀ te ǀ agne ǀ jā́ta-vedaḥ ǀ tanváḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ ékaḥ ǁ

Sukta 51.translation: “(The gods speak). Great and very dense is the covering enveloped by which,Agni, you have enteredinto the waters. AgniJātavedas, one deity has beheld all your manifold forms.”
Sukta 51.sanskrit_wisdomlib: म॒हत्तदुल्बं॒ स्थवि॑रं॒ तदा॑सी॒द्येनावि॑ष्टितः प्रवि॒वेशि॑था॒पः । विश्वा॑ अपश्यद्बहु॒धा ते॑ अग्ने॒ जात॑वेदस्त॒न्वो॑ दे॒व एक॑:

devanagari.text: को मा ददर्श कतमः स देवो यो मे तन्वो बहुधा पर्यपश्यत् ।क्वाह मित्रावरुणा क्षियंत्यग्नेर्विश्वाः समिधो देवयानीः ॥

transliteration.text: káḥ ǀ mā ǀ dadarśa ǀ katamáḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ yáḥ ǀ me ǀ tanváḥ ǀ bahudhā́ ǀ pari-ápaśyat ǀkvá ǀ áha ǀ mitrāvaruṇā ǀ kṣiyanti ǀ agnéḥ ǀ víśvāḥ ǀ sam-ídhaḥ ǀ deva-yā́nīḥ ǁ

Sukta 51.translation: “(Agnispeaks). Who has beheld me? Which is it of the deities who has fully seen my manifold forms?WhereMitraandVaruṇa, do Agni's luminous vehicles of the gods abide?”
Sukta 51.sanskrit_wisdomlib: को मा॑ ददर्श कत॒मः स दे॒वो यो मे॑ त॒न्वो॑ बहु॒धा प॒र्यप॑श्यत् । क्वाह॑ मित्रावरुणा क्षियन्त्य॒ग्नेर्विश्वा॑: स॒मिधो॑ देव॒यानी॑:

devanagari.text: ऐच्छाम त्वा बहुधा जातवेदः प्रविष्टमग्ने अप्स्वोषधीषु ।तं त्वा यमो अचिकेच्चित्रभानो दशांतरुष्यादतिरोचमानं ॥

transliteration.text: áicchāma ǀ tvā ǀ bahudhā́ ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ prá-viṣṭam ǀ agne ǀ ap-sú ǀ óṣadhīṣu ǀtám ǀ tvā ǀ yamáḥ ǀ aciket ǀ citrabhāno íti citra-bhāno ǀ daśa-antaruṣyā́t ǀ ati-rócamānam ǁ

Sukta 51.translation: “(The gods). We sought for you,AgniJātavedas, who had entered in many ways into the waters, intothe plural nts;Yamarecognized you, who have adorable rays, blazing from your ten hiding-plural ces.”
Sukta 51.sanskrit_wisdomlib: ऐच्छा॑म त्वा बहु॒धा जा॑तवेद॒: प्रवि॑ष्टमग्ने अ॒प्स्वोष॑धीषु । तं त्वा॑ य॒मो अ॑चिकेच्चित्रभानो दशान्तरु॒ष्याद॑ति॒रोच॑मानम्

devanagari.text: होत्रादहं वरुण बिभ्यदायं नेदेव मा युनजन्नत्र देवाः ।तस्य मे तन्वो बहुधा निविष्टा एतमर्थं न चिकेताहमग्निः ॥

Sukta 51.translation: “(Agni). DivineVaruṇa, I have come hither, being afraid ofhotā, lest the gods should again associateme with him; my forms have therefore entered (into the waters) in various plural ces. I, Agni, do not consent (toundertake) that office.”
Sukta 51.sanskrit_wisdomlib: हो॒त्राद॒हं व॑रुण॒ बिभ्य॑दायं॒ नेदे॒व मा॑ यु॒नज॒न्नत्र॑ दे॒वाः । तस्य॑ मे त॒न्वो॑ बहु॒धा निवि॑ष्टा ए॒तमर्थं॒ न चि॑केता॒हम॒ग्निः

devanagari.text: एहि मनुर्देवयुर्यज्ञकामोऽरंकृत्या तमसि क्षेष्यग्ने ।सुगान्पथः कृणुहि देवयानान्वह हव्यानि सुमनस्यमानः ॥

Sukta 51.translation: “(The gods). Come,Agni, the devoutManu(is) desirous of offering sacrifice; adorning yourself, youabide in darkness; make straight the paths traversed by the gods, and with a benevolent mind convey ouroblations.”
Sukta 51.sanskrit_wisdomlib: एहि॒ मनु॑र्देव॒युर्य॒ज्ञका॑मोऽरं॒कृत्या॒ तम॑सि क्षेष्यग्ने । सु॒गान्प॒थः कृ॑णुहि देव॒याना॒न्वह॑ ह॒व्यानि॑ सुमन॒स्यमा॑नः

transliteration.text: agnéḥ ǀ pū́rve ǀ bhrā́taraḥ ǀ ártham ǀ etám ǀ rathī́-iva ǀ ádhvānam ǀ ánu ǀ ā́ ǀ avarīvuríti ǀtásmāt ǀ bhiyā́ ǀ varuṇa ǀ dūrám ǀ āyam ǀ gauráḥ ǀ ná ǀ kṣepnóḥ ǀ avije ǀ jyā́yāḥ ǁ

Sukta 51.translation: “(Agni). The elder brothers of Agni performed that duty, as the driver of a chariot covers the roaḍ(They were slain), and therefore,Varuṇa, I fled afar through fear. I trembled as a wild ox (tembles) at thebowstring of the archer.”
Sukta 51.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒ग्नेः पूर्वे॒ भ्रात॑रो॒ अर्थ॑मे॒तं र॒थीवाध्वा॑न॒मन्वाव॑रीवुः । तस्मा॑द्भि॒या व॑रुण दू॒रमा॑यं गौ॒रो न क्षे॒प्नोर॑विजे॒ ज्याया॑:

devanagari.text: कुर्मस्त आयुरजरं यदग्ने यथा युक्तो जातवेदो न रिष्याः ।अथा वहासि सुमनस्यमानो भागं देवेभ्यो हविषः सुजात ॥

Sukta 51.translation: “(The gods). We grant you life,Agni, which (is) exempt from decay, so that thus endowed,Jātavedas,you will not die; so, becoming conciliated, well- born, Agni, bear their portion of the oblation to the gods.”
Sukta 51.sanskrit_wisdomlib: कु॒र्मस्त॒ आयु॑र॒जरं॒ यद॑ग्ने॒ यथा॑ यु॒क्तो जा॑तवेदो॒ न रिष्या॑: । अथा॑ वहासि सुमन॒स्यमा॑नो भा॒गं दे॒वेभ्यो॑ ह॒विष॑: सुजात

devanagari.text: प्रयाजान्मे अनुयाजांश्च केवलानूर्जस्वंतं हविषो दत्त भागं ।घृतं चापां पुरुषं चौषधीनामग्नेश्च दीर्घमायुरस्तु देवाः ॥

transliteration.text: pra-yājā́n ǀ me ǀ anu-yājā́n ǀ ca ǀ kévalān ǀ ū́rjasvantam ǀ havíṣaḥ ǀ datta ǀ bhāgám ǀghṛtám ǀ ca ǀ apā́m ǀ púruṣam ǀ ca ǀ óṣadhīnām ǀ agnéḥ ǀ ca ǀ dīrghám ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ astu ǀ devāḥ ǁ

Sukta 51.translation: “(Agni). Only grant to me, deities, the concentrated portion of the oblation the Prayājas and Anuyājasexclusively; (give me) the butter (the essence) of the waters, and man (the essence) of the plural nts; and let the lifeof Agni be long.”
Sukta 51.sanskrit_wisdomlib: प्र॒या॒जान्मे॑ अनुया॒जाँश्च॒ केव॑ला॒नूर्ज॑स्वन्तं ह॒विषो॑ दत्त भा॒गम् । घृ॒तं चा॒पां पुरु॑षं॒ चौष॑धीनाम॒ग्नेश्च॑ दी॒र्घमायु॑रस्तु देवाः

Sukta 51.translation: “(The gods). Yours,Agni, be the Prayājas and Anuyājas exclusively; yours be the concentrated portions of the oblations; let this sacrifice; Agni, be all yours, and let the four quarters of space bow down beforeyou.”
Sukta 51.sanskrit_wisdomlib: तव॑ प्रया॒जा अ॑नुया॒जाश्च॒ केव॑ल॒ ऊर्ज॑स्वन्तो ह॒विष॑: सन्तु भा॒गाः । तवा॑ग्ने य॒ज्ञो॒३॒॑ऽयम॑स्तु॒ सर्व॒स्तुभ्यं॑ नमन्तां प्र॒दिश॒श्चत॑स्रः

Sukta 52.translation: “instrumental uct me,Viśvedevās, since I am appointedHotā, how sitting here I ought to praise you; declareto me your portion; how you have acquired it, and by what path I may convey the oblation to you.”

Sukta 52.translation: “Best entitled to the sacrifice, I have sat down as theHotā; all the divineMarutsurge me( to bear theoblation); the office of theAdhvaryuis to be discharged daily,Aśvins, by you; let the moon be thebrahman, andlet it be also your oblation.”

Sukta 52.translation: “Who is this, who is theHotā? (Afraid) ofYama, what offering does he bear that the gods accept?Agniis born day by day, and month by month, and so the gods have made for themselves a bearer of oblationṣ”
Sukta 52.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒यं यो होता॒ किरु॒ स य॒मस्य॒ कमप्यू॑हे॒ यत्स॑म॒ञ्जन्ति॑ दे॒वाः । अह॑रहर्जायते मा॒सिमा॒स्यथा॑ दे॒वा द॑धिरे हव्य॒वाह॑म्

Sukta 52.translation: “The gods have made me the bearer of oblations returning after departure, and passing many difficultplaces; (saying) thisAgniis wise; he will accomplish the sacrifice for us, whether it be that of the five ways, thethree kinds, or the seven threads.”

Sukta 52.translation: “Gods, I solicit of you immortality and excellentmaleoffspring, that I may offer you adoration. I causeIndra to take the thunderbolt in hishands, wherewith he may overcome all these hostile hosts.”
Sukta 52.sanskrit_wisdomlib: आ वो॑ यक्ष्यमृत॒त्वं सु॒वीरं॒ यथा॑ वो देवा॒ वरि॑व॒: करा॑णि । आ बा॒ह्वोर्वज्र॒मिन्द्र॑स्य धेया॒मथे॒मा विश्वा॒: पृत॑ना जयाति

Sukta 52.translation: “Three thousand three hundred and thirty-and-nine deities worshippedAgni, they sprinkled (me) withbutter, they strewed the sacred grass, and then made the invoker of the gods sit down.”

Sukta 53.translation: “(The gods). He whom we sought with (anxious) minds has arrived; he who understands the sacrificeand is acquainted with its different parts; may he who is most skilled in worship, sacrifice for us at the worship ofthe gods, being seated (at the altar), taking plural ce among (the priests), and preceding us.”

Sukta 53.translation: “Thehotā, most skilled in worship, has been sanctified by his seat (at the altar); he contemplates thesacred offerings reverently plural ced (before him); let us speedily worship with ghī the gods to whom worship isdue; let us praise those who are entitled to praise.”

Sukta 53.translation: “He has today made our banquet to the gods efficacious; we have obtained the mysterious tongue ofsacrifice; he has come, fragrant, clothed with life; he makes our oblation to the gods today auspicious.”

Sukta 61.translation: “The fierce-voiced (Nābhānediṣṭha repeated) through his intelligence this praise ofRudra, in themidst of the ceremony at the assembly (of theAṅgirasas), which (praise) his parents, making (the partition) andhis brothers engaged in giving (the shares accomplished); he perfected the seven priests (therewith) on the dayon which the rite was to be matured.”

Sukta 61.translation: “He (Rudra) bestowing on his worshippers the gift (of wealth) and the defeat (of their foes),castingdown (therākṣasas) with his weapons, has constructed the altar; rapid in movement, most fierce in speech,and shedding the procreative fluid like water around.”

Sukta 61.translation: “(I call you to these) oblations, to which hastening, (Aśvins), swift as thought at the invitation of theworshipper, you rejoice my (worshipper) who, affluent in the wealth of sacrifice, mixes (the oblation) with hisfingers in your presence, (holding) in hishandthe sacrifice intended (for you).”

Sukta 61.translation: “TheAṅgirasas, who were engaged in the nine months;' ceremonial, reciting the praise suited to therite, quickly attained the friendship of the maiden; those who seated in the two seats (heaven and earth) came totheir protector, as they had no donation, milked forth the inexhaustible (waters).”
Sukta 61.sanskrit_wisdomlib: म॒क्षू क॒नाया॑: स॒ख्यं नव॑ग्वा ऋ॒तं वद॑न्त ऋ॒तयु॑क्तिमग्मन् । द्वि॒बर्ह॑सो॒ य उप॑ गो॒पमागु॑रदक्षि॒णासो॒ अच्यु॑ता दुदुक्षन्

Sukta 61.translation: “Quickly (obtaining) the friendship of the maiden, they poured forth water like new wealth, when theyoffered to you (Indra) the pure riches, the milk of the cow, that yields ambrosia.”
Sukta 61.sanskrit_wisdomlib: म॒क्षू क॒नाया॑: स॒ख्यं नवी॑यो॒ राधो॒ न रेत॑ ऋ॒तमित्तु॑रण्यन् । शुचि॒ यत्ते॒ रेक्ण॒ आय॑जन्त सब॒र्दुघा॑या॒: पय॑ उ॒स्रिया॑याः

devanagari.text: पश्वा यत्पश्चा वियुता बुधंतेति ब्रवीति वक्तरी रराणः ।वसोर्वसुत्वा कारवोऽनेहा विश्वं विवेष्टि द्रविणमुप क्षु ॥

Sukta 61.translation: “"When (the worshippers) find (the stalls deserted) by the cattle" (then the performer of the rite)exclaims, "(Indra), plural asing to his adorer, the affluent lord of affluence, the compassionate, the sinless, quicklyrecovers all the wealth (that has been carried off)."”
Sukta 61.sanskrit_wisdomlib: प॒श्वा यत्प॒श्चा वियु॑ता बु॒धन्तेति॑ ब्रवीति व॒क्तरी॒ ररा॑णः । वसो॑र्वसु॒त्वा का॒रवो॑ऽने॒हा विश्वं॑ विवेष्टि॒ द्रवि॑ण॒मुप॒ क्षु

devanagari.text: तदिन्न्वस्य परिषद्वानो अग्मन्पुरू सदंतो नार्षदं बिभित्सन् ।वि शुष्णस्य संग्रथितमनर्वा विदत्पुरुप्रजातस्य गुहा यत् ॥

Sukta 61.translation: “Then the attendant (rays of light) quickly gathered round him, and (theasuras) dwelling in manyregions sought to destroy the son ofNṛṣad, but the irresistible (Indra) found the well-knit mail ofŚuṣṇa, whoseoffspring was numerous, which was hidden in the cave.”
Sukta 61.sanskrit_wisdomlib: तदिन्न्व॑स्य परि॒षद्वा॑नो अग्मन्पु॒रू सद॑न्तो नार्ष॒दं बि॑भित्सन् । वि शुष्ण॑स्य॒ संग्र॑थितमन॒र्वा वि॒दत्पु॑रुप्रजा॒तस्य॒ गुहा॒ यत्

devanagari.text: भर्गो ह नामोत यस्य देवाः स्वर्ण ये त्रिषधस्थे निषेदुः ।अग्निर्ह नामोत जातवेदाः श्रुधी नो होतर्ऋतस्य होताध्रुक् ॥

Sukta 61.translation: “WhetherBhargais the name of that radiance, on the triple seat of which those who are gods areseated, as if in heaven, or whether it beAgni, orJātavedas; invoker (of the gods), who are the ministrant priestof the sacrifice, hear our guileless invocation.”
Sukta 61.sanskrit_wisdomlib: भर्गो॑ ह॒ नामो॒त यस्य॑ दे॒वाः स्व१॒॑र्ण ये त्रि॑षध॒स्थे नि॑षे॒दुः । अ॒ग्निर्ह॒ नामो॒त जा॒तवे॑दाः श्रु॒धी नो॑ होतॠ॒तस्य॒ होता॒ध्रुक्

devanagari.text: उत त्या मे रौद्रावर्चिमंता नासत्याविंद्र गूर्तये यजध्यै ।मनुष्वद्वृक्तबर्हिषे रराणा मंदू हितप्रयसा विक्षु यज्यू ॥

Sukta 61.translation: “And,Indra, let those two brilliant sons ofRudra, theNāsatyās, (be present) at my praise andsacrifice; being propitious to (me seated) on the strewn grass, as (at the sacrifice of)Manu, cheerful, liberal ofwealth to the people, deserving of adoration.”
Sukta 61.sanskrit_wisdomlib: उ॒त त्या मे॒ रौद्रा॑वर्चि॒मन्ता॒ नास॑त्याविन्द्र गू॒र्तये॒ यज॑ध्यै । म॒नु॒ष्वद्वृ॒क्तब॑र्हिषे॒ ररा॑णा म॒न्दू हि॒तप्र॑यसा वि॒क्षु यज्यू॑

Sukta 61.translation: “This royal (Soma), this glorified creator, is praised (by all), and, like a sage, constituting his owncause-way, he traverses the firmament; he madeKakṣīvattremble, he (made)Agni(shake) as horses (agitate)the light- whirling, revolving-wheel (of a chariot).”
Sukta 61.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒यं स्तु॒तो राजा॑ वन्दि वे॒धा अ॒पश्च॒ विप्र॑स्तरति॒ स्वसे॑तुः । स क॒क्षीव॑न्तं रेजय॒त्सो अ॒ग्निं ने॒मिं न च॒क्रमर्व॑तो रघु॒द्रु

Sukta 61.translation: “The kinsman of the two (worlds,Agni), the conveyer (of all), the sacrificer, (made) theambrosia-yielding cow, which had not given birth, to yield milk (forŚayu), when he praisesMitra,VaruṇaandAryaman, with most excellent and choice hymns.”
Sukta 61.sanskrit_wisdomlib: स द्वि॒बन्धु॑र्वैतर॒णो यष्टा॑ सब॒र्धुं धे॒नुम॒स्वं॑ दु॒हध्यै॑ । सं यन्मि॒त्रावरु॑णा वृ॒ञ्ज उ॒क्थैर्ज्येष्ठे॑भिरर्य॒मणं॒ वरू॑थैः

transliteration.text: tát-bandhuḥ ǀ sūríḥ ǀ diví ǀ te ǀ dhiyam-dhā́ḥ ǀ nā́bhānédiṣṭhaḥ ǀ rapati ǀ prá ǀ vénan ǀsā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ nā́bhiḥ ǀ paramā́ ǀ asyá ǀ vā ǀ gha ǀ ahám ǀ tát ǀ paścā́ ǀ katitháḥ ǀ cit ǀ āsa ǁ

Sukta 61.translation: “The kinsman of the earth, the utterer of praise (belonging) to you (who abides) in heaven,Nābhānediṣṭha, the supporter of the rite, desiring (the recompense), repeats (this praise); the (heaven) ourmost excellent bound (is the site) of the (sun), and I was after many (degrees) descended from hiṃ”
Sukta 61.sanskrit_wisdomlib: तद्ब॑न्धुः सू॒रिर्दि॒वि ते॑ धियं॒धा नाभा॒नेदि॑ष्ठो रपति॒ प्र वेन॑न् । सा नो॒ नाभि॑: पर॒मास्य वा॑ घा॒हं तत्प॒श्चा क॑ति॒थश्चि॑दास

transliteration.text: iyám ǀ me ǀ nā́bhiḥ ǀ ihá ǀ me ǀ sadhá-stham ǀ imé ǀ me ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ ayám ǀ asmi ǀ sárvaḥ ǀdvi-jā́ḥ ǀ áha ǀ prathama-jā́ḥ ǀ ṛtásya ǀ idám ǀ dhenúḥ ǀ aduhat ǀ jā́yamānā ǁ

Sukta 61.translation: “This (aerial voice) is my bond of affinity; here, (in the solar orb) is my abiding-plural ce; these are myresplendent (rays); I am this all; I am the twice-born; the first-born of truth; the cow, as soon as born, milked forthidentical withĀditya; sā yā vāg asau saādityaḥ, that which is vāk is that Ādityaḥ:ŚatapathaBrāhmaṇa10.5.1.4]. the forests, terminates (in the fire of sacrifice), who upward rising, like a line, adorable, quickly subdues (hisfoes). him, unchangeable, the augmenter of happiness, his mother has brought forth.”

Sukta 61.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अधा॑सु म॒न्द्रो अ॑र॒तिर्वि॒भावाव॑ स्यति द्विवर्त॒निर्व॑ने॒षाट् । ऊ॒र्ध्वा यच्छ्रेणि॒र्न शिशु॒र्दन्म॒क्षू स्थि॒रं शे॑वृ॒धं सू॑त मा॒ता

devanagari.text: अधा गाव उपमातिं कनाया अनु श्वांतस्य कस्य चित्परेयुः ।श्रुधि त्वं सुद्रविणो नस्त्वं याळाश्वघ्नस्य वावृधे सूनृताभिः ॥
अध । गावः । उपऽमातिम् । कनायाः । अनु । श्वान्तस्य । कस्य । चित् । परा । ईयुः ।श्रुधि । त्वम् । सुऽद्रविणः । नः । त्वम् । याट् । आश्वऽघ्नस्य । ववृधे । सूनृताभिः ॥

transliteration.text: ádha ǀ gā́vaḥ ǀ úpa-mātim ǀ kanā́yāḥ ǀ ánu ǀ śvāntásya ǀ kásya ǀ cit ǀ párā ǀ īyuḥ ǀśrudhí ǀ tvám ǀ su-draviṇaḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ tvám ǀ yāṭ ǀ āśva-ghnásya ǀ vavṛdhe ǀ sūnṛ́tābhiḥ ǁ

Sukta 61.translation: “The words of the desirable (praise), of a certain tranquil person n (Nābhānediṣṭha), attain theprototype (Indra). Do you, who are the giver of wealth (Agni), hear us; offer sacrifice, you are magnified by thesincere eulogies ofAśvaghna.”
Sukta 61.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अधा॒ गाव॒ उप॑मातिं क॒नाया॒ अनु॑ श्वा॒न्तस्य॒ कस्य॑ चि॒त्परे॑युः । श्रु॒धि त्वं सु॑द्रविणो न॒स्त्वं या॑ळाश्व॒घ्नस्य॑ वावृधे सू॒नृता॑भिः

devanagari.text: अध त्वमिंद्र विद्ध्यस्मान्महो राये नृपते वज्रबाहुः ।रक्षा च नो मघोनः पाहि सूरीननेहसस्ते हरिवो अभिष्टौ ॥
अध । त्वम् । इन्द्र । विद्धि । अस्मान् । महः । राये । नृऽपते । वज्रऽबाहुः ।रक्ष । च । नः । मघोनः । पाहि । सूरीन् । अनेहसः । ते । हरिऽवः । अभिष्टौ ॥

transliteration.text: ádha ǀ tvám ǀ indra ǀ viddhí ǀ asmā́n ǀ maháḥ ǀ rāyé ǀ nṛ-pate ǀ vájra-bāhuḥ ǀrákṣa ǀ ca ǀ naḥ ǀ maghónaḥ ǀ pāhí ǀ sūrī́n ǀ anehásaḥ ǀ te ǀ hari-vaḥ ǀ abhíṣṭau ǁ

Sukta 61.translation: “Do you,Indra, king of men, who are the bearer of the thunderbolt, regard us now to (give us) greatriches, and protect us who are affluent in (oblations), who utter (your) praise; may we, lord of bay steeds, (be)free from blame on your approach.”
Sukta 61.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अध॒ त्वमि॑न्द्र वि॒द्ध्य१॒॑स्मान्म॒हो रा॒ये नृ॑पते॒ वज्र॑बाहुः । रक्षा॑ च नो म॒घोन॑: पा॒हि सू॒रीन॑ने॒हस॑स्ते हरिवो अ॒भिष्टौ॑

devanagari.text: अध यद्राजाना गविष्टौ सरत्सरण्युः कारवे जरण्युः ।विप्रः प्रेष्ठः स ह्येषां बभूव परा च वक्षदुत पर्षदेनान् ॥
अध । यत् । राजाना । गोऽइष्टौ । सरत् । सरण्युः । कारवे । जरण्युः ।विप्रः । प्रेष्ठः । सः । हि । एषाम् । बभूव । परा । च । वक्षत् । उत । पर्षत् । एनान् ॥

transliteration.text: ádha ǀ yát ǀ rājānā ǀ gó-iṣṭau ǀ sárat ǀ saraṇyúḥ ǀ kāráve ǀ jaraṇyúḥ ǀvípraḥ ǀ préṣṭhaḥ ǀ sáḥ ǀ hí ǀ eṣām ǀ babhū́va ǀ párā ǀ ca ǀ vákṣat ǀ utá ǀ parṣat ǀ enān ǁ

Sukta 61.translation: “Since, royal (MitraandVaruṇa), the impetuous (Yama) now approaches in expectation of (the gift of)cattle, and desiring praise for the sacrificing (band of theAṅgirasas); the sage (Nābhānediṣṭha) has beenheld most dear by them; may he accomplish (what has to be effected), and make them successful.”
Sukta 61.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अध॒ यद्रा॑जाना॒ गवि॑ष्टौ॒ सर॑त्सर॒ण्युः का॒रवे॑ जर॒ण्युः । विप्र॒: प्रेष्ठ॒: स ह्ये॑षां ब॒भूव॒ परा॑ च॒ वक्ष॑दु॒त प॑र्षदेनान्

devanagari.text: अधा न्वस्य जेन्यस्य पुष्टौ वृथा रेभंत ईमहे तदू नु ।सरण्युरस्य सूनुरश्वो विप्रश्चासि श्रवसश्च सातौ ॥
अध । नु । अस्य । जेन्यस्य । पुष्टौ । वृथा । रेभन्तः । ईमहे । तत् । ऊं इति । नु ।सरण्युः । अस्य । सूनुः । अश्वः । विप्रः । च । असि । श्रवसः । च । सातौ ॥

transliteration.text: ádha ǀ nú ǀ asya ǀ jényasya ǀ puṣṭáu ǀ vṛ́thā ǀ rébhantaḥ ǀ īmahe ǀ tát ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ nú ǀsaraṇyúḥ ǀ asya ǀ sūnúḥ ǀ áśvaḥ ǀ vípraḥ ǀ ca ǀ asi ǀ śrávasaḥ ǀ ca ǀ sātáu ǁ

Sukta 61.translation: “And for the contentment of this victorious (Varuṇa), praising (him) without an effort, we solicit this (ofhim), (that) his progeny, a swift horse, (may be ours), and you, (Varuṇa), are wise, and (are occupied) inprocuring us food.”
Sukta 61.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अधा॒ न्व॑स्य॒ जेन्य॑स्य पु॒ष्टौ वृथा॒ रेभ॑न्त ईमहे॒ तदू॒ नु । स॒र॒ण्युर॑स्य सू॒नुरश्वो॒ विप्र॑श्चासि॒ श्रव॑सश्च सा॒तौ

devanagari.text: युवोर्यदि सख्यायास्मे शर्धाय स्तोमं जुजुषे नमस्वान् ।विश्वत्र यस्मिन्ना गिरः समीचीः पूर्वीव गातुर्दाशत्सूनृतायै ॥

transliteration.text: yuvóḥ ǀ yádi ǀ sakhyā́ya ǀ asmé íti ǀ śárdhāya ǀ stómam ǀ jujuṣé ǀ námasvān ǀviśvátra ǀ yásmin ǀ ā́ ǀ gíraḥ ǀ sam-īcī́ḥ ǀ pūrvī́-iva ǀ gātúḥ ǀ dā́śat ǀ sūnṛ́tāyai ǁ

Sukta 61.translation: “If the priest offers homage to you two (MitraandVaruṇa) for the sake of your friendship and ourinvigoration, on (the formation of) which (friendship) the praises (of theAṅgirasasgo) everywhere in a commondirection; may he give (plural asure) to the utterer of praise like an ancient road.”
Sukta 61.sanskrit_wisdomlib: यु॒वोर्यदि॑ स॒ख्याया॒स्मे शर्धा॑य॒ स्तोमं॑ जुजु॒षे नम॑स्वान् । वि॒श्वत्र॒ यस्मि॒न्ना गिर॑: समी॒चीः पू॒र्वीव॑ गा॒तुर्दाश॑त्सू॒नृता॑यै

devanagari.text: स गृणानो अद्भिर्देववानिति सुबंधुर्नमसा सूक्तैः ।वर्धदुक्थैर्वचोभिरा हि नूनं व्यध्वैति पयस उस्रियायाः ॥

transliteration.text: sáḥ ǀ gṛṇānáḥ ǀ at-bhíḥ ǀ devá-vān ǀ íti ǀ su-bándhuḥ ǀ námasā ǀ su-uktáiḥ ǀvárdhat ǀ uktháiḥ ǀ vácaḥ-bhiḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ hí ǀ nūnám ǀ ví ǀ ádhvā ǀ eti ǀ páyasaḥ ǀ usríyāyāḥ ǁ

Sukta 61.translation: “Being praised with reverence and hymns thus, "the god-accompanied (Varuṇa) of good lineage,together with the waters"; may he be magnified; (attracted) by hymns and prayers (may he) now (approach); thepath of the milk of the cow is open (for his worship).”
Sukta 61.sanskrit_wisdomlib: स गृ॑णा॒नो अ॒द्भिर्दे॒ववा॒निति॑ सु॒बन्धु॒र्नम॑सा सू॒क्तैः । वर्ध॑दु॒क्थैर्वचो॑भि॒रा हि नू॒नं व्यध्वै॑ति॒ पय॑स उ॒स्रिया॑याः

devanagari.text: त ऊ षु णो महो यजत्रा भूत देवास ऊतये सजोषाः ।ये वाजाँ अनयता वियंतो ये स्था निचेतारो अमूराः ॥

transliteration.text: té ǀ ūṃ íti ǀ sú ǀ naḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ yajatrāḥ ǀ bhūtá ǀ devāsaḥ ǀ ūtáye ǀ sa-jóṣāḥ ǀyé ǀ vā́jān ǀ ánayata ǀ vi-yántaḥ ǀ yé ǀ sthá ǀ ni-cetā́raḥ ǀ ámūrāḥ ǁ

Sukta 61.translation: “Adorable divinities, be consentient for our great preservation, both you who, going in variousdirections, are the bringers of food, and you who, being no longer perplexed, are the discoverers (of the cattle).”
Sukta 61.sanskrit_wisdomlib: त ऊ॒ षु णो॑ म॒हो य॑जत्रा भू॒त दे॑वास ऊ॒तये॑ स॒जोषा॑: । ये वाजाँ॒ अन॑यता वि॒यन्तो॒ ये स्था नि॑चे॒तारो॒ अमू॑राः

devanagari.text: ये यज्ञेन दक्षिणया समक्ता इंद्रस्य सख्यममृतत्वमानश ।तेभ्यो भद्रमंगिरसो वो अस्तु प्रति गृभ्णीत मानवं सुमेधसः ॥

transliteration.text: yé ǀ yajñéna ǀ dákṣiṇayā ǀ sám-aktāḥ ǀ índrasya ǀ sakhyám ǀ amṛta-tvám ǀ ānaśá ǀtébhyaḥ ǀ bhadrám ǀ aṅgirasaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ astu ǀ práti ǀ gṛbhṇīta ǀ mānavám ǀ su-medhasaḥ ǁ

Sukta 62.translation: “You, who associated with sacrifice and pious donations, have acquired the friendship ofIndraandimmortality; upon you,Aṅgirasas, may good fortune attend; welcome, sages, the son ofManu.”
Sukta 62.sanskrit_wisdomlib: ये य॒ज्ञेन॒ दक्षि॑णया॒ सम॑क्ता॒ इन्द्र॑स्य स॒ख्यम॑मृत॒त्वमा॑न॒श । तेभ्यो॑ भ॒द्रम॑ङ्गिरसो वो अस्तु॒ प्रति॑ गृभ्णीत मान॒वं सु॑मेधसः

devanagari.text: य उदाजन्पितरो गोमयं वस्वृतेनाभिंदन्परिवत्सरे वलं ।दीर्घायुत्वमंगिरसो वो अस्तु प्रति गृभ्णीत मानवं सुमेधसः ॥

transliteration.text: yé ǀ ut-ā́jan ǀ pitáraḥ ǀ go-máyam ǀ vásu ǀ ṛténa ǀ ábhindan ǀ parivatsaré ǀ valám ǀdīrghāyu-tvám ǀ aṅgirasaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ astu ǀ práti ǀ gṛbhṇīta ǀ mānavám ǀ su-medhasaḥ ǁ

Sukta 62.translation: “May length of life be yours,Aṅgirasas, our progenitors, who drove forth the wealth of cattle, and bymeans of your sacrifice when the year was ended, demolished (theasura)Bala; welcome, sages, the son ofManu.”
Sukta 62.sanskrit_wisdomlib: य उ॒दाज॑न्पि॒तरो॑ गो॒मयं॒ वस्वृ॒तेनाभि॑न्दन्परिवत्स॒रे व॒लम् । दी॒र्घा॒यु॒त्वम॑ङ्गिरसो वो अस्तु॒ प्रति॑ गृभ्णीत मान॒वं सु॑मेधसः

devanagari.text: य ऋतेन सूर्यमारोहयंदिव्यप्रथयन्पृथिवीं मातरं वि ।सुप्रजास्त्वमंगिरसो वो अस्तु प्रति गृभ्णीत मानवं सुमेधसः ॥

transliteration.text: yé ǀ ṛténa ǀ sū́ryam ǀ ā́ ǀ árohayan ǀ diví ǀ áprathayan ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ mātáram ǀ ví ǀsuprajāḥ-tvám ǀ aṅgirasaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ astu ǀ práti ǀ gṛbhṇīta ǀ mānavám ǀ su-medhasaḥ ǁ

Sukta 62.translation: “May the possession of posterity be yours,Aṅgirasas, who elevated by the (power) of sacrifice theSun in heaven, and made the maternal earth renowned; welcome, sages, the son ofManu.”
Sukta 62.sanskrit_wisdomlib: य ऋ॒तेन॒ सूर्य॒मारो॑हयन्दि॒व्यप्र॑थयन्पृथि॒वीं मा॒तरं॒ वि । सु॒प्र॒जा॒स्त्वम॑ङ्गिरसो वो अस्तु॒ प्रति॑ गृभ्णीत मान॒वं सु॑मेधसः

devanagari.text: अयं नाभा वदति वल्गु वो गृहे देवपुत्रा ऋषयस्तच्छृणोतन ।सुब्रह्मण्यमंगिरसो वो अस्तु प्रति गृभ्णीत मानवं सुमेधसः ॥
अयम् । नाभा । वदति । वल्गु । वः । गृहे । देवऽपुत्राः । ऋषयः । तत् । शृणोतन ।सुऽब्रह्मण्यम् । अङ्गिरसः । वः । अस्तु । प्रति । गृभ्णीत । मानवम् । सुऽमेधसः ॥

transliteration.text: ayám ǀ nā́bhā ǀ vadati ǀ valgú ǀ vaḥ ǀ gṛhé ǀ déva-putrāḥ ǀ ṛṣayaḥ ǀ tát ǀ śṛṇotana ǀsu-brahmaṇyám ǀ aṅgirasaḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ astu ǀ práti ǀ gṛbhṇīta ǀ mānavám ǀ su-medhasaḥ ǁ

Sukta 62.translation: “Ṛṣis, sons of the gods, this (Nābhānediṣṭha) addresses to you in the house of (sacrifice) hisbenediction, hear it; may divine splendour,Aṅgirasas, be yours; welcome, sages, the son ofManu.”
Sukta 62.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒यं नाभा॑ वदति व॒ल्गु वो॑ गृ॒हे देव॑पुत्रा ऋषय॒स्तच्छृ॑णोतन । सु॒ब्र॒ह्म॒ण्यम॑ङ्गिरसो वो अस्तु॒ प्रति॑ गृभ्णीत मान॒वं सु॑मेधसः

devanagari.text: विरूपास इदृषयस्त इद्गंभीरवेपसः ।ते अंगिरसः सूनवस्ते अग्नेः परि जज्ञिरे ॥
विऽरूपासः । इत् । ऋषयः । ते । इत् । गम्भीरऽवेपसः ।ते । अङ्गिरसः । सूनवः । ते । अग्नेः । परि । जज्ञिरे ॥

transliteration.text: ví-rūpāsaḥ ǀ ít ǀ ṛ́ṣayaḥ ǀ té ǀ ít ǀ gambhīrá-vepasaḥ ǀté ǀ áṅgirasaḥ ǀ sūnávaḥ ǀ té ǀ agnéḥ ǀ pári ǀ jajñire ǁ

Sukta 62.translation: “These Ṛṣis, however different in form, were verily of profound piety; they are theAṅgirasaswhohave been born as the sons ofAgni.”
Sukta 62.sanskrit_wisdomlib: विरू॑पास॒ इदृष॑य॒स्त इद्ग॑म्भी॒रवे॑पसः । ते अङ्गि॑रसः सू॒नव॒स्ते अ॒ग्नेः परि॑ जज्ञिरे

devanagari.text: ये अग्नेः परि जज्ञिरे विरूपासो दिवस्परि ।नवग्वो नु दशग्वो अंगिरस्तमो सचा देवेषु मंहते ॥
ये । अग्नेः । परि । जज्ञिरे । विऽरूपासः । दिवः । परि ।नवऽग्वः । नु । दशऽग्वः । अङ्गिरःऽतमः । सचा । देवेषु । मंहते ॥

transliteration.text: yé ǀ agnéḥ ǀ pári ǀ jajñiré ǀ ví-rūpāsaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ pári ǀnáva-gvaḥ ǀ nú ǀ dáśa-gvaḥ ǀ áṅgiraḥ-tamaḥ ǀ sácā ǀ devéṣu ǀ maṃhate ǁ

Sukta 62.translation: “Among those who have sprung fromAgniin many forms, (and spring) from heaven, the chiefAṅgirasa, the celebrator of the nine-month rite, the celebrator of the ten-month rite, accompanied by the godsbestows (upon me wealth).”
Sukta 62.sanskrit_wisdomlib: ये अ॒ग्नेः परि॑ जज्ञि॒रे विरू॑पासो दि॒वस्परि॑ । नव॑ग्वो॒ नु दश॑ग्वो॒ अङ्गि॑रस्तमो॒ सचा॑ दे॒वेषु॑ मंहते

devanagari.text: इंद्रेण युजा निः सृजंत वाघतो व्रजं गोमंतमश्विनं ।सहस्रं मे ददतो अष्टकर्ण्यः श्रवो देवेष्वक्रत ॥

transliteration.text: índreṇa ǀ yujā́ ǀ níḥ ǀ sṛjanta ǀ vāghátaḥ ǀ vrajám ǀ gó-mantam ǀ aśvínam ǀsahásram ǀ me ǀ dádataḥ ǀ aṣṭa-karṇyáḥ ǀ śrávaḥ ǀ devéṣu ǀ akrata ǁ

Sukta 62.translation: “The acceptors of oblations, withIndrafor their associate, have emptied pastures crowded with cows,and horses, giving me a thousand full-grown (cattle), they have gained renown among the gods.”
Sukta 62.sanskrit_wisdomlib: इन्द्रे॑ण यु॒जा निः सृ॑जन्त वा॒घतो॑ व्र॒जं गोम॑न्तम॒श्विन॑म् । स॒हस्रं॑ मे॒ दद॑तो अष्टक॒र्ण्य१॒॑: श्रवो॑ दे॒वेष्व॑क्रत

devanagari.text: प्र नूनं जायतामयं मनुस्तोक्मेव रोहतु ।यः सहस्रं शताश्वं सद्यो दानाय मंहते ॥

Sukta 62.translation: “May thisManu(Sāvarṇi) quickly be born, may he increase like (well- watered) seed, who sends meat once a thousand and a hundred horses for a present.”
Sukta 62.sanskrit_wisdomlib: प्र नू॒नं जा॑यताम॒यं मनु॒स्तोक्मे॑व रोहतु । यः स॒हस्रं॑ श॒ताश्वं॑ स॒द्यो दा॒नाय॒ मंह॑ते

devanagari.text: न तमश्नोति कश्चन दिव इव सान्वारभं ।सावर्ण्यस्य दक्षिणा वि सिंधुरिव पप्रथे ॥
न । तम् । अश्नोति । कः । चन । दिवःऽइव । सानु । आऽरभम् ।सावर्ण्यस्य । दक्षिणा । वि । सिन्धुःऽइव । पप्रथे ॥

Sukta 62.translation: “No one succeeds in reaching him; (elevated) like the summit of heaven, the liberality ofSāvarṇihasbroadened out like a river.”
Sukta 62.sanskrit_wisdomlib: न तम॑श्नोति॒ कश्च॒न दि॒व इ॑व॒ सान्वा॒रभ॑म् । सा॒व॒र्ण्यस्य॒ दक्षि॑णा॒ वि सिन्धु॑रिव पप्रथे

devanagari.text: उत दासा परिविषे स्मद्दिष्टी गोपरीणसा ।यदुस्तुर्वश्च मामहे ॥

transliteration.text: utá ǀ dāsā́ ǀ pari-víṣe ǀ smáddiṣṭī íti smát-diṣṭī ǀ gó-parīṇasā ǀyáduḥ ǀ turváḥ ǀ ca ǀ mamahe ǁ

Sukta 62.translation: “YaduandIndraspeaking auspiciously, and possessed of numerous cattle, gave them like (appointed)servants, for the enjoyment (ofManuSāvarṇi).”
Sukta 62.sanskrit_wisdomlib: उ॒त दा॒सा प॑रि॒विषे॒ स्मद्दि॑ष्टी॒ गोप॑रीणसा । यदु॑स्तु॒र्वश्च॑ मामहे

devanagari.text: सहस्रदा ग्रामणीर्मा रिषन्मनुः सूर्येणास्य यतमानैतु दक्षिणा ।सावर्णेर्देवाः प्र तिरंत्वायुर्यस्मिन्नश्रांता असनाम वाजं ॥
सहस्रऽदाः । ग्रामऽनीः । मा । रिषत् । मनुः । सूर्येण । अस्य । यतमाना । एतु । दक्षिणा ।सावर्णेः । देवाः । प्र । तिरन्तु । आयुः । यस्मिन् । अश्रान्ताः । असनाम । वाजम् ॥

transliteration.text: sahasra-dā́ḥ ǀ grāma-nī́ḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ riṣat ǀ mánuḥ ǀ sū́ryeṇa ǀ asya ǀ yátamānā ǀ etu ǀ dákṣiṇā ǀsā́varṇeḥ ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ prá ǀ tirantu ǀ ā́yuḥ ǀ yásmin ǀ áśrāntāḥ ǀ ásanāma ǀ vā́jam ǁ

Sukta 62.translation: “May the donor of a thousand (cows), the head of the district, theManu, never suffer wrong, may hisliberality go spreading (in glory) with the sun; may the gods prolong the life ofSāvarṇi(from whom) unwearied(in his service) we enjoy abundant food.”
Sukta 62.sanskrit_wisdomlib: स॒ह॒स्र॒दा ग्रा॑म॒णीर्मा रि॑ष॒न्मनु॒: सूर्ये॑णास्य॒ यत॑मानैतु॒ दक्षि॑णा । साव॑र्णेर्दे॒वाः प्र ति॑र॒न्त्वायु॒र्यस्मि॒न्नश्रा॑न्ता॒ अस॑नाम॒ वाज॑म्

devanagari.text: परावतो ये दिधिषंत आप्यं मनुप्रीतासो जनिमा विवस्वतः ।ययातेर्ये नहुष्यस्य बर्हिषि देवा आसते ते अधि ब्रुवंतु नः ॥

Sukta 63.translation: “May the gods who, (coming) from afar proclaim their affinity (with men), and beloved by men, (support)the genitive rations of (Manu, the son of)Vivasvat; may they who are seated on the sacred grass ofYayāti, the sonofNahuṣa, speak favourably unto us.”
Sukta 63.sanskrit_wisdomlib: प॒रा॒वतो॒ ये दिधि॑षन्त॒ आप्यं॒ मनु॑प्रीतासो॒ जनि॑मा वि॒वस्व॑तः । य॒याते॒र्ये न॑हु॒ष्य॑स्य ब॒र्हिषि॑ दे॒वा आस॑ते॒ ते अधि॑ ब्रुवन्तु नः

devanagari.text: विश्वा हि वो नमस्यानि वंद्या नामानि देवा उत यज्ञियानि वः ।ये स्थ जाता अदितेरद्भ्यस्परि ये पृथिव्यास्ते म इह श्रुता हवं ॥

transliteration.text: víśvā ǀ hí ǀ vaḥ ǀ namasyā́ni ǀ vándyā ǀ nā́māni ǀ devāḥ ǀ utá ǀ yajñíyāni ǀ vaḥ ǀyé ǀ sthá ǀ jātā́ḥ ǀ áditeḥ ǀ at-bhyáḥ ǀ pári ǀ yé ǀ pṛthivyā́ḥ ǀ té ǀ me ǀ ihá ǀ śruta ǀ hávam ǁ

Sukta 63.translation: “All your appellations, gods, are to be revered and praised, and worshipped, and whether you aresprung from heaven, or from the firmament, or from earth, hear at this (solemnity) my invocation.”
Sukta 63.sanskrit_wisdomlib: विश्वा॒ हि वो॑ नम॒स्या॑नि॒ वन्द्या॒ नामा॑नि देवा उ॒त य॒ज्ञिया॑नि वः । ये स्थ जा॒ता अदि॑तेर॒द्भ्यस्परि॒ ये पृ॑थि॒व्यास्ते म॑ इ॒ह श्रु॑ता॒ हव॑म्

येभ्यः । माता । मधुऽमत् । पिन्वते । पयः । पीयूषम् । द्यौः । अदितिः । अद्रिऽबर्हाः ।उक्थऽशुष्मान् । वृषऽभरान् । सुऽअप्नसः । तान् । आदित्यान् । अनु । मद । स्वस्तये ॥

transliteration.text: yébhyaḥ ǀ mātā́ ǀ mádhu-mat ǀ pínvate ǀ páyaḥ ǀ pīyū́ṣam ǀ dyáuḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ ádri-barhāḥ ǀukthá-śuṣmān ǀ vṛṣa-bharā́n ǀ su-ápnasaḥ ǀ tā́n ǀ ādityā́n ǀ ánu ǀ mada ǀ svastáye ǁ

Sukta 63.translation: “To (these dieties) to whom the maternal (earth) yields the sweet- flavoured milk, and thecloud-invested, undepressed heaven (yields) ambrosia, to thoseĀdityaswhose strength is sacred praise, whoare bringers of rain, the doers of good actions, offer for your welfare laudation.”
Sukta 63.sanskrit_wisdomlib: येभ्यो॑ मा॒ता मधु॑म॒त्पिन्व॑ते॒ पय॑: पी॒यूषं॒ द्यौरदि॑ति॒रद्रि॑बर्हाः । उ॒क्थशु॑ष्मान्वृषभ॒रान्त्स्वप्न॑स॒स्ताँ आ॑दि॒त्याँ अनु॑ मदा स्व॒स्तये॑

devanagari.text: नृचक्षसो अनिमिषंतो अर्हणा बृहद्देवासो अमृतत्वमानशुः ।ज्योतीरथा अहिमाया अनागसो दिवो वर्ष्माणं वसते स्वस्तये ॥
नृऽचक्षसः । अनिऽमिषन्तः । अर्हणा । बृहत् । देवासः । अमृतऽत्वम् । आनशुः ।ज्योतिःऽरथाः । अहिऽमायाः । अनागसः । दिवः । वर्ष्माणम् । वसते । स्वस्तये ॥

transliteration.text: nṛ-cákṣasaḥ ǀ áni-miṣantaḥ ǀ arháṇā ǀ bṛhát ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ amṛta-tvám ǀ ānaśuḥ ǀjyotíḥ-rathāḥ ǀ áhi-māyāḥ ǀ ánāgasaḥ ǀ diváḥ ǀ varṣmā́ṇam ǀ vasate ǀ svastáye ǁ

Sukta 63.translation: “The gods, the never-slumbering beholders of mankind, and entitled (to their adoration), have obtainedgreat immortality; conveyed in chariots of light, possessed of unsurpassable wisdom, devoid of sin, they inhabitthe exalted station of heaven for the well-being (of the world).”
Sukta 63.sanskrit_wisdomlib: नृ॒चक्ष॑सो॒ अनि॑मिषन्तो अ॒र्हणा॑ बृ॒हद्दे॒वासो॑ अमृत॒त्वमा॑नशुः । ज्यो॒तीर॑था॒ अहि॑माया॒ अना॑गसो दि॒वो व॒र्ष्माणं॑ वसते स्व॒स्तये॑

devanagari.text: सम्राजो ये सुवृधो यज्ञमाययुरपरिह्वृता दधिरे दिवि क्षयं ।ताँ आ विवास नमसा सुवृक्तिभिर्महो आदित्याँ अदितिं स्वस्तये ॥
सम्ऽराजः । ये । सुऽवृधः । यज्ञम् । आऽययुः । अपरिऽह्वृताः । दधिरे । दिवि । क्षयम् ।तान् । आ । विवास । नमसा । सुवृक्तिऽभिः । महः । आदित्यान् । अदितिम् । स्वस्तये ॥

transliteration.text: sam-rā́jaḥ ǀ yé ǀ su-vṛ́dhaḥ ǀ yajñám ǀ ā-yayúḥ ǀ ápari-hvṛtāḥ ǀ dadhiré ǀ diví ǀ kṣáyam ǀtā́n ǀ ā́ ǀ vivāsa ǀ námasā ǀ suvṛktí-bhiḥ ǀ maháḥ ǀ ādityā́n ǀ áditim ǀ svastáye ǁ

Sukta 63.translation: “The gods, who, kings over all, and most exalted, have come to the sacrifice, who, unassailable, abidein heaven; them, the mightyĀdityas, (the sage) worships with reverence, and with praises, and alsoAditifor hiswell- being.”
Sukta 63.sanskrit_wisdomlib: स॒म्राजो॒ ये सु॒वृधो॑ य॒ज्ञमा॑य॒युरप॑रिह्वृता दधि॒रे दि॒वि क्षय॑म् । ताँ आ वि॑वास॒ नम॑सा सुवृ॒क्तिभि॑र्म॒हो आ॑दि॒त्याँ अदि॑तिं स्व॒स्तये॑

devanagari.text: को वः स्तोमं राधति यं जुजोषथ विश्वे देवासो मनुषो यति ष्ठन ।को वोऽध्वरं तुविजाता अरं करद्यो नः पर्षदत्यंहः स्वस्तये ॥
कः । वः । स्तोमम् । राधति । यम् । जुजोषथ । विश्वे । देवासः । मनुषः । यति । स्थन ।कः । वः । अध्वरम् । तुविऽजाताः । अरम् । करत् । यः । नः । पर्षत् । अति । अंहः । स्वस्तये ॥

transliteration.text: káḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ stómam ǀ rādhati ǀ yám ǀ jújoṣatha ǀ víśve ǀ devāsaḥ ǀ manuṣaḥ ǀ yáti ǀ sthána ǀkáḥ ǀ vaḥ ǀ adhvarám ǀ tuvi-jātāḥ ǀ áram ǀ karat ǀ yáḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ párṣat ǀ áti ǀ áṃhaḥ ǀ svastáye ǁ

Sukta 63.translation: “Who offers you the praise which you like, you wise universal deities, however many you may be?Deities from whom many are born, who can prepare for you such worship as may bear the safe beyond iniquityfor our well-being?”
Sukta 63.sanskrit_wisdomlib: को व॒: स्तोमं॑ राधति॒ यं जुजो॑षथ॒ विश्वे॑ देवासो मनुषो॒ यति॒ ष्ठन॑ । को वो॑ऽध्व॒रं तु॑विजाता॒ अरं॑ कर॒द्यो न॒: पर्ष॒दत्यंह॑: स्व॒स्तये॑

devanagari.text: येभ्यो होत्रां प्रथमामायेजे मनुः समिद्धाग्निर्मनसा सप्त होतृभिः ।त आदित्या अभयं शर्म यच्छत सुगा नः कर्त सुपथा स्वस्तये ॥

transliteration.text: yébhyaḥ ǀ hótrām ǀ prathamā́m ǀ ā-yejé ǀ mánuḥ ǀ sámiddha-agniḥ ǀ mánasā ǀ saptá ǀ hótṛ-bhiḥ ǀté ǀ ādityāḥ ǀ ábhayam ǀ śárma ǀ yacchata ǀ su-gā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ karta ǀ su-páthā ǀ svastáye ǁ

Sukta 63.translation: “Ādityas, to whom,Manu, having kindled the fire, offered the first sacrifice with (reverent) mind,(aided) by the seven ministrant priests, do you bestow upon us prosperity, free from peril; provide for us plural asantpaths easy to travel for our well-being.”
Sukta 63.sanskrit_wisdomlib: येभ्यो॒ होत्रां॑ प्रथ॒मामा॑ये॒जे मनु॒: समि॑द्धाग्नि॒र्मन॑सा स॒प्त होतृ॑भिः । त आ॑दित्या॒ अभ॑यं॒ शर्म॑ यच्छत सु॒गा न॑: कर्त सु॒पथा॑ स्व॒स्तये॑

devanagari.text: य ईशिरे भुवनस्य प्रचेतसो विश्वस्य स्थातुर्जगतश्च मंतवः ।ते नः कृतादकृतादेनसस्पर्यद्या देवासः पिपृता स्वस्तये ॥
ये । ईशिरे । भुवनस्य । प्रऽचेतसः । विश्वस्य । स्थातुः । जगतः । च । मन्तवः ।ते । नः । कृतात् । अकृतात् । एनसः । परि । अद्य । देवासः । पिपृत । स्वस्तये ॥

transliteration.text: yé ǀ ī́śire ǀ bhúvanasya ǀ prá-cetasaḥ ǀ víśvasya ǀ sthātúḥ ǀ jágataḥ ǀ ca ǀ mántavaḥ ǀté ǀ naḥ ǀ kṛtā́t ǀ ákṛtāt ǀ énasaḥ ǀ pári ǀ adyá ǀ devāsaḥ ǀ pipṛta ǀ svastáye ǁ

Sukta 63.translation: “May the wise and omniscient deities, who rule over the whole world both stationary and moveable,deliver us today from committed and uncommitted sin, for our well-being.”
Sukta 63.sanskrit_wisdomlib: य ईशि॑रे॒ भुव॑नस्य॒ प्रचे॑तसो॒ विश्व॑स्य स्था॒तुर्जग॑तश्च॒ मन्त॑वः । ते न॑: कृ॒तादकृ॑ता॒देन॑स॒स्पर्य॒द्या दे॑वासः पिपृता स्व॒स्तये॑

devanagari.text: भरेष्विंद्रं सुहवं हवामहेऽंहोमुचं सुकृतं दैव्यं जनं ।अग्निं मित्रं वरुणं सातये भगं द्यावापृथिवी मरुतः स्वस्तये ॥
भरेषु । इन्द्रम् । सुऽहवम् । हवामहे । अंहःऽमुचम् । सुऽकृतम् । दैव्यम् । जनम् ।अग्निम् । मित्रम् । वरुणम् । सातये । भगम् । द्यावापृथिवी इति । मरुतः । स्वस्तये ॥

transliteration.text: bháreṣu ǀ índram ǀ su-hávam ǀ havāmahe ǀ aṃhaḥ-múcam ǀ su-kṛ́tam ǀ dáivyam ǀ jánam ǀagním ǀ mitrám ǀ váruṇam ǀ sātáye ǀ bhágam ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ marútaḥ ǀ svastáye ǁ

Sukta 63.translation: “We call in battles upon the well-invokedIndra, the liberator from sin, and upon the virtuous folk ofheaven,Agni,Mitra,Varuṇa,Bhaga, Heaven and Earth, theMaruts, for the acquisition (of food), for well-being.”
Sukta 63.sanskrit_wisdomlib: भरे॒ष्विन्द्रं॑ सु॒हवं॑ हवामहेंऽहो॒मुचं॑ सु॒कृतं॒ दैव्यं॒ जन॑म् । अ॒ग्निं मि॒त्रं वरु॑णं सा॒तये॒ भगं॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी म॒रुत॑: स्व॒स्तये॑

devanagari.text: सुत्रामाणं पृथिवीं द्यामनेहसं सुशर्माणमदितिं सुप्रणीतिं ।दैवीं नावं स्वरित्रामनागसमस्रवंतीमा रुहेमा स्वस्तये ॥
सुऽत्रामाणम् । पृथिवीम् । द्याम् । अनेहसम् । सुऽशर्माणम् । अदितिम् । सुऽप्रनीतिम् ।दैवीम् । नावम् । सुऽअरित्राम् । अनागसम् । अस्रवन्तीम् । आ । रुहेम । स्वस्तये ॥

transliteration.text: su-trā́māṇam ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ dyā́m ǀ anehásam ǀ su-śármāṇam ǀ áditim ǀ su-pránītim ǀdáivīm ǀ nā́vam ǀ su-aritrā́m ǀ ánāgasam ǀ ásravantīm ǀ ā́ ǀ ruhema ǀ svastáye ǁ

Sukta 63.translation: “May we for our well-being ascend the well-oared, defectless, unyielding, divine vessel, thesafe-sheltering expansive heaven, exempt from evil, replete with happiness, exalted and right-directing.”
Sukta 63.sanskrit_wisdomlib: सु॒त्रामा॑णं पृथि॒वीं द्याम॑ने॒हसं॑ सु॒शर्मा॑ण॒मदि॑तिं सु॒प्रणी॑तिम् । दैवीं॒ नावं॑ स्वरि॒त्रामना॑गस॒मस्र॑वन्ती॒मा रु॑हेमा स्व॒स्तये॑

devanagari.text: विश्वे यजत्रा अधि वोचतोतये त्रायध्वं नो दुरेवाया अभिह्रुतः ।सत्यया वो देवहूत्या हुवेम शृण्वतो देवा अवसे स्वस्तये ॥

transliteration.text: víśve ǀ yajatrāḥ ǀ ádhi ǀ vocata ǀ ūtáye ǀ trā́yadhvam ǀ naḥ ǀ duḥ-évāyāḥ ǀ abhi-hrútaḥ ǀsatyáyā ǀ vaḥ ǀ devá-hūtyā ǀ huvema ǀ śṛṇvatáḥ ǀ devāḥ ǀ ávase ǀ svastáye ǁ

Sukta 63.translation: “Adorable, universal gods, advocate our cause for our protection; preserve us from malignant adversity,may we with since invocation invoke you, gods, who listen (to our praise) for our protection, for our well-being.”
Sukta 63.sanskrit_wisdomlib: विश्वे॑ यजत्रा॒ अधि॑ वोचतो॒तये॒ त्राय॑ध्वं नो दु॒रेवा॑या अभि॒ह्रुत॑: । स॒त्यया॑ वो दे॒वहू॑त्या हुवेम शृण्व॒तो दे॑वा॒ अव॑से स्व॒स्तये॑

devanagari.text: अपामीवामप विश्वामनाहुतिमपारातिं दुर्विदत्रामघायतः ।आरे देवा द्वेषो अस्मद्युयोतनोरु णः शर्म यच्छता स्वस्तये ॥

Sukta 63.translation: “(Remove far) from us disease, remove all neglect of oblations, remove illiberality, the malevolence ofthose who wish to do us harm; remove far from us, gods, those who hate us; grant us ample happiness for ourwell-being.”
Sukta 63.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अपामी॑वा॒मप॒ विश्वा॒मना॑हुति॒मपारा॑तिं दुर्वि॒दत्रा॑मघाय॒तः । आ॒रे दे॑वा॒ द्वेषो॑ अ॒स्मद्यु॑योतनो॒रु ण॒: शर्म॑ यच्छता स्व॒स्तये॑

devanagari.text: अरिष्टः स मर्तो विश्व एधते प्र प्रजाभिर्जायते धर्मणस्परि ।यमादित्यासो नयथा सुनीतिभिरति विश्वानि दुरिता स्वस्तये ॥

Sukta 63.translation: “Unharmed prospers every mortal, after performing his duties, he flourishes with posterity, whom youĀdityas guide with good counsels safe over all misfortunes to well-being.”
Sukta 63.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अरि॑ष्ट॒: स मर्तो॒ विश्व॑ एधते॒ प्र प्र॒जाभि॑र्जायते॒ धर्म॑ण॒स्परि॑ । यमा॑दित्यासो॒ नय॑था सुनी॒तिभि॒रति॒ विश्वा॑नि दुरि॒ता स्व॒स्तये॑

devanagari.text: यं देवासोऽवथ वाजसातौ यं शूरसाता मरुतो हिते धने ।प्रातर्यावाणं रथमिंद्र सानसिमरिष्यंतमा रुहेमा स्वस्तये ॥

Sukta 63.translation: “(The chariot) which, deities, you protect for the supply of food; that which,Maruts, (you protect) inbattle for the sake of the deposited spoil; may we mount,Indra, the early-moving desirable irresistible chariot forour well- being.”
Sukta 63.sanskrit_wisdomlib: यं दे॑वा॒सोऽव॑थ॒ वाज॑सातौ॒ यं शूर॑साता मरुतो हि॒ते धने॑ । प्रा॒त॒र्यावा॑णं॒ रथ॑मिन्द्र सान॒सिमरि॑ष्यन्त॒मा रु॑हेमा स्व॒स्तये॑

Sukta 63.translation: “Maruts, secure to us well-being on roads, in deserts, well-being in waters, midst the might of assailinghosts; well-being in the son-bearing wombs (of our wives); well-being for (the acquisition of) riches.”
Sukta 63.sanskrit_wisdomlib: स्व॒स्ति न॑: प॒थ्या॑सु॒ धन्व॑सु स्व॒स्त्य१॒॑प्सु वृ॒जने॒ स्व॑र्वति । स्व॒स्ति न॑: पुत्रकृ॒थेषु॒ योनि॑षु स्व॒स्ति रा॒ये म॑रुतो दधातन

devanagari.text: स्वस्तिरिद्धि प्रपथे श्रेष्ठा रेक्णस्वत्यभि या वाममेति ।सा नो अमा सो अरणे नि पातु स्वावेशा भवतु देवगोपा ॥

Sukta 63.translation: “May (pṛthivī), who secures well-being to the excellent path, who, abounding with wealth, goes to thedesirable (plural ce of sacrifice), preserve our home, may she protect us on the path we have to travel; cherished bythe gods, may she be to us a plural asant abode.”
Sukta 63.sanskrit_wisdomlib: स्व॒स्तिरिद्धि प्रप॑थे॒ श्रेष्ठा॒ रेक्ण॑स्वत्य॒भि या वा॒ममेति॑ । सा नो॑ अ॒मा सो अर॑णे॒ नि पा॑तु स्वावे॒शा भ॑वतु दे॒वगो॑पा

devanagari.text: एवा प्लतेः सूनुरवीवृधद्वो विश्व आदित्या अदिते मनीषी ।ईशानासो नरो अमर्त्येनास्तावि जनो दिव्यो गयेन ॥

Sukta 64.translation: “plural asant of aspect (is troop ofMaruts), like a house well stored with provisions; fortunate is the favourof the Maruts, the sons ofRudra; may we (thereby) be famed among men for cattle, and so, gods, ever approach(you) with sacrificial food.”

Sukta 64.translation: “Maruts,Indra, gods,VaruṇaandMitra, reward the worship, which you have given as (men fatten) the(newly-delivered) cow with milk, you have repeatedly put my praises on your car.”

Sukta 64.translation: “Maruts, repeatedly acknowledge us, so that (you may make us the objects) of this relationship; andmayAditigrant us affinity (with men) on the navel of the earth, where we first assemble (to offer oblations).”
Sukta 64.sanskrit_wisdomlib: कु॒विद॒ङ्ग प्रति॒ यथा॑ चिद॒स्य न॑: सजा॒त्य॑स्य मरुतो॒ बुबो॑धथ । नाभा॒ यत्र॑ प्रथ॒मं सं॒नसा॑महे॒ तत्र॑ जामि॒त्वमदि॑तिर्दधातु नः

devanagari.text: ते हि द्यावापृथिवी मातरा मही देवी देवांजन्मना यज्ञिये इतः ।उभे बिभृत उभयं भरीमभिः पुरू रेतांसि पितृभिश्च सिंचतः ॥

Sukta 64.translation: “They, two, the maternal heaven and earth, mighty, divine, adorable, attain to the gods upon their birth;they both cherish the two (races, human and divine) (gods), they shed abundant moisture.”
Sukta 64.sanskrit_wisdomlib: ते हि द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी मा॒तरा॑ म॒ही दे॒वी दे॒वाञ्जन्म॑ना य॒ज्ञिये॑ इ॒तः । उ॒भे बि॑भृत उ॒भयं॒ भरी॑मभिः पु॒रू रेतां॑सि पि॒तृभि॑श्च सिञ्चतः

devanagari.text: वि षा होत्रा विश्वमश्नोति वार्यं बृहस्पतिररमतिः पनीयसी ।ग्रावा यत्र मधुषुदुच्यते बृहदवीवशंत मतिभिर्मनीषिणः ॥

transliteration.text: ví ǀ sā́ ǀ hótrā ǀ víśvam ǀ aśnoti ǀ vā́ryam ǀ bṛ́haspátiḥ ǀ arámatiḥ ǀ pánīyasī ǀgrā́vā ǀ yátra ǀ madhu-sút ǀ ucyáte ǀ bṛhát ǀ ávīvaśanta ǀ matí-bhiḥ ǀ manīṣíṇaḥ ǁ

Sukta 64.translation: “That voice of invocation, the protectress of the mighty, never ceasing, the panegyrist (of the gods),the pious, by their praises, make the god desirous (of the sacrifice).”
Sukta 64.sanskrit_wisdomlib: वि षा होत्रा॒ विश्व॑मश्नोति॒ वार्यं॒ बृह॒स्पति॑र॒रम॑ति॒: पनी॑यसी । ग्रावा॒ यत्र॑ मधु॒षुदु॒च्यते॑ बृ॒हदवी॑वशन्त म॒तिभि॑र्मनी॒षिण॑:

devanagari.text: एवा कविस्तुवीरवाँ ऋतज्ञा द्रविणस्युर्द्रविणसश्चकानः ।उक्थेभिरत्र मतिभिश्च विप्रोऽपीपयद्गयो दिव्यानि जन्म ॥

Sukta 64.translation: “The pious sage,Gaya, eloquent in laudation, conversant with sacred rites, wishing for wealth, eagerfor wealth, propitiates the celestial people with prayers and praises.”
Sukta 64.sanskrit_wisdomlib: ए॒वा क॒विस्तु॑वी॒रवाँ॑ ऋत॒ज्ञा द्र॑विण॒स्युर्द्रवि॑णसश्चका॒नः । उ॒क्थेभि॒रत्र॑ म॒तिभि॑श्च॒ विप्रोऽपी॑पय॒द्गयो॑ दि॒व्यानि॒ जन्म॑

Sukta 64.translation: “Universal deities andAditi, thus has the prudent son of plural ti magnified you; the celestial people, theimmortal (company of the gods) through whom (when praised) men become the bonds (of wealth), have beenglorified byGaya.”

Sukta 65.translation: “Agni,Inda,Varuṇa,Mitra,Aryaman,Vāyu,Pūṣan,Sarasvatī, theĀdityas,Viṣṇu, theMaruts,the mighty heaven,Soma,Rudra,Aditi,Brahmaṇaspatiwith one consent.”
Sukta 65.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒ग्निरिन्द्रो॒ वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा वा॒युः पू॒षा सर॑स्वती स॒जोष॑सः । आ॒दि॒त्या विष्णु॑र्म॒रुत॒: स्व॑र्बृ॒हत्सोमो॑ रु॒द्रो अदि॑ति॒र्ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॑:

devanagari.text: इंद्राग्नी वृत्रहत्येषु सत्पती मिथो हिन्वाना तन्वा समोकसा ।अंतरिक्षं मह्या पप्रुरोजसा सोमो घृतश्रीर्महिमानमीरयन् ॥

transliteration.text: indrāgnī́ íti ǀ vṛtra-hátyeṣu ǀ sátpatī íti sát-patī ǀ mitháḥ ǀ hinvānā́ ǀ tanvā́ ǀ sám-okasā ǀantárikṣam ǀ máhi ǀ ā́ ǀ papruḥ ǀ ójasā ǀ sómaḥ ǀ ghṛta-śrī́ḥ ǀ mahimā́nam ǀ īráyan ǁ

Sukta 65.translation: “Indra, andAgni, the lords of the virtuous, standing in the same plural ce, mutually invigorating each otherwith might in theVṛtra-slaying battles, and the ghī-glorifiedSomaputting forth his greatness have filled the vastfirmament with their strength.”
Sukta 65.sanskrit_wisdomlib: इ॒न्द्रा॒ग्नी वृ॑त्र॒हत्ये॑षु॒ सत्प॑ती मि॒थो हि॑न्वा॒ना त॒न्वा॒३॒॑ समो॑कसा । अ॒न्तरि॑क्षं॒ मह्या प॑प्रु॒रोज॑सा॒ सोमो॑ घृत॒श्रीर्म॑हि॒मान॑मी॒रय॑न्

transliteration.text: téṣām ǀ hí ǀ mahnā́ ǀ mahatā́m ǀ anarváṇām ǀ stómān ǀ íyarmi ǀ ṛta-jñā́ḥ ǀ ṛta-vṛ́dhām ǀyé ǀ apsavám ǀ arṇavám ǀ citrá-rādhasaḥ ǀ té ǀ naḥ ǀ rāsantām ǀ maháye ǀ su-mitryā́ḥ ǁ

Sukta 65.translation: “Skilled in pious rites, I recite the praises of these (deities), mighty through (their own) might,unassailable, exalted by sacrifice; may those (gods) who possessed of various wealth, (rain down) the beautifulwater-cloud, acting in friendly wise, grant us (wealth) for our honour (among men).”
Sukta 65.sanskrit_wisdomlib: तेषां॒ हि म॒ह्ना म॑ह॒ताम॑न॒र्वणां॒ स्तोमाँ॒ इय॑र्म्यृत॒ज्ञा ऋ॑ता॒वृधा॑म् । ये अ॑प्स॒वम॑र्ण॒वं चि॒त्ररा॑धस॒स्ते नो॑ रासन्तां म॒हये॑ सुमि॒त्र्याः

transliteration.text: sváḥ-naram ǀ antárikṣāṇi ǀ rocanā́ ǀ dyā́vābhū́mī íti ǀ pṛthivī́m ǀ skambhuḥ ǀ ójasā ǀpṛkṣā́ḥ-iva ǀ maháyantaḥ ǀ su-rātáyaḥ ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ stavante ǀ mánuṣāya ǀ sūráyaḥ ǁ

Sukta 65.translation: “They have sustained by their strength the leader of all (the sun), the luminaries of the firmament,heaven and earth, the outstretched (firmament), honouring (their worshippers) like those who give food (to thepoor), the genitive rous gods bestowing wealth on man are glorified (at this sacrifice).”
Sukta 65.sanskrit_wisdomlib: स्व॑र्णरम॒न्तरि॑क्षाणि रोच॒ना द्यावा॒भूमी॑ पृथि॒वीं स्क॑म्भु॒रोज॑सा । पृ॒क्षा इ॑व म॒हय॑न्तः सुरा॒तयो॑ दे॒वाः स्त॑वन्ते॒ मनु॑षाय सू॒रय॑:

Sukta 65.translation: “(Descendant of)Vasiṣṭha, I have glorified the immortal gods who preside over all worlds; may theythis day bestow upon us widely-famed food; do you always cherish us with blessings.”

Sukta 66.translation: “I invoke for the success of the sacrifice the gods, who bestow abundant food, the diffusers of light, theextremely wise who flourish mightily, abounding in all riches, havingIndraas their chief, immortal, augmented bysacrifice.”
Sukta 66.sanskrit_wisdomlib: दे॒वान्हु॑वे बृ॒हच्छ्र॑वसः स्व॒स्तये॑ ज्योति॒ष्कृतो॑ अध्व॒रस्य॒ प्रचे॑तसः । ये वा॑वृ॒धुः प्र॑त॒रं वि॒श्ववे॑दस॒ इन्द्र॑ज्येष्ठासो अ॒मृता॑ ऋता॒वृध॑:

Sukta 66.translation: “We offer praise to the company of theMaruts, the attendants uponMaghavan, who, encouraged byIndra, and instrumental ucted byVaruṇa, have acquired a portion of the light of the sun; the wise worshippers beget thesacrifice.”
Sukta 66.sanskrit_wisdomlib: इन्द्र॑प्रसूता॒ वरु॑णप्रशिष्टा॒ ये सूर्य॑स्य॒ ज्योति॑षो भा॒गमा॑न॒शुः । म॒रुद्ग॑णे वृ॒जने॒ मन्म॑ धीमहि॒ माघो॑ने य॒ज्ञं ज॑नयन्त सू॒रय॑:

devanagari.text: इंद्रो वसुभिः परि पातु नो गयमादित्यैर्नो अदितिः शर्म यच्छतु ।रुद्रो रुद्रेभिर्देवो मृळयाति नस्त्वष्टा नो ग्नाभिः सुविताय जिन्वतु ॥

transliteration.text: índraḥ ǀ vásu-bhiḥ ǀ pári ǀ pātu ǀ naḥ ǀ gáyam ǀ ādityáiḥ ǀ naḥ ǀ áditiḥ ǀ śárma ǀ yacchatu ǀrudráḥ ǀ rudrébhiḥ ǀ deváḥ ǀ mṛḷayāti ǀ naḥ ǀ tváṣṭā ǀ naḥ ǀ gnā́bhiḥ ǀ suvitā́ya ǀ jinvatu ǁ

Sukta 66.translation: “MayIndrawith theVasusguard our dwelling; mayAditiwith theĀdityasgrant us felicity; may thedivineRudrawith theRudrasmake us happy;mayTvaṣṭāwith the wives of the gods be favourable to us forour prosperity.”
Sukta 66.sanskrit_wisdomlib: इन्द्रो॒ वसु॑भि॒: परि॑ पातु नो॒ गय॑मादि॒त्यैर्नो॒ अदि॑ति॒: शर्म॑ यच्छतु । रु॒द्रो रु॒द्रेभि॑र्दे॒वो मृ॑ळयाति न॒स्त्वष्टा॑ नो॒ ग्नाभि॑: सुवि॒ताय॑ जिन्वतु

devanagari.text: अदितिर्द्यावापृथिवी ऋतं महदिंद्राविष्णू मरुतः स्वर्बृहत् ।देवाँ आदित्याँ अवसे हवामहे वसून्रुद्रान्त्सवितारं सुदंससं ॥

Sukta 66.translation: “Aditi, heaven and earth, the mighty Truth (Agni),Indra,Viṣṇu, theMaruts, the great sun-- (these) weinvoke for our protection, as well as the divineĀdityas, theVasus, theRudras, andSavitā, the accomplisher ofgood works.”
Sukta 66.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अदि॑ति॒र्द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी ऋ॒तं म॒हदिन्द्रा॒विष्णू॑ म॒रुत॒: स्व॑र्बृ॒हत् । दे॒वाँ आ॑दि॒त्याँ अव॑से हवामहे॒ वसू॑न्रु॒द्रान्त्स॑वि॒तारं॑ सु॒दंस॑सम्

Sukta 66.translation: “MaySarasvatī, (endowed) with intelligences,Varuṇathe observer of oblations,Pūṣan,Viṣṇu, themightyVāyu, theAśvins, (may these) the bestowers of food upon worshippers, immortal, the possessors of allwealth, grant us a habitation triply-guarded from evil.”

devanagari.text: वृषा यज्ञो वृषणः संतु यज्ञिया वृषणो देवा वृषणो हविष्कृतः ।वृषणा द्यावापृथिवी ऋतावरी वृषा पर्जन्यो वृषणो वृषस्तुभः ॥

transliteration.text: vṛ́ṣā ǀ yajñáḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ santu ǀ yajñíyāḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ devā́ḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ haviḥ-kṛ́taḥ ǀvṛ́ṣaṇā ǀ dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ ṛtávarī ítyṛtá-varī ǀ vṛ́ṣā ǀ parjányaḥ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ vṛṣa-stúbhaḥ ǁ

Sukta 66.translation: “May our sacrifice be the showerer (of benefits); may the gods who are worthy of sacrifice be theshowerers (of benefits); may the priest, may the presenters of the oblation, be the showerers (of benefits); mayheaven and earth receiving adoration be the showerers (of benefits); mayParjanyabe the showerer (of rain);may those who praise (the gods) with showers be showerers.”

devanagari.text: अग्नीषोमा वृषणा वाजसातये पुरुप्रशस्ता वृषणा उप ब्रुवे ।यावीजिरे वृषणो देवयज्यया ता नः शर्म त्रिवरूथं वि यंसतः ॥

transliteration.text: agnī́ṣómā ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇā ǀ vā́ja-sātaye ǀ puru-praśastā́ ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇau ǀ úpa ǀ bruve ǀyáu ǀ ījiré ǀ vṛ́ṣaṇaḥ ǀ deva-yajyáyā ǀ tā́ ǀ naḥ ǀ śárma ǀ tri-várūtham ǀ ví ǀ yaṃsataḥ ǁ

Sukta 66.translation: “I glorify for the obtaining of food the two showerers (of benefits),AgniandSoma, the many-laudedshowerers (of benefits), may these two whom the priests have worshipped with divine worship bestow upon us atriply-guarded dwelling.”
Sukta 66.sanskrit_wisdomlib: अ॒ग्नीषोमा॒ वृष॑णा॒ वाज॑सातये पुरुप्रश॒स्ता वृष॑णा॒ उप॑ ब्रुवे । यावी॑जि॒रे वृष॑णो देवय॒ज्यया॒ ता न॒: शर्म॑ त्रि॒वरू॑थं॒ वि यं॑सतः

Sukta 66.translation: “The (gods) observing obligations endowed with vigour, developers of sacrifice, possessed ofabundant brightness, the defenders of sacrifices, havingAgnifor their priest, enjoying truth, unassailable, setfree the waters at the combat with theVṛtra.”
Sukta 66.sanskrit_wisdomlib: धृ॒तव्र॑ताः क्ष॒त्रिया॑ यज्ञनि॒ष्कृतो॑ बृहद्दि॒वा अ॑ध्व॒राणा॑मभि॒श्रिय॑: । अ॒ग्निहो॑तार ऋत॒सापो॑ अ॒द्रुहो॒ऽपो अ॑सृज॒न्ननु॑ वृत्र॒तूर्ये॑

devanagari.text: द्यावापृथिवी जनयन्नभि व्रताप ओषधीर्वनिनानि यज्ञिया ।अंतरिक्षं स्वरा पप्रुरूतये वशं देवासस्तन्वी नि मामृजुः ॥

transliteration.text: dyā́vāpṛthivī́ íti ǀ janayan ǀ abhí ǀ vratā́ ǀ ā́paḥ ǀ óṣadhīḥ ǀ vanínāni ǀ yajñíyā ǀantárikṣam ǀ sváḥ ǀ ā́ ǀ papruḥ ǀ ūtáye ǀ váśam ǀ devā́saḥ ǀ tanví ǀ ní ǀ mamṛjuḥ ǁ

Sukta 66.translation: “The gods engendered the heaven and earth with their respective functions, the waters, the plural nts, thesacred trees; they filled the whole firmament (with lustre) for its protection; they graced the desirable (sacrifice) intheir own person ns.”
Sukta 66.sanskrit_wisdomlib: द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी ज॑नयन्न॒भि व्र॒ताप॒ ओष॑धीर्व॒निना॑नि य॒ज्ञिया॑ । अ॒न्तरि॑क्षं॒ स्व१॒॑रा प॑प्रुरू॒तये॒ वशं॑ दे॒वास॑स्त॒न्वी॒३॒॑ नि मा॑मृजुः

devanagari.text: धर्तारो दिव ऋभवः सुहस्ता वातापर्जन्या महिषस्य तन्यतोः ।आप ओषधीः प्र तिरंतु नो गिरो भगो रातिर्वाजिनो यंतु मे हवं ॥

Sukta 66.translation: “May the upholders of the sky, the radiant with truth, the well-armed deities,VātaandParjanya, (theutterers) of the mighty thunder, the waters, the plural nts, amplify our praises; may the liberalBhagaand Vājinscome to my invocation.”

Sukta 67.translation: “Together with his true brilliant wealth-winning friendly (Maruts) he destroyed the detainer of the cows;Brahmaṇaspati, with the showerers (of benefits), the conveyers of desirable (water), the frequenters of sacrifice,acquired wealth.”

Sukta 67.translation: “They with truthful mind searching for the cows resolved by their exploits to make him the lord of cattle;Bṛhaspatiwith his self-yoked (allied) mutually defending each other from reproach, set free the kind.”

Sukta 67.translation: “Magnifying the victoriousBṛhaspati, the showerer (of benefits), roaring in mid-heaven like a lion, letus praise him in the conflicts where heroes win, with auspicious praises.”
Sukta 67.sanskrit_wisdomlib: तं व॒र्धय॑न्तो म॒तिभि॑: शि॒वाभि॑: सिं॒हमि॑व॒ नान॑दतं स॒धस्थे॑ । बृह॒स्पतिं॒ वृष॑णं॒ शूर॑सातौ॒ भरे॑भरे॒ अनु॑ मदेम जि॒ष्णुम्

devanagari.text: यदा वाजमसनद्विश्वरूपमा द्यामरुक्षदुत्तराणि सद्म ।बृहस्पतिं वृषणं वर्धयंतो नाना संतो बिभ्रतो ज्योतिरासा ॥

Sukta 67.translation: “When he acquires food of various kinds, when he ascends the sky or the northern stations, (the godsare) extollingBṛhaspati, the showerer (of benefits), with their mouth, being in various (quarters), bearing light.”
Sukta 67.sanskrit_wisdomlib: य॒दा वाज॒मस॑नद्वि॒श्वरू॑प॒मा द्यामरु॑क्ष॒दुत्त॑राणि॒ सद्म॑ । बृह॒स्पतिं॒ वृष॑णं व॒र्धय॑न्तो॒ नाना॒ सन्तो॒ बिभ्र॑तो॒ ज्योति॑रा॒सा

devanagari.text: सत्यामाशिषं कृणुता वयोधै कीरिं चिद्ध्यवथ स्वेभिरेवैः ।पश्चा मृधो अप भवंतु विश्वास्तद्रोदसी शृणुतं विश्वमिन्वे ॥

Sukta 67.translation: “Make good our prayer for the bestowal of food; you protect through your movements even (me) yourprayer).”

Sukta 67.translation: “Indraby his might has cleft the brow of the vast watery cloud, he has slain Ahi; he has made the sevenrivers flow; do you, heaven and earth, along with the gods, protect us.”

Sukta 68.translation: “The son ofAṅgirasapervading him with his brightness has, likeBhaga, broughtAryamanto the cows;asMitra(unites his radiance) with the people, so has he united husband and wife;Bṛhaspati, send (yourwide-spread rays to your worshippers) as (a warrior sends his) horses to battle.”

Sukta 68.translation: “Bṛhaspatibrings unto (the gods), after extricating them from the mountains, the cows that are theyielders of pure (milk), ever in motion, the objects of search and of desire, well-coloured and of unexceptionableform, (as men bring) barley from the granaries.”
Sukta 68.sanskrit_wisdomlib: सा॒ध्व॒र्या अ॑ति॒थिनी॑रिषि॒रा स्पा॒र्हाः सु॒वर्णा॑ अनव॒द्यरू॑पाः । बृह॒स्पति॒: पर्व॑तेभ्यो वि॒तूर्या॒ निर्गा ऊ॑पे॒ यव॑मिव स्थि॒विभ्य॑:

Sukta 68.translation: “Saturating (the earth) with water, scattering the receptacle of rain, the adorableBṛhaspati, raising upthe cattle from the rock as (he raises) a meteor from the sky, rent the skin of the earth (with the hoofs of thecattle) as (Parjanyarends it) with rain.”
Sukta 68.sanskrit_wisdomlib: आ॒प्रु॒षा॒यन्मधु॑न ऋ॒तस्य॒ योनि॑मवक्षि॒पन्न॒र्क उ॒ल्कामि॑व॒ द्योः । बृह॒स्पति॑रु॒द्धर॒न्नश्म॑नो॒ गा भूम्या॑ उ॒द्नेव॒ वि त्वचं॑ बिभेद

Sukta 68.translation: “Bṛhaspatidrove away the darkness from the firmament with light as the wind (blows) the Śīpālafrom the water; guessing (them to be there), he swept theVala's cows together to himself as the wind (sweeps)the clouds.”

Sukta 68.translation: “WhenBṛhaspatidemolished with rays burning like fire the weapon of the malignantVala, he devouredhim (encompassed by his followers) as the tongue (consumes) that which is encompassed by the teeth; he mademanifest the hiding- plural ce of the kine.”

Sukta 68.translation: “WhenBṛhaspatihad discovered that name of the lowing kine in their plural ce in the cave, by his ownstrength he extricated the cattle from the rock as (breaking) the eggs of a bird (one extricates) the embryo.”

Sukta 68.translation: “Bṛhaspatifound the dawn, the sun,Agni; he dispersed the gloom with light; he seized (the cattle fromthe rock)) ofValasurrounded by the kine as (one extracts) marrow from a bone.”

Sukta 68.translation: “As the trees (bemoan) their leaves carried off by the winter, soValabemoaned his kine (carried off) byBṛhaspati; he did that which cannot be imitated, which cannot be repeated, whereby sun and moon mutually rise(day and night).”

Sukta 68.translation: “The protecting (deities) have decorated the heaven with constellations as (men decorate) a brownhorse with golden trappings; they established darkness in the night and light in the day;Bṛhaspatifractured therock and recovered the cows.”

Sukta 69.translation: “Do you,Agni, whom Vadhryaśva propitiating you formerly kindled, accept this; be the proector of oursacrifices, be the protector of our bodies; preserve this wealth which has been given to us by you.”
Sukta 69.sanskrit_wisdomlib: यं त्वा॒ पूर्व॑मीळि॒तो व॑ध्र्य॒श्वः स॑मी॒धे अ॑ग्ने॒ स इ॒दं जु॑षस्व । स न॑: स्ति॒पा उ॒त भ॑वा तनू॒पा दा॒त्रं र॑क्षस्व॒ यदि॒दं ते॑ अ॒स्मे

devanagari.text: भवा द्युम्नी वाध्र्यश्वोत गोपा मा त्वा तारीदभिमातिर्जनानां ।शूर इव धृष्णुश्च्यवनः सुमित्रः प्र नु वोचं वाध्र्यश्वस्य नाम ॥

transliteration.text: bháva ǀ dyumnī́ ǀ vādhri-aśva ǀ utá ǀ gopā́ḥ ǀ mā́ ǀ tvā ǀ tārīt ǀ abhí-mātiḥ ǀ jánānām ǀśū́raḥ-iva ǀ ghṛṣṇúḥ ǀ cyávanaḥ ǀ su-mitráḥ ǀ prá ǀ nú ǀ vocam ǀ vā́dhri-aśvasya ǀ nā́ma ǁ

Sukta 69.translation: “Kinsman of Vadhryaśva, be the possessor of food and our protector; let no one assail you, (for youare) the overcomer of men; like a resolute warrior (you are) the overthrower (of enemies); I,Sumitra, celebratethe names of the kinsmen ofVadhyaśva.”
Sukta 69.sanskrit_wisdomlib: भवा॑ द्यु॒म्नी वा॑ध्र्यश्वो॒त गो॒पा मा त्वा॑ तारीद॒भिमा॑ति॒र्जना॑नाम् । शूर॑ इव धृ॒ष्णुश्च्यव॑नः सुमि॒त्रः प्र नु वो॑चं॒ वाध्र्य॑श्वस्य॒ नाम॑

devanagari.text: समज्र्या पर्वत्या वसूनि दासा वृत्राण्यार्या जिगेथ ।शूर इव धृष्णुश्च्यवनो जनानां त्वमग्ने पृतनायूँरभि ष्याः ॥
सम् । अज्र्या । पर्वत्या । वसूनि । दासा । वृत्राणि । आर्या । जिगेथ ।शूरःऽइव । घृष्णुः । च्यवनः । जनानाम् । त्वम् । अग्ने । पृतनाऽयून् । अभि । स्याः ॥

transliteration.text: sám ǀ ajryā́ ǀ parvatyā́ ǀ vásūni ǀ dā́sā ǀ vṛtrā́ṇi ǀ ā́ryā ǀ jigetha ǀśū́raḥ-iva ǀ ghṛṣṇúḥ ǀ cyávanaḥ ǀ jánānām ǀ tvám ǀ agne ǀ pṛtanā-yū́n ǀ abhí ǀ syāḥ ǁ

Sukta 69.translation: “You have gained mountain-treasures beneficial to men, (you have defeated the hostilities) of strongmen,DāsasandVṛtras, like a resolute warrior, do you,Agni, the overthrower (of enemies), overcome thosewho are desirous of battle.”
Sukta 69.sanskrit_wisdomlib: सम॒ज्र्या॑ पर्व॒त्या॒३॒॑ वसू॑नि॒ दासा॑ वृ॒त्राण्यार्या॑ जिगेथ । शूर॑ इव धृ॒ष्णुश्च्यव॑नो॒ जना॑नां॒ त्वम॑ग्ने पृतना॒यूँर॒भि ष्या॑:

devanagari.text: दीर्घतंतुर्बृहदुक्षायमग्निः सहस्रस्तरीः शतनीथ ऋभ्वा ।द्युमांद्युमत्सु नृभिर्मृज्यमानः सुमित्रेषु दीदयो देवयत्सु ॥
दीर्घऽतन्तुः । बृहत्ऽउक्षा । अयम् । अग्निः । सहस्रऽस्तरीः । शतऽनीथः । ऋभ्वा ।द्युऽमान् । द्युमत्ऽसु । नृऽभिः । मृज्यमानः । सुऽमित्रेषु । दीदयः । देवयत्ऽसु ॥

transliteration.text: dīrghá-tantuḥ ǀ bṛhát-ukṣā ǀ ayám ǀ agníḥ ǀ sahásra-starīḥ ǀ śatá-nīthaḥ ǀ ṛ́bhvā ǀdyu-mā́n ǀ dyumát-su ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ mṛjyámānaḥ ǀ su-mitréṣu ǀ dīdayaḥ ǀ devayát-su ǁ

Sukta 69.translation: “ThisAgnito whom a long series (of sacrifices has been addressed), who is bright with many rays,covering thousands (in the form of ghī), the leader of hundreds (of burnt offerings), the mighty one, brilliantamong the brilliant, (is) being glorified by the priests; shine (Agni) upon the devoutSumitras.”
Sukta 69.sanskrit_wisdomlib: दी॒र्घत॑न्तुर्बृ॒हदु॑क्षा॒यम॒ग्निः स॒हस्र॑स्तरीः श॒तनी॑थ॒ ऋभ्वा॑ । द्यु॒मान्द्यु॒मत्सु॒ नृभि॑र्मृ॒ज्यमा॑नः सुमि॒त्रेषु॑ दीदयो देव॒यत्सु॑

devanagari.text: त्वे धेनुः सुदुघा जातवेदोऽसश्चतेव समना सबर्धुक् ।त्वं नृभिर्दक्षिणावद्भिरग्ने सुमित्रेभिरिध्यसे देवयद्भिः ॥
त्वे इति । धेनुः । सुऽदुघा । जातऽवेदः । असश्चताऽइव । समना । सबःऽधुक् ।त्वम् । नृऽभिः । दक्षिणावत्ऽभिः । अग्ने । सुऽमित्रेभिः । इध्यसे । देवयत्ऽभिः ॥

transliteration.text: tvé íti ǀ dhenúḥ ǀ su-dúghā ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ asaścátā-iva ǀ samanā́ ǀ sabaḥ-dhúk ǀtvám ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ dákṣiṇāvat-bhiḥ ǀ agne ǀ su-mitrébhiḥ ǀ idhyase ǀ devayát-bhiḥ ǁ

Sukta 69.translation: “In you,Jātavedas, is the cow easy to be milked, yielding ambrosia as it were inexhaustibly in battle,you are kindled,Agni, by the devoutSumitraswho are entitled to the sacrificial donation.”
Sukta 69.sanskrit_wisdomlib: त्वे धे॒नुः सु॒दुघा॑ जातवेदोऽस॒श्चते॑व सम॒ना स॑ब॒र्धुक् । त्वं नृभि॒र्दक्षि॑णावद्भिरग्ने सुमि॒त्रेभि॑रिध्यसे देव॒यद्भि॑:

devanagari.text: देवाश्चित्ते अमृता जातवेदो महिमानं वाध्र्यश्व प्र वोचन् ।यत्संपृच्छं मानुषीर्विश आयंत्वं नृभिरजयस्त्वावृधेभिः ॥
देवाः । चित् । ते । अमृताः । जातऽवेदः । महिमानम् । वाध्रिऽअश्व । प्र । वोचन् ।यत् । सम्ऽपृच्छम् । मानुषीः । विशः । आयन् । त्वम् । नृऽभिः । अजयः । त्वाऽवृधेभिः ॥

transliteration.text: devā́ḥ ǀ cit ǀ te ǀ amṛ́tāḥ ǀ jāta-vedaḥ ǀ mahimā́nam ǀ vādhri-aśva ǀ prá ǀ vocan ǀyát ǀ sam-pṛ́ccham ǀ mā́nuṣīḥ ǀ víśaḥ ǀ ā́yan ǀ tvám ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ ajayaḥ ǀ tvā́-vṛdhebhiḥ ǁ

Sukta 69.translation: “The immortal gods have proclaimed your greatness.Jātavedas, Vadhryaśva (Agni); when humanbeings, came to inquire (who would slay theasuras), then you with (the gods), the leaders of all, fostered by youdid overcome (those who impeded the ceremony).”
Sukta 69.sanskrit_wisdomlib: दे॒वाश्चि॑त्ते अ॒मृता॑ जातवेदो महि॒मानं॑ वाध्र्यश्व॒ प्र वो॑चन् । यत्स॒म्पृच्छं॒ मानु॑षी॒र्विश॒ आय॒न्त्वं नृभि॑रजय॒स्त्वावृ॑धेभिः

devanagari.text: पितेव पुत्रमबिभरुपस्थे त्वामग्ने वध्र्यश्वः सपर्यन् ।जुषाणो अस्य समिधं यविष्ठोत पूर्वाँ अवनोर्व्राधतश्चित् ॥

transliteration.text: pitā́-iva ǀ putrám ǀ abibhaḥ ǀ upá-sthe ǀ tvā́m ǀ agne ǀ vadhri-aśváḥ ǀ saparyán ǀjuṣāṇáḥ ǀ asya ǀ sam-ídham ǀ yaviṣṭha ǀ utá ǀ pū́rvān ǀ avanoḥ ǀ vrā́dhataḥ ǀ cit ǁ

Sukta 69.translation: “Vadhryaśva, honouring you,Agni, plural ced you upon the altar as a father (plural ces) his son (upon hislap); plural ased with his fuel, youngest (of the gods), you did slay the ancient obstructers of the rite.”
Sukta 69.sanskrit_wisdomlib: पि॒तेव॑ पु॒त्रम॑बिभरु॒पस्थे॒ त्वाम॑ग्ने वध्र्य॒श्वः स॑प॒र्यन् । जु॒षा॒णो अ॑स्य स॒मिधं॑ यविष्ठो॒त पूर्वाँ॑ अवनो॒र्व्राध॑तश्चित्

devanagari.text: शश्वदग्निर्वध्र्यश्वस्य शत्रून्नृभिर्जिगाय सुतसोमवद्भिः ।समनं चिददहश्चित्रभानोऽव व्राधंतमभिनद्वृधश्चित् ॥

transliteration.text: śáśvat ǀ agníḥ ǀ vadhri-aśvásya ǀ śátrūn ǀ nṛ́-bhiḥ ǀ jigāya ǀ sutásomavat-bhiḥ ǀsámanam ǀ cit ǀ adahaḥ ǀ citrabhāno íti citra-bhāno ǀ áva ǀ vrā́dhantam ǀ abhinat ǀ vṛdháḥ ǀ cit ǁ

Sukta 69.translation: “Agniby means of the priests of Vadhryaśva pouring out libations always conquers his foes; you(Agni) shining with varied splendour, have consumed the battle; (your praiser) self-fostered has destroyed hispowerful (assailant).”
Sukta 69.sanskrit_wisdomlib: शश्व॑द॒ग्निर्व॑ध्र्य॒श्वस्य॒ शत्रू॒न्नृभि॑र्जिगाय सु॒तसो॑मवद्भिः । सम॑नं चिददहश्चित्रभा॒नोऽव॒ व्राध॑न्तमभिनद्वृ॒धश्चि॑त्

devanagari.text: अयमग्निर्वध्र्यश्वस्य वृत्रहा सनकात्प्रेद्धो नमसोपवाक्यः ।स नो अजामीँरुत वा विजामीनभि तिष्ठ शर्धतो वाध्र्यश्व ॥
